	v10.W = p5
	v10.A = p6
	v10.S = p7
	v10.D = p8

	v10.ThrottleFloat = 0

	v10.Changed = v10._Event.Event
	return v10
end
function v_u_4.Connect(p_u_11) -- name: Connect
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	p_u_11:Disconnect()
	if v_u_3 then
		p_u_11._cn = v_u_1.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_11
			local v12 = 0
			local v13 = 0
			if p_u_11.W.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v13 = v13 + 1
			end
			if p_u_11.S.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v13 = v13 - 1
			end
			if p_u_11.A.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v12 = v12 - 1
			end
			if p_u_11.D.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v12 = v12 + 1
			end
			p_u_11:_Check(v12, v13)
		end)
	else
		p_u_11._cn = v_u_1.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (copy) p_u_11
			local v14 = 0
			local v15 = 0
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
				v15 = v15 + 1
			end
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
				v15 = v15 - 1
			end
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
				v14 = v14 - 1
			end
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
				v14 = v14 + 1
			end
			p_u_11:_Check(v14, v15)
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_4._Check(p16, p17, p18) -- name: _Check
	if p17 ~= p16.SteerFloat or p18 ~= p16.ThrottleFloat then
		p16.SteerFloat = p17
		p16.ThrottleFloat = p18
		p16._Event:Fire(p18, p17)
	end
end

	if p19._cn then
		p19._cn:Disconnect()
	end
end
return v_u_4

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10

function v_u_3.Update(p15, p16) -- name: Update
	local v17 = p15.Model
	local v18 = p15.Driver
	local v19 = p15.Config
	if v17 and v17.Parent then
		if v17:GetAttribute("IsTurn") then
			local v20 = -p15.SteerFloat * v19.MaxTurnAngle
			local v21 = p15.ThrottleFloat * v19.MaxSpeed
			local v22 = not p15.IsLift and 0 or v19.MaxUpAngle
			if p15.Speed < 0 and v21 == 0 then
				p15.Speed = 0
			end
			p15.SteerAngle = p15.SteerAngle + (v20 - p15.SteerAngle) * p16 * v19.TurnSpeed
			p15.Speed = p15.Speed + (v21 - p15.Speed) * p16 * v19.Torque
			if v22 > 0 then
				p15.Up = p15.Up + (v22 - p15.Up) * p16 * v19.UpSpeed
				p15.BalanceOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
			else
				p15.Up = p15.Up * (p15.Up / v19.MaxUpAngle)
				p15.BalanceOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
				local v23 = p15.Speed
				if math.abs(v23) < 0.3 * v19.MaxSpeed or p15.Up < 5 then
					p15.Up = 0
					p15.BalanceOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.PrimaryAxisPerpendicular
				end
			end
			local v24 = p15.SteerAngle
			local v25 = p15.Speed
			local v26 = p15.Up
			local v27 = workspace:Raycast(p15.Model.BackWheel.Position, v18.CFrame.UpVector * -5, p15.Raypara)
			local v28 = v27 and v27.Normal or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local v29 = v18.CFrame.LookVector:Cross(v28):Cross(v28)
			local v30 = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -v29, v28)
			local v31 = CFrame.new(v18.Position - v28 * 10) * v30 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
			p15.RootAttachment.WorldCFrame = p15.RootAttachment.WorldCFrame:Lerp(v31, 0.5)
			local v32 = v18.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * v25
			local v33 = math.abs(v25)
			local v34 = v32 / math.max(v33, 0.001)
			if v34 < 0 then
				local _ = v34 * 5
			end
			local v35 = -(-p15.SteerFloat) * v19.SteerPerSpeed * v18.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			local v36 = -v19.MaxSteerSpeed
			local v37 = v19.MaxSteerSpeed
			local v38 = math.clamp(v35, v36, v37)
			if v26 == 0 then
				p15.BalanceOrientation.Attachment0.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, v38)
			else
				local v39 = p15.BalanceOrientation.Attachment0
				local v40 = CFrame.Angles
				local v41 = -math.rad(v26)
				local v42 = -v24
				v39.CFrame = v40(v41, math.rad(v42), (math.rad(v38))) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
			end
			local v43 = -v19.MaxTurnAngle
			local v44 = v19.MaxTurnAngle
			local v45 = math.clamp(v24, v43, v44)
			local v46 = math.rad(v45)
			local v47 = v19.SteerAngleDivSpeed
			local v48 = p15.Speed
			local v49 = math.abs(v48)
			local v50 = v47 / math.max(v49, 0.001)
			local v51 = v46 / math.max(1, v50)
			v17.Handle.HandleMotor.DesiredAngle = v51
			v17.BackWheel.BackMotor.AngularVelocity = math.max(v25, -10)

		p15:Stop()
		return
	end
end

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6

	describe("Promise:finally", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should be called upon resolve, reject, or cancel", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_153 = 0
			local function v154() -- name: finally
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_153
				v_u_153 = v_u_153 + 1
			end
			v_u_1.new(function(p155, _)
				p155()

		end)
		it("should not forward return values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

	end,
	["Await"] = function(p10, p11, p12, p13) -- name: Await
		local v14 = p10

			error(("Got class %*; expected to be of type %*"):format(p10.ClassName, p13), 2)

function v8.Format(p28, p29) -- name: Format
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_1.class.try_coerce(1, p28, "NumberFormatter")
	if type(p29) == "string" then
		error("Argument #2 as a string interpreted as decimal is not currently supported, please cast the argument to a double if you want the string to be interpreted as a double", 2)
	end
	local v30 = v_u_1.class.try_coerce(2, p29, "number")
	local v31 = v_u_1.class.get_resolved_data(p28, v_u_27)
	local v32 = v31.symbols
	local v33, v34, v35
	if v30 == v30 then
		if v30 == (1 / 0) or v30 == (-1 / 0) then
			v33 = v30 < 0
			v34 = v32[v_u_6.ENumberFormatSymbols.kInfinitySymbol]
			v35 = false
		else
			local v36, v37, v38
			if v30 == 0 then
				v33 = math.atan2(v30, -1) < 0
				v36 = nil
				v37 = 0
				v38 = 1
			else
				v33 = v30 < 0
				v36, v37, v38 = v_u_1.decimal_conversion.from_double((math.abs(v30)))
			end
			v34, v35 = v_u_1.format.format_unsigned_finite(v36, v37, v38, v33, v31)
		end
	else
		local v39 = string.pack
		v33 = string.byte(v39(">d", v30)) >= 128
		v34 = v32[v_u_6.ENumberFormatSymbols.kNaNSymbol]
		v35 = true
	end
	return v_u_1.format.display_sign(v34, v33, v35, v31.displaySignAt, v31.symbols)
end

									else
										local v17 = v16 + 1
										if p5 == v17 then
											v8 = "Sign"
											if p6 then
												print("Sign ---")
												v_u_2.Sign()
												return v8
											end
										else
											local v18 = v17 + 1
											if p5 == v18 then
												v8 = "SignNearZero"
												if p6 then
													print("SignNearZero ---")
													v_u_2.SignNearZero()
													return v8
												end
											else
												local v19 = v18 + 1
												if p5 == v19 then
													v8 = "SignCoverage"
													if p6 then
														print("SignCoverage ---")
														v_u_2.SignCoverage()
														return v8
													end
												else
													local v20 = v19 + 1
													if p5 ~= v20 then
														local _ = v20 + 1
														return ""
													end
													v8 = "Decimal"
													if p6 then
														print("Decimal ---")
														v_u_2.Decimal()
														return v8
													end
												end
											end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return v8
end

function v_u_2.SignNearZero() -- name: SignNearZero
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	for _, v21 in {
		{ v_u_1.SignDisplay.AUTO, 1.1, "1" },
		{ v_u_1.SignDisplay.AUTO, 0.9, "1" },

local function v_u_14(p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: internal_get_digits
	local v8
	if p6 <= 0 then
		v8 = string.rep("0", -p6 + 1)
		p6 = 1
	else
		v8 = ""
	end
	local v9 = p6 - 1
	local v10 = p7 - math.max(p5, v9)
	local v11
	if v10 <= 0 then
		v11 = ""
	else
		v11 = string.rep("0", v10)
		p7 = p5
	end
	local v12
	if p5 < p6 then
		v12 = ""
	else
		local v13 = table.unpack
		v12 = string.char(v13(p4, p6, p7))
	end
	return v8 .. v12 .. v11
end
function v_u_3.strip_trailing_zero(p15, p16) -- name: strip_trailing_zero
	if p16 < 0 then
		return 0
	end
	while p15[p16] == 0 do
		p16 = p16 - 1
	end
	return p16
end
function v_u_3.round_sig(p17, p18, p19, p20, p21) -- name: round_sig
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3
	local v22 = 0
	if p19 < p18 then
		local v23 = nil
		local v24 = p19 < 0 and -1 or (p17[p19 + 1] > 5 and 1 or (p17[p19 + 1] == 5 and (p19 + 1 < p18 and 1 or 0) or -1))
		local v25
		if p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.CEILING then
			v25 = p20 and 1 or -2
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.FLOOR then
			v25 = p20 and -2 or 1
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.UP then
			v25 = -2
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.DOWN then
			v25 = 1
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN then
			v25 = p19 <= 0 and 0 or p17[p19] % -2
		else
			v25 = p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.HALF_DOWN and 0 or (p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.HALF_UP and -1 or v23)
		end
		if v25 < v24 then
			while p17[p19] == 9 and p19 > 0 do
				p19 = p19 - 1
			end
			if p19 <= 0 then
				p17[1] = 1
				v22 = 1 - p19
				p19 = 1
			else
				p17[p19] = p17[p19] + 1
			end
		end
		p18 = v_u_3.strip_trailing_zero(p17, p19)
	end
	return p18, v22
end
function v_u_3.resolve_int_frac(p26, p27, p28, p29, p30, p31, p32) -- name: resolve_int_frac
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	for v33 = 1, p27 do
		p26[v33] = p26[v33] + 48
	end
	local v34, v35
	if p28 < p29 and p30 < p28 + 1 then
		v34 = "0"
		v35 = ""
	else
		v34 = v_u_14(p26, p27, p29, p28)
		v35 = v_u_14(p26, p27, p28 + 1, p30)
	end
	if p31 and p31 <= p28 - p29 + 1 then
		local v36
		if p32 == "%" then
			v36 = "%0%%"
		elseif #p32 > 1 then
			v36 = "%0" .. string.reverse(p32)
		else
			v36 = "%0" .. p32
		end
		v34 = string.reverse((string.gsub(string.reverse(v34), "...", v36, (p28 - p29) / 3)))
	end
	return v34, v35
end
function v_u_3.format_expt(p37, p38, p39, p40) -- name: format_expt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v41 = ""
	local v42
	if p37 < 0 then
		local v43 = -p37
		v42 = tostring(v43)
		if p40.negative then
			v41 = p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kMinusSignSymbol]
		end
	elseif p37 == 0 then
		v42 = "0"
		if p40.positiveZero then
			v41 = p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kPlusSignSymbol]
		end
	else
		v42 = tostring(p37)
		if p40.positive then
			v41 = p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kPlusSignSymbol]
		end
	end
	local v44 = string.rep("0", p39 - #v42) .. v42
	return p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kExponentialSymbol] .. v41 .. v44
end
function v_u_3.resolve_with_notation(_, p45, p46, p47, p48) -- name: resolve_with_notation

	local v49 = nil
	local v50 = nil
	local v51 = nil
	if p45 <= 0 then
		if p47.type == v_u_1._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC then
			v49 = v_u_3.format_expt(0, p48, p47.minExponentDigits, p47.displayExponentSignAt)
		end
	elseif p47.type == v_u_1._Internal.NotationType.SIMPLE then
		p46 = p46 + p45
	else
		local v52 = p47.power10Scale
		local v53 = p46 + p45 - 1

		local v55 = math.floor(v54)

			if v56 < v55 then

			end

	end

function v_u_3.format_unsigned_finite(p57, p58, p59, p60, p61) -- name: format_unsigned_finite

	local v63 = p61.integerWidth.max

	end

	end

function v_u_3.display_sign(p80, p81, p82, p83, p84) -- name: display_sign

local function v_u_43(p37) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_1
	local v38, v40, v40 = string.match(p37, "^(%a+)/?([^/]*)/?([^/]*)$")
	local v41 = 1
	local v42 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
	if v38 == "scientific" or v38 == "engineering" then
		if string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		elseif string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		end
		if v40 ~= "" then
			if string.sub(v40, 1, 5) ~= "sign-" then
				return nil
			end
			v42 = v_u_36[v40]
		end
		if v41 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			return table.freeze({
				["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
				["power10Scale"] = v38 == "engineering" and 3 or 1,
				["minExponentDigits"] = v41,
				["exponentSignDisplay"] = v42,
				["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v42)
			})
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_50(p44) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation_concise
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v45, v46 = string.match(p44, "^(EE?)(.+)$")
	if v45 then
		local v47, v48 = string.match(v46, "^(%+[!%?])(.+)$")
		local v49
		if v47 then
			v49 = v_u_36[v47]
		else
			v49 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
			v48 = v46
		end
		if string.match(v48, "^0+$") then
			if #v48 > 999 then
				return nil
			else
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
					["power10Scale"] = v45 == "EE" and 3 or 1,
					["minExponentDigits"] = #v48,
					["exponentSignDisplay"] = v49,
					["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v49)
				})
			end
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_71(p51) -- name: skeleton_to_precision
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v52, v53, v54 = string.match(p51, "^%.((0*)#*)(.*)$")
	if not v52 then
		v52, v54 = string.match(p51, "^(precision%-integer)(.*)$")
	end
	if v52 then
		local v55, v56
		if v52 == "precision-integer" then
			v55 = 0
			v56 = 0
		else
			v55 = #v53
			v56 = #v52
		end
		if string.match(v54, "^[%*%+]") and v53 == v52 then
			v54 = string.sub(v54, 2)
			v56 = -1
		end
		if v55 > 999 or v56 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			if v56 == -1 then
				v56 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
			end
			if string.sub(v54, 1, 1) == "/" then
				local v57 = false
				local v58, v59, v60 = string.match(v54, "^/((@+)#*)([%*%+rs]?)$")
				if not v58 or v60 == "" and v59 ~= "@" or (v60 == "*" or v60 == "+") and v59 ~= v58 then
					return nil
				end
				local v61, v62
				if v60 == "" then
					v61 = #v58
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "s"
				elseif v60 == "*" or v60 == "+" then
					v61 = #v59
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "r"
				else
					v62 = #v59
					v61 = #v58
					v57 = true
				end
				if v62 > 999 or v61 > 999 then
					return nil
				end
				local v63 = table.freeze
				local v64 = {
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT,
					["minFractionDigits"] = v55,
					["maxFractionDigits"] = v56,
					["minSignificantDigits"] = v62,
					["maxSignificantDigits"] = v61
				}
				local v65
				if v60 == "r" then
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED
				else
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.STRICT
				end
				v64.roundingPriority = v65
				v64.sourcedWithSignificantDigits = v57
				return v63(v64)
			elseif v54 == "" then
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION,
					["min"] = v55,
					["max"] = v56
				})
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	else
		local v66, v67, v68 = string.match(p51, "^((@+)#*)([%*%+]?)$")
		if not v66 then
			return nil
		end
		local v69 = #v67
		local v70 = #v66
		if v68 ~= "" then
			if v69 ~= v70 then
				return nil
			end
			string.sub(v68, 2)
			v70 = -1
		end
		if v69 > 999 or v70 > 999 then
			return nil
		end
		if v70 == -1 then
			v70 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
		end
		return table.freeze({
			["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.SIGNFICANT,
			["min"] = v69,
			["max"] = v70
		})
	end
end
local function v_u_76(p72) -- name: skeleton_to_int_width
	if p72 == "integer-width-trunc" then
		return table.freeze({
			["min"] = 0,
			["max"] = 0
		})
	else
		local v73 = string.match(p72, "^integer%-width/[%*%+](0*)$")
		if v73 then
			if #v73 > 999 then
				return nil
			else
				return table.freeze({
					["min"] = nil,
					["max"] = -1,
					["min"] = #v73
				})
			end
		else
			local v74, v75 = string.match(p72, "^integer%-width/(#*(0*))$")
			if v74 and (v74 ~= "" and (#v74 <= 999 and #v75 <= 999)) then
				return table.freeze({
					["min"] = #v75,
					["max"] = #v74
				})
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_78(p77) -- name: skeleton_to_int_width_concise
	if string.match(p77, "^0+$") and #p77 < 1000 then
		return table.freeze({
			["min"] = nil,
			["max"] = -1,
			["min"] = #p77
		})
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function v3.to_option_linked_list(p79) -- name: to_option_linked_list
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_50, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_78
	local v80 = {}
	local v81 = nil
	for v82, v83 in string.gmatch(p79, "()(%S+)") do
		local v84 = v_u_35[v83]
		local v85
		if v84 then
			v85 = v_u_36[v83]
		else
			v85 = nil
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_43(v83) or v_u_50(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "notation"
			end
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_71(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "precision"
			end
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_76(v83) or v_u_78(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "integerWidth"
			end
		end
		if not v84 or v80[v84] then
			return false, string.format("number skeleton syntax error near \'%*\' at position %d", string.gsub(v83, "\'", "\\\'"), v82)
		end
		v80[v84] = true
		v81 = {
			["key"] = v84,
			["value"] = v85,
			["parent"] = v81
		}
	end
	return true, v81
end

	if p68.activeState ~= v73 then
		local v74 = p68.isSelected
		p68.activeState = v73
		if v73 == "Deselected" then
			p68.isSelected = false
			if v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(false, p70, p71)
				p68.deselected:Fire(p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p70, p71)
		elseif v73 == "Selected" then
			p68.isSelected = true
			if not v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(true, p70, p71)
				p68.selected:Fire(p70, p71)
				v_u_19:Fire(p68, p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p70, p71)
		end
		p68.stateChanged:Fire(v73, p70, p71)
	end
end
function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_75, p_u_76) -- name: getInstance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v77 = p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76]
	if v77 then
		return v77
	end
	local function v_u_81(p_u_78, p_u_79) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75
		if not p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] then
			local v80 = p_u_79:GetAttribute("Collective")

				v80 = p_u_75.cachedCollectives[v80]

				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_75, (copy) p_u_78, (copy) p_u_79
				p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = nil
				p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v82 = p_u_75.widget
	v_u_81("Widget", v82)
	if p_u_76 == "Widget" then
		return v82
	end
	local v_u_83 = nil
	local function v_u_89(p84) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_81, (copy) p_u_76, (ref) v_u_83
		for _, v85 in pairs(p84:GetChildren()) do

			if not v86 or v86 == p_u_75.UID then

				v_u_89(v87)

					end
				end

		end
	end

end

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_270, p_u_271, p_u_272) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_270, (copy) p_u_271, (copy) p_u_272
		local v_u_273 = p_u_270:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_273.Transparency = 1
		p_u_271.Parent = v_u_273.Parent
		p_u_271.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_271.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_271.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_271.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_271.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_274 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]
			p_u_270:addToJanitor(v_u_273:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v_u_274):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_274, (copy) v_u_273
				p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]
			end))
		end
		local function v_u_279() -- name: getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_271
			local v275 = 0
			local v276 = 0
			for _, v277 in p_u_271.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local v278 = string.lower(v277.Name)
				if v278 == "digit" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				elseif (v278 == "prefix" or (v278 == "suffix" or v278 == "comma")) and v277.Text ~= "" then
					v275 = v275 + v277.AbsoluteSize.X
					v276 = v276 + 1
				end
			end
			return v275, v276
		end
		local function v_u_288() -- name: adjustSize
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_279, (ref) p_u_270, (ref) p_u_271, (copy) v_u_273
			local v280, v281 = v_u_279()
			if v281 < 18 then
				p_u_270:setLabel(p_u_271.Value)
			end
			local v282 = p_u_271.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
			while v280 < v282 and p_u_270.isDestroyed ~= true do

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_1
	if p_u_20 then
		local v_u_25 = p_u_20:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v_u_25 then
			local v26 = p23 or false
			local v27 = p24 or 100
			if p21 then
				local v28 = script.cot:Clone()
				v28.Parent = p_u_20
				v28.CFrame = p_u_20.Head.CFrame
				local v29 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", v28)
				v29.Part0 = v28
				v29.Part1 = p_u_20.Head
				v_u_14(p_u_20, v_u_25)
				if v_u_2:IsClient() then
					v_u_25:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
					v_u_25:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
				elseif v_u_2:IsServer() then
					p_u_20.PrimaryPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
					v_u_25:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
					v_u_25:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
				end
				if v26 then
					local v30 = p_u_20:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if v30 and v30:IsA("BasePart") then
						v30:ApplyImpulse(v30.CFrame.LookVector * -v27)
						return
					end
				end
			else
				local v_u_31, v_u_32
				if p22 then
					v_u_31 = nil
					v_u_32 = nil
				else
					v_u_32 = Instance.new("Animation", p_u_20)
					if p_u_20.PrimaryPart.CFrame.LookVector.Y < -0.5 then
						v_u_32.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://83248247292511"
					else
						v_u_32.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://80150104042484"
					end
					v_u_31 = v_u_25.Animator:LoadAnimation(v_u_32)
					v_u_31.Looped = false
					v_u_31.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
					v_u_25.WalkSpeed = 0
				end
				v_u_19(p_u_20, v_u_25)
				if p_u_20:FindFirstChild("cot") then
					p_u_20.cot:Destroy()
				end
				if v_u_2:IsClient() then
					v_u_25:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
					v_u_25:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
				elseif v_u_2:IsServer() then
					v_u_25:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
					v_u_25.PlatformStand = false
					if not p22 then
						task.spawn(function()
							-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_31, (ref) v_u_32
							task.wait(0.1)
							v_u_25.WalkSpeed = 16
							v_u_31:Play()
							v_u_25.PlatformStand = false
							v_u_31.Stopped:Wait()
							v_u_32:Destroy()
						end)
					end
					v_u_25:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
					local v_u_33 = v_u_1:GetPlayerFromCharacter(p_u_20)
					if v_u_33 and (p_u_20 and (p_u_20.PrimaryPart and not p_u_20.PrimaryPart.Anchored)) then
						pcall(function()
							-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_20, (copy) v_u_33
							p_u_20.PrimaryPart:SetNetworkOwner(v_u_33)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			warn("RagdollModule.SetRagdoll: Character does not have a Humanoid.")
		end
	else
		warn("RagdollModule.SetRagdoll: No character provided.")
		return
	end
end
return v3

function v_u_20.m_AppendBone(_, p23, p24, p25, p26) -- name: m_AppendBone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_18
	local v27 = v_u_10.GatherBoneSettings(p24)
	local v28 = v_u_12.new(p24, p23.Root, p23.RootPart)
	for v29, v31 in v27 do
		if v31 == "\194\172" or not v31 then
			local v31 = nil
		end
		v28[v29] = v31
	end
	local v32 = p23.Bones[p25]
	if p25 > 0 then
		local v33 = (v32.Position - v28.Position).Magnitude
		v28.FreeLength = v33
		v28.Weight = v33 * 0.7
		v28.HeirarchyLength = p26
		v32.HasChild = true
	end
	if p26 <= p23.Settings.AnchorDepth then
		v_u_18("Anchoring bone")
		v28.Anchored = true
	end
	v28.ParentIndex = p25
	local v34 = p23.Bones
	table.insert(v34, v28)
end
function v_u_20.m_CreateBoneTree(p_u_35, p36, p37) -- name: m_CreateBoneTree
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_17
	local v_u_38 = v_u_13.new(p37, p36, v_u_10.GatherObjectSettings(p36))
	v_u_18((("Creating bone tree %*; %*"):format(p36.Name, p37.Name)))
	v_u_16()
	local function v_u_57(p39, p40, p41) -- name: AddChildren
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) p_u_35, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_57, (ref) v_u_17
		v_u_18((("Adding bone: %*; %*; %*"):format(p39.Name, p40, p41)))
		v_u_16()
		local v42 = false
		for _, v43 in p39:GetChildren() do
			if v43:IsA("Bone") then
				p_u_35:m_AppendBone(v_u_38, v43, p40, p41)
				v_u_57(v43, #v_u_38.Bones, p41 + 1)
				v42 = true
			end
		end
		local v44 = p39.Name
		local v45 = #p39.Name - 3
		local v46 = #p39.Name
		local v47
		if string.sub(v44, v45, v46) == "_end" then
			v47 = true
		else
			local v48 = p39.Name
			local v49 = #p39.Name - 4
			local v50 = #p39.Name
			v47 = string.sub(v48, v49, v50) == "_Tail" and true or v42
		end
		if not v47 then
			v_u_18("Adding tail bone")
			local v51 = p39.Parent
			local v52 = v51:IsA("Bone") and v51.WorldPosition or v51.Position
			local v53 = p39.WorldCFrame + p39.WorldCFrame.UpVector.Unit * (p39.WorldPosition - v52).Magnitude
			local v54 = Instance.new("Bone")
			v54.Parent = p39
			v54.Name = p39.Name .. "_Tail"
			v54.WorldCFrame = v53
			for v55, v56 in p39:GetAttributes() do
				v54:SetAttribute(v55, v56)
			end
			p_u_35:m_AppendBone(v_u_38, v54, #v_u_38.Bones, p41)
		end
		v_u_17()
	end
	p_u_35:m_AppendBone(v_u_38, p37, 0, 0)
	v_u_57(p37, 1, 1)
	local v58 = p_u_35.BoneTrees
	table.insert(v58, v_u_38)
	v_u_17()
end
function v_u_20.m_UpdateViewFrustum(p59) -- name: m_UpdateViewFrustum
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9
	if shared.FrameCounter % v_u_8.FRUSTUM_FREQ == 0 then
		local v60, v61, v62, v63, v64, v65, v66, v67, v68 = v_u_9.GetCFrames(workspace.CurrentCamera, v_u_8.FAR_PLANE)
		for _, v69 in p59.BoneTrees do
			local v70 = {
				["CFrame"] = v69.BoundingBoxCFrame,
				["Size"] = v69.BoundingBoxSize
			}
			v69.InView = v_u_9.ObjectInFrustum(v70, v60, v61, v62, v63, v64, v65, v66, v67, v68)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_20.m_CleanColliders(p71) -- name: m_CleanColliders
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_17
	local v72 = false
	if #p71.ColliderObjects ~= 0 then
		for v73, v74 in p71.ColliderObjects do
			if #v74.Colliders == 0 or v74.Destroyed == true then
				v_u_19("Deleting Collider Object")
				v_u_16()
				v74:Destroy()
				v_u_17()
				table.remove(p71.ColliderObjects, v73)
				v72 = true
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_20.m_UpdateBoneTree(p75, p76, p77, p78) -- name: m_UpdateBoneTree
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	if p76.Destroyed then
		p76:Destroy()
		table.remove(p75.BoneTrees, p77)
	else
		p76:PreUpdate(p78)
		if p76.InView then
			local v79 = p76.UpdateRate
			if math.floor(v79) ~= 0 and p76.InWorkspace then
				for _, v80 in p75.ColliderObjects do
					v80:Step()
				end
				local v81 = 1 / p76.UpdateRate
				p76.AccumulatedDelta = p76.AccumulatedDelta + p78
				local v82 = false
				while v81 < p76.AccumulatedDelta do
					p76.AccumulatedDelta = p76.AccumulatedDelta - v81
					p76:StepPhysics(v81)
					p76:Constrain(p75.ColliderObjects, v81)
					p76:SolveTransform(v81)
					v82 = true
				end
				if v82 then
					task.synchronize()
					p76:ApplyTransform()
				end
				return
			end
		end
		local v83 = p76.IsSkippingUpdates
		p76:SkipUpdate()
		if not v83 then
			task.synchronize()
			p76:ApplyTransform()
			local v84 = v_u_18
			local v85 = p76.InView
			local v86 = p76.UpdateRate
			v84((("Skipping BoneTree, InView: %*, Update Rate == 0: %*, InWorkspace: %*"):format(v85, math.floor(v86) == 0, p76.InWorkspace)))
		end
	end
end
function v_u_20.m_CheckDestroy(p87) -- name: m_CheckDestroy
	p87.ShouldDestroy = false
	if #p87.BoneTrees ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	p87.ShouldDestroy = true
	return true
end
function v_u_20.LoadObject(p88, p89) -- name: LoadObject
	local v90 = p89:GetAttribute("Roots")
	if v90 then
		local v91 = v90:split(",")
		local v92 = {}
		for _, v93 in p89:QueryDescendants("Bone") do
			if v92[v93.Name] then
				warn((("[SmartBone2::LoadObject] Duplicate bones of name: %* in RootPart: %*"):format(v93.Name, p89.Name)))
			else
				v92[v93.Name] = v93
			end
		end
		for _, v94 in v91 do
			local v95 = v92[v94]
			if v95 then
				p88:m_CreateBoneTree(p89, v95)
			else
				warn((("[SmartBone2::LoadObject] Couldn\'t find Root Bone of name: %* in RootPart: %*"):format(v94, p89.Name)))
			end
		end
	else
		warn((("[SmartBone2::LoadObject] Cannot load an object with no roots defined %*"):format(p89.Name)))
	end
end

function v_u_20.SkipUpdate(p107) -- name: SkipUpdate

		v108:SkipUpdate()

end
function v_u_20.StepBoneTrees(p109, p110) -- name: StepBoneTrees
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19
	if p109:m_CheckDestroy() then
		return
	elseif p110 <= 0 then
		v_u_19("DeltaTime is zero or sub zero, not updating.")
	else
		p109:m_CleanColliders()
		p109:m_UpdateViewFrustum()
		for v111, v112 in p109.BoneTrees do
			p109:m_UpdateBoneTree(v112, v111, p110)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_20.Start() -- name: Start
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_7
	if v_u_4:IsClient() then
		if not v_u_20.Running then
			if v_u_8.STARTUP_PRINT_ENABLED or v_u_8.LOG_VERBOSE then
				print((("SmartBone2 v%* Starting"):format(v_u_8.VERSION)))
			end
			v_u_20.Running = true
			local v140 = v_u_3.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
			local v_u_141 = Instance.new("Folder")
			v_u_141.Name = "SmartBone-Actors"
			v_u_141.Parent = v140
			local v142 = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			v142.Name = "OverlayEvent"
			v142.Parent = script
			v142.Event:Connect(function(p143, ...)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
				if v_u_8.DEBUG_OVERLAY_ENABLED then
					if p143 == "Text" then
						v_u_11:Text(...)
						return
					elseif p143 == "Begin" then
						v_u_11:Begin(...)
					elseif p143 == "End" then
						v_u_11:End()
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end)
			local v_u_144 = {}
			local v_u_145 = {}
			local function v_u_151() -- name: GatherColliders
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_8
				local v146 = {
					["Key"] = {},
					["Raw"] = {}
				}
				for _, v147 in v_u_1:GetTagged("SmartCollider") do
					if v147:IsA("BasePart") then
						local v148 = v147:GetAttribute("ColliderKey")
						if v148 then
							v148 = tostring(v148)
							if not v146.Key[v148] then
								v146.Key[v148] = {}
							end
							local v149 = v146.Key[v148]
							table.insert(v149, v147)
						end
						v_u_18((("Adding collider: %*, Collider Key: %*"):format(v147.Name, v148)))
						local v150 = v146.Raw
						table.insert(v150, v147)
						if v_u_8.YIELD_ON_COLLIDER_GATHER then
							task.wait()
						end
					end
				end
				return v146
			end
			local function v164(p_u_152) -- name: SetupObject
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_151, (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_141, (copy) v_u_144, (ref) v_u_17
				if p_u_152:IsA("BasePart") then
					v_u_18((("Setup Object: %*"):format(p_u_152.Name)))
					v_u_16()
					local v153 = v_u_151()
					local v154 = p_u_152:GetAttribute("ColliderKey")
					local v155
					if v154 then
						v155 = v153.Key[tostring(v154)] or {}
					else
						v155 = v153.Raw or {}
					end
					local v156 = {}
					for _, v157 in v155 do
						local v158 = { v_u_10.GetCollider(v157), v157 }
						table.insert(v156, v158)
					end
					local v159 = table.remove(v_u_145) or Instance.new("Actor")
					local v160 = v_u_15:Clone()
					v160.Parent = v159
					v160.Enabled = true
					v159.Parent = v_u_141
					v_u_144[p_u_152] = v159
					task.wait()
					v159:SendMessage("Setup", p_u_152, v156, script)
					p_u_152:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_152, (ref) v_u_144, (ref) v_u_145
						if p_u_152.Parent == nil then
							local v161 = p_u_152
							local v162 = v_u_144[v161]
							v_u_144[v161] = nil
							if v162 then
								v162.Name = "Pooled Actor"
								local v163 = v_u_145
								table.insert(v163, v162)
							end
						else
							return
						end
					end)
					v_u_18("Runtime Started")
					v_u_17()
				end
			end
			local v_u_165 = v_u_1:GetInstanceAddedSignal("SmartBone"):Connect(v164)
			local v_u_169 = v_u_1:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("SmartBone"):Connect(function(p166) -- name: OnObjectFreed
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_144, (copy) v_u_145
				local v167 = v_u_144[p166]
				v_u_144[p166] = nil
				if v167 then
					v167.Name = "Pooled Actor"
					local v168 = v_u_145
					table.insert(v168, v167)
				end
			end)
			for _, v170 in v_u_1:GetTagged("SmartBone") do
				v164(v170)
			end
			if v_u_8.DEBUG_OVERLAY_ENABLED then
				v_u_11 = v_u_7.new()
				local v171 = v_u_3.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
				local v172 = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
				v172.Name = "SmartBoneDebugOverlay"
				v172.IgnoreGuiInset = true
				v172.ResetOnSpawn = false
				v172.Parent = v171
				v_u_11.BackFrame.Parent = v172
				v_u_4.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11
					v_u_11:Render()
				end)
			end
			return {
				["Stop"] = function() -- name: Stop
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_141, (copy) v_u_165, (copy) v_u_169
					v_u_20.Running = false
					if v_u_8.RESET_BONE_ON_DESTROY then
						for _, v173 in v_u_141:GetChildren() do
							v173:SendMessage("Destroy")
						end
						if v_u_165 then
							v_u_165:Disconnect()
						end
						if v_u_169 then
							v_u_169:Disconnect()
						end
					else
						v_u_141:Destroy()
					end
				end
			}
		end
		warn("Cannot call Smartbone.Start() multiple times")
	else
		warn("Smartbone.Start() can only be called in client context.")
	end
end
return v_u_20

function v_u_1.Init(p3, p_u_4) -- name: Init
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	if p3 == nil then

	end
	if p_u_4 == nil then
		p_u_4 = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat
	end
	v_u_2.parentInstance = p3
	local v5 = v_u_2._started == false
	assert(v5, "Iris.Init can only be called once.")
	v_u_2._started = true
	v_u_2._generateRootInstance()
	v_u_2._generateSelectionImageObject()

		-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_4, (ref) v_u_2
		local v6 = p_u_4
		if typeof(v6) == "function" then

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2

	end)

end
function v_u_1.Connect(_, p7) -- name: Connect
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_2._started == false then

end

end
function v_u_1.End() -- name: End
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_2._stackIndex == 1 then
		error("Callback has too many calls to Iris.End()", 2)
	end
	v_u_2._IDStack[v_u_2._stackIndex] = nil
	local v12 = v_u_2
	v12._stackIndex = v12._stackIndex - 1
end

			end

			p78.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local function v_u_9(p5, p6, p7) -- name: getValueByIndex
		if typeof(p5) == "number" then
			return p5
		end
		if typeof(p5) == "Vector2" then
			if p6 == 1 then
				return p5.X
			end
			if p6 == 2 then
				return p5.Y
			end
		elseif typeof(p5) == "Vector3" then
			if p6 == 1 then
				return p5.X
			end
			if p6 == 2 then
				return p5.Y
			end
			if p6 == 3 then
				return p5.Z
			end
		elseif typeof(p5) == "UDim" then
			if p6 == 1 then
				return p5.Scale
			end
			if p6 == 2 then
				return p5.Offset
			end
		elseif typeof(p5) == "UDim2" then
			if p6 == 1 then
				return p5.X.Scale
			end
			if p6 == 2 then
				return p5.X.Offset
			end
			if p6 == 3 then
				return p5.Y.Scale
			end
			if p6 == 4 then
				return p5.Y.Offset
			end
		elseif typeof(p5) == "Color3" then
			local v8 = p7.UseHSV and { p5:ToHSV() } or { p5.R, p5.G, p5.B }
			if p6 == 1 then
				return v8[1]
			end
			if p6 == 2 then
				return v8[2]
			end
			if p6 == 3 then
				return v8[3]
			end
		elseif typeof(p5) == "Rect" then
			if p6 == 1 then
				return p5.Min.X
			end
			if p6 == 2 then
				return p5.Min.Y
			end
			if p6 == 3 then
				return p5.Max.X
			end
			if p6 == 4 then
				return p5.Max.Y
			end
		elseif typeof(p5) == "table" then
			return p5[p6]
		end
		error((("Incorrect datatype or value: %* %* %*"):format(p5, typeof(p5), p6)))
	end
	local function v_u_23(p10, p11, p12, p13) -- name: updateValueByIndex
		if typeof(p10) == "number" then
			return p12
		end
		if typeof(p10) == "Vector2" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return Vector2.new(p12, p10.Y)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return Vector2.new(p10.X, p12)
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "Vector3" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				local v14 = p10.Y
				local v15 = p10.Z
				return Vector3.new(p12, v14, v15)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				local v16 = p10.X
				local v17 = p10.Z
				return Vector3.new(v16, p12, v17)
			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				local v18 = p10.X
				local v19 = p10.Y
				return Vector3.new(v18, v19, p12)
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "UDim" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return UDim.new(p12, p10.Offset)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return UDim.new(p10.Scale, p12)
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "UDim2" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return UDim2.new(UDim.new(p12, p10.X.Offset), p10.Y)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return UDim2.new(UDim.new(p10.X.Scale, p12), p10.Y)
			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				return UDim2.new(p10.X, UDim.new(p12, p10.Y.Offset))
			end
			if p11 == 4 then
				return UDim2.new(p10.X, UDim.new(p10.Y.Scale, p12))
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "Rect" then
			if p11 == 1 then
				return Rect.new(Vector2.new(p12, p10.Min.Y), p10.Max)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return Rect.new(Vector2.new(p10.Min.X, p12), p10.Max)
			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				return Rect.new(p10.Min, Vector2.new(p12, p10.Max.Y))
			end
			if p11 == 4 then
				return Rect.new(p10.Min, Vector2.new(p10.Max.X, p12))
			end
		elseif typeof(p10) == "Color3" then
			if p13.UseHSV then
				local v20, v21, v22 = p10:ToHSV()
				if p11 == 1 then
					return Color3.fromHSV(p12, v21, v22)
				end
				if p11 == 2 then
					return Color3.fromHSV(v20, p12, v22)
				end
				if p11 == 3 then
					return Color3.fromHSV(v20, v21, p12)
				end
			end
			if p11 == 1 then
				return Color3.new(p12, p10.G, p10.B)
			end
			if p11 == 2 then
				return Color3.new(p10.R, p12, p10.B)
			end
			if p11 == 3 then
				return Color3.new(p10.R, p10.G, p12)
			end
		end
		error((("Incorrect datatype or value %* %* %*"):format(p10, typeof(p10), p11)))
	end

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2

				local v4, v5 = pcall(v3)

				if v_u_2._stackIndex ~= 1 then
					v_u_2._stackIndex = 1
					error("Callback has too few calls to Iris.End()", 0)
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield(true)
		end
	end)

		return p7.value

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2

		end

			v_u_2._widgets[v10.type].UpdateState(v10)

		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
		if p_u_1.Disabled then
			return
		else
			v_u_2._rootWidget.lastCycleTick = v_u_2._cycleTick
			if v_u_2._rootInstance == nil or v_u_2._rootInstance.Parent == nil then
				p_u_1.ForceRefresh()
			end
			for _, v15 in v_u_2._lastVDOM do
				if v15.lastCycleTick ~= v_u_2._cycleTick then
					v_u_2._DiscardWidget(v15)

			v_u_2._VDOM = v_u_2._generateEmptyVDOM()

			end

			v18._cycleTick = v18._cycleTick + 1

				local v20 = v_u_2.parentInstance.AbsoluteSize.Y

		end
	end

	function v_u_2._deepCompare(p102, p103) -- name: _deepCompare

	end

local v1 = script.Parent
local v_u_2 = require(v1:WaitForChild("Config"))
local v_u_3 = require(v1:WaitForChild("Utilities"))
local v_u_51 = {
	["GetCFrames"] = function(p4, p5) -- name: GetCFrames
		local v6 = p4.CFrame
		local v7 = v6.Position
		local v8 = v6.RightVector
		local v9 = v6.UpVector
		local v10 = p5 * 0.5
		local v11 = (p4.FieldOfView + 5) * 0.5 * 0.017453
		local v12 = math.tan(v11) * p5
		local v13 = v12 * (p4.ViewportSize.X / p4.ViewportSize.Y)
		local v14 = v6 * CFrame.new(0, 0, -p5)
		local v15 = v14 * Vector3.new(v13, v12, 0)
		local v16 = -v13
		local v17 = -v12
		local v18 = v14 * Vector3.new(v16, v17, 0)
		local v19 = -v12
		local v20 = v14 * Vector3.new(v13, v19, 0)
		return (v6 * CFrame.new(0, 0, -v10)):Inverse(), v13, v12, v10, v9:Cross(v20 - v7).Unit, v9:Cross(v18 - v7).Unit, v8:Cross(v7 - v15).Unit, v8:Cross(v7 - v20).Unit, v6
	end,
	["InViewFrustum"] = function(p21, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28, p29, p30) -- name: InViewFrustum
		local v31 = p30.Position
		local v32 = p22 * p21
		if p23 < v32.X or (v32.X < -p23 or (p24 < v32.Y or (v32.Y < -p24 or (p25 < v32.Z or v32.Z < -p25)))) then
			return false
		end
		local v33 = p21 - v31
		return p26:Dot(v33) >= 0 and (p27:Dot(v33) <= 0 and (p28:Dot(v33) >= 0 and p29:Dot(v33) <= 0))
	end,
	["ObjectInFrustum"] = function(p34, p35, p36, p37, p38, p39, p40, p41, p42, p43) -- name: ObjectInFrustum
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_51
		local v44 = p34.CFrame
		local v45 = p34.Size
		local v46 = v_u_2.FAR_PLANE * 0.5
		local v47 = p43.Position + p43.LookVector * v46
		local v48 = v_u_3.ClosestPointOnLine(v47, p43.LookVector, v46, v44.Position)
		local v49, v50 = v_u_3.ClosestPointInBox(v44, v45, v48)
		return v49 and true or (v_u_51.InViewFrustum(v50, p35, p36, p37, p38, p39, p40, p41, p42, p43) and true or false)
	end
}
return v_u_51

		local v19 = (1 / 0)

			v15 = math.max(v15, v22)

			local v31 = (v29.y - v19) / (v16 - v19) * 1 + -0.5

function v_u_1.Draw(p9, p10, p11, p_u_12) -- name: Draw
	local v_u_13 = p9.Ceive
	if v_u_13.Enabled then
		local v_u_14 = p10.Position
		local v15 = p10.UpVector
		local v16 = p10.RightVector
		local v17 = p10.LookVector
		local v18 = p11 * 0.5
		local v19 = v15 * v18.Y
		local v20 = v16 * v18.X
		local v21 = v17 * v18.Z
		local v_u_22 = nil
		local v_u_23 = nil
		local v_u_24 = nil
		local v_u_25 = nil
		local function v33(p26, p27, p28) -- name: CalculateZFace
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) p_u_12
			local v29 = v_u_14 + (p26 - p27 + p28)
			local v30 = v_u_14 + (p26 + p27 + p28)
			local v31 = v_u_14 + (-p26 - p27 + p28)

			v_u_24 = v29
			v_u_25 = v30

			v_u_13.Ray:Draw(v30, v32)

			end
			v_u_13.Ray:Draw(v31, v32)

		(function(p34, p35, p36) -- name: CalculateYFace
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) p_u_12

function v_u_3.Render(p42) -- name: Render

		p42:m_Pool()
		p42:m_Cleanup()

	else

local function v_u_92(p27, p_u_28, p29) -- name: SolveWind
	local v30 = p_u_28.Settings
	local v31 = v30.WindType
	if v31 ~= "Sine" and (v31 ~= "Noise" and v31 ~= "Hybrid") then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v32 = p_u_28.WindOffset + (os.clock() - p27.HeirarchyLength * 0.2 + (p27.TransformOffset.Position - p_u_28.Root.WorldPosition).Magnitude * 0.2) * v30.WindInfluence
	local v33 = v30.WindSpeed
	local v_u_34 = v30.WindStrength
	if v33 <= 1e-6 or v_u_34 <= 1e-6 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v_u_35 = v30.WindDirection
	local v36 = p29.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or p29.Unit
	local v37 = v36:Dot(v_u_35)
	local v38 = 1 - math.abs(v37)
	if v33 > 0 then
		if v36:Dot(v_u_35) > 0 then
			local v39 = 1 - p29.Magnitude / v33
			v38 = v38 * math.abs(v39)
		else
			v38 = v38 * (1 + p29.Magnitude / v33)
		end
	end
	local v40 = v33 * v38
	local v41 = p29.Magnitude < 100 and p29.Magnitude or 100
	local v42 = v41 == 0 and 0 or 2 ^ (v41 * 10 - 10)
	local v43 = math.min(v42, 100)
	local v_u_44 = v32 * math.max(v43, 1)
	local v_u_45
	if v40 < 1 then
		v_u_45 = v40 * v43
	else
		local v46 = v43 / 2
		v_u_45 = v40 * (v46 > 1 and v46 and v46 or 1)
	end
	local v47 = nil
	local function v63() -- name: SampleSin
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_45, (ref) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_35
		local v48 = v_u_34 ^ 0.8
		local v49 = v_u_45 * 2
		local v50 = v_u_44 * v48
		local v51 = math.sin(v50)
		local v52 = v_u_44 / 10 * v48
		local v53 = math.cos(v52)
		local v54 = v_u_44 * 2 * v48
		local v55 = math.sin(v54)
		local v56 = v_u_44 * 3 * v48
		local v57 = math.cos(v56)
		local v58 = (v51 + v53 + v55 + v57) / 4
		local v59 = v58 * 0.5 + 0.5
		local v60 = v58 * v49
		local v61 = v59 * v49
		local v62 = v_u_35
		if v60 < v61 then
			v60 = v61 or v60
		end
		return v62 * v60
	end
	local function v79(p64, p65) -- name: SampleNoise
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_45, (copy) p_u_28, (copy) v_u_35
		local v66 = p64 or 0
		local v67 = v_u_34 ^ 0.8
		local v68 = v_u_45 * 2
		local v69 = p_u_28.WindOffset
		local v70 = math.noise(v67, 0, v69)
		local v71 = math.clamp(v70, -1, 1)
		if p65 then
			v71 = v71 ^ 2
		end
		local v72 = v71 * (v68 + v66)
		local v73 = math.noise(0, v67, v69)
		local v74 = math.clamp(v73, -1, 1)
		if p65 then
			v74 = v74 ^ 2
		end
		local v75 = v74 * (v68 + v66)
		local v76 = math.noise(v69, 0, v67)
		local v77 = math.clamp(v76, -1, 1)
		if p65 then
			v77 = v77 ^ 2
		end
		local v78 = v77 * (v68 + v66)
		return v_u_35 * Vector3.new(v72, v75, v78)
	end
	if v30.WindType == "Sine" then
		local v80 = v63()
		local v81 = v_u_44 * 1
		v47 = v80 * (math.sin(v81) * 0.3 + 0.7)
	elseif v30.WindType == "Noise" then
		local v82 = v79(0, true)
		local v83 = v_u_44 * 1
		v47 = v82 * (math.sin(v83) * 0.3 + 0.7)
	elseif v30.WindType == "Hybrid" then
		local v84 = v63()
		local v85 = v_u_44 * 1
		local v86 = v84 * (math.sin(v85) * 0.3 + 0.7)
		local v87 = v79(0.5, true)
		local v88 = v_u_44 * 1
		v47 = (v86 + v87 * (math.sin(v88) * 0.3 + 0.7)) * 0.5
	end
	local v89 = v47 / (p27.FreeLength < 0.01 and 0.01 or p27.FreeLength)
	local v90 = v30.WindInfluence * (v_u_34 * 0.01)
	local v91 = p27.HeirarchyLength
	return v89 * (v90 * (math.clamp(v91, 1, 10) * 0.1)) * p27.Weight
end

		end
		v114 = v115.AnimatedWorldCFrame * v113.TransformedCFrame
	end
	p108.AnimatedWorldCFrame = v114
	local v116 = p108.Bone:FindFirstChild("SmartWeld")
	p108.ActiveWeld = false
	if v116 and v116:IsA("ObjectValue") then
		local v117 = v116.Value
		p108.RigidWeld = v116:GetAttribute("Rigid") == true
		if v117 then
			if v117:IsA("Attachment") then
				p108.WeldPosition = v117.WorldPosition
				p108.WeldCFrame = v117.WorldCFrame

				p108.WeldPosition = v117.Position
				p108.WeldCFrame = v117.CFrame
				p108.ActiveWeld = true
			end
		end
	end
	if p108.ParentIndex < 1 then
		p108.Anchored = true
	end
	if p108.Bone == p108.RootBone then
		local v118
		if p108.Bone.Parent:IsA("Bone") then
			v118 = v_u_20(p108.Bone.Parent)
		else
			v118 = p108.RootPart.CFrame
		end
		p108.TransformOffset = v118 * p108.Transform
	else
		p108.TransformOffset = v111.AnimatedWorldCFrame * p108.Transform
	end

function v_u_93.StepPhysics(p119, p120, p121, p122) -- name: StepPhysics
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_92
	if p119.Anchored then
		p119.LastPosition = p119.AnimatedWorldCFrame.Position
		p119.Position = p119.AnimatedWorldCFrame.Position
	else
		if p119.Force or p119.Gravity then
			p121 = (p119.Gravity or p120.Settings.Gravity) + (p119.Force or p120.Settings.Force)
		end
		local v123 = p120.Settings
		local v124 = (p119.Position - p119.LastPosition) / p122
		if v124.Magnitude > 50 then
			v124 = v124.Unit * 50 or v124
		end
		local v125 = p120.ObjectAcceleration * v123.Inertia
		local v126 = v_u_92(p119, p120, v124)
		local v127 = p121 + v125
		p119.LastPosition = p119.Position
		p119.Position = p119.Position + (v124 * (1 - v123.Damping) * p122 + v127 * p122 * p122 + v126)
	end
end
function v_u_93.Constrain(p128, p129, p130, p131) -- name: Constrain
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_11
	if not p128.Anchored then
		local v132 = p128.Position
		local v133 = p128.RootPart.CFrame
		local v134 = v_u_9(p128, v132, p128.LastPosition)
		if #p130 ~= 0 then
			v134 = v_u_7(p128, v134, p130)
		end
		local v135
		if p129.Settings.Constraint == "Spring" then
			v135 = v_u_12(p128, v134, nil, p129, p131)
		elseif p129.Settings.Constraint == "Distance" then
			v135 = v_u_8(p128, v134, p129)
		elseif p129.Settings.Constraint == "Rope" then
			v135 = v_u_10(p128, v134, p129)
		else
			v135 = p128.AnimatedWorldCFrame.Position
		end
		local v136 = v_u_11(p128, v_u_6(p128, v135, p128.LastPosition, v133), p129)
		if p128.ActiveWeld then
			if p128.RigidWeld then
				v136 = p128.WeldPosition
			else
				v136 = v_u_12(p128, v136, p128.WeldPosition, p129, p131)
			end
		end
		p128.Friction = 0
		for _, v137 in p128.CollisionHits do
			local v138 = p128.RootPart.CurrentPhysicalProperties
			local v139 = v137.CurrentPhysicalProperties
			local v140 = v138.Friction
			local v141 = v138.FrictionWeight
			local v142 = v139.Friction
			local v143 = v139.FrictionWeight
			local v144 = (v140 * v141 + v142 * v143) / (v141 + v143)
			if v144 < p128.Friction then
				v144 = p128.Friction or v144
			end
			p128.Friction = v144
		end
		p128.Position = v136
	end
end

function v_u_93.SolveTransform(p146, p147, p148) -- name: SolveTransform
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_13
	if p146.ParentIndex >= 1 then
		p146.IsSkippingUpdates = false
		local v149 = p147.Bones[p146.ParentIndex]
		local v150 = v149.Bone
		if v149 and v150 then
			local v151 = v149.TransformOffset
			local v152 = p146.Position - v149.Position
			local v153 = v_u_4.GetRotationBetween(v151.UpVector, v152).Rotation * v151.Rotation
			local v154 = 1 - 0.00001 ^ p148
			local v155 = math.min(v154, 1)
			if v149.ActiveWeld and v149.RigidWeld then
				v149.CalculatedWorldCFrame = v149.WeldCFrame
			else
				v149.CalculatedWorldCFrame = v150.WorldCFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(v149.Position) * v153, v155)
			end
			local v156 = v_u_13
			local v157 = v149.CalculatedWorldCFrame.Position
			v156(v157 == v157, warn, "If you see this report this as a bug, (NaN Calc world cframe)")
		end
	end
end
function v_u_93.ApplyTransform(p158, p159) -- name: ApplyTransform
	p158.SolvedAnimatedCFrame = false
	if p158.ParentIndex >= 1 then

			if v160.Anchored and not p159.Settings.AnchorsRotate then
				v161.WorldCFrame = v160.TransformOffset

function v_u_3.GetCollisions(p28, p29, p30) -- name: GetCollisions
	if not p28.m_Object then
		return {}
	end
	if #p28.Colliders == 0 then
		return {}
	end
	if os.clock() - p28.m_LastSleepCycle >= 0.2 then
		p28.m_LastSleepCycle = os.clock()
		if p28.m_Object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			p28.m_Awake = true
		else
			p28.m_Awake = false
		end
	end
	if not p28.m_Awake then
		return {}
	end
	local v31 = {}
	for _, v32 in p28.Colliders do
		local v33, v34, v35 = v32:GetClosestPoint(p29, p30)
		if v33 then
			table.insert(v31, {
				["ClosestPoint"] = v34,
				["Normal"] = v35

end

local function v_u_35(p1, p2, p3) -- name: ClosestPointFunc
	local v4 = p1:pointToObjectSpace(p3)
	local v5 = p2.x
	local v6 = p2.y
	local v7 = p2.z
	local v8 = v4.x
	local v9 = v4.y
	local v10 = v4.z
	local v11 = -v5 * 0.5
	local v12 = v5 * 0.5
	local v13 = math.clamp(v8, v11, v12)
	local v14 = -v6 * 0.5
	local v15 = v6 * 0.5
	local v16 = math.clamp(v9, v14, v15)
	local v17 = -v7 * 0.5
	local v18 = v7 * 0.5
	local v19 = math.clamp(v10, v17, v18)
	if v13 == v8 and (v16 == v9 and v19 == v10) then
		local v20 = v8 - v5 * 0.5
		local v21 = v9 - v6 * 0.5
		local v22 = v10 - v7 * 0.5
		local v23 = -v8 - v5 * 0.5
		local v24 = -v9 - v6 * 0.5
		local v25 = -v10 - v7 * 0.5
		local v26 = math.max(v20, v21, v22, v23, v24, v25)
		if v26 == v20 then
			local v27 = v5 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v27, v9, v10), p1.XVector
		elseif v26 == v21 then
			local v28 = v6 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v28, v10), p1.YVector
		elseif v26 == v22 then
			local v29 = v7 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v9, v29), p1.ZVector
		elseif v26 == v23 then
			local v30 = -v5 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v30, v9, v10), -p1.XVector
		elseif v26 == v24 then
			local v31 = -v6 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v31, v10), -p1.YVector
		elseif v26 == v25 then
			local v32 = -v7 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v9, v32), -p1.ZVector
		else
			warn("CLOSEST POINT ON BOX FAIL")
			return false, p1.Position, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end
	else
		local v33 = p1 * Vector3.new(v13, v16, v19)
		local v34 = p3 - v33
		return false, v33, v34.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v34.Unit
	end
end
return function(p36, p37, p38, p39)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35
	local v40, v41, v42 = v_u_35(p36, p37, p38)
	if v40 then
		return v40, v41, v42
	else
		return (v41 - p38).Magnitude < p39, v41, v42
	end
end

return function(p1, p2, p3, p4)

	local v6 = p2.X
	local v7 = p1 * CFrame.Angles(1.5707963267948966, -1.5707963267948966, 0)

	local v9 = v7.UpVector
	local v10 = v6 * 0.5
	local v11 = (p3 - v8):Dot(v9)
	local v12 = -v10
	local v13 = v8 + v9 * math.clamp(v11, v12, v10)
	local v14 = (v13 - p3).Magnitude
	local v15 = p3 - v13
	local v16 = v15.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v15.Unit
	local v17 = v14 <= v5

		return (v18 - p3).Magnitude < p4, v18, v16
	end

local function v_u_39(p1, p2, p3) -- name: ClosestPointFunc
	local v4 = (p2.Y < p2.Z and p2.Y or p2.Z) * 0.5
	local v5 = p2.X * 0.5
	local v6 = p1.Position
	local v7 = p1.RightVector
	local v8 = (p3 - v6):Dot(v7)
	local v9 = -v5
	local v10 = math.clamp(v8, v9, v5)
	local v11 = v6 + v7 * v10
	local v12 = p1.Position + -p1.RightVector * v5
	local v13 = p1.Position + p1.RightVector * v5
	local v14 = -p1.RightVector
	local v15 = p1.RightVector
	local v16 = p3 - (p3 - v12):Dot(v14) * v14
	local v17 = p3 - (p3 - v13):Dot(v15) * v15
	local v18 = v16 - v12
	local v19 = v18.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v18.Unit
	local v20 = (v16 - v12).Magnitude
	local v21
	if v20 < v4 then
		v21 = v20 or v4
	else
		v21 = v4
	end
	local v22 = v12 + v19 * v21
	local v23 = v17 - v13
	local v24 = v23.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v23.Unit
	local v25 = (v17 - v13).Magnitude
	local v26
	if v25 < v4 then
		v26 = v25 or v4
	else
		v26 = v4
	end
	local v27 = v13 + v24 * v26
	local v28 = (v11 - p3).Magnitude
	local v29 = p3 - v11
	local v30 = v29.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v29.Unit
	local v31 = v28 <= v4
	local v32 = v11 + v30 * v4
	local v33 = (v27 - p3).Magnitude
	local v34 = (v22 - p3).Magnitude
	local v35 = (v32 - p3).Magnitude
	local v36 = math.min(v33, v34, v35)
	if v10 == v5 or v36 == v33 then
		local v37 = p3 - v27
		return (v37.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v37.Unit):Dot(v15) < 0, v27, v15
	end
	if v10 ~= -v5 and v36 ~= v34 then
		return v31, v32, v30
	end
	local v38 = p3 - v22
	return (v38.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v38.Unit):Dot(v14) < 0, v22, v14
end
return function(p40, p41, p42, p43)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_39
	local v44, v45, v46 = v_u_39(p40, p41, p42)
	if v44 then
		return v44, v45, v46
	else
		return (v45 - p42).Magnitude < p43, v45, v46
	end
end

    [========== SCRIPT: Triangle ==========]
local v_u_1 = Vector3.new().Dot
local v_u_2 = Vector3.new().Cross
local v_u_3 = math.clamp
return function(p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: ClosestPointOnTri
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v8 = p5 - p4
	local v9 = p4 + v_u_3(v_u_1(p7 - p4, v8) / v_u_1(v8, v8), 0, 1) * v8
	local v10 = p6 - p5
	local v11 = p5 + v_u_3(v_u_1(p7 - p5, v10) / v_u_1(v10, v10), 0, 1) * v10
	local v12 = p4 - p6
	local v13 = p6 + v_u_3(v_u_1(p7 - p6, v12) / v_u_1(v12, v12), 0, 1) * v12
	local v14 = v_u_2(p5 - p4, p6 - p4)
	local v15 = v14.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v14.Unit
	local v16 = p7 - (p7 - (p4 + p5 + p6) * 0.3333):Dot(v15) * v15
	local v17
	if v_u_1(v_u_2(p6 - p5, p7 - p5), (v_u_2(p6 - p5, p4 - p5))) >= 0 and v_u_1(v_u_2(p6 - p4, p7 - p4), (v_u_2(p6 - p4, p5 - p4))) >= 0 then
		v17 = v_u_1(v_u_2(p5 - p4, p7 - p4), (v_u_2(p5 - p4, p6 - p4))) >= 0
	else
		v17 = false
	end
	if v17 then
		return v16, v15
	else
		local v18 = (v9 - p7).Magnitude
		local v19 = (v11 - p7).Magnitude
		local v20 = (v13 - p7).Magnitude
		local v21 = math.min(v18, v19, v20)
		if v21 == v18 then
			return v9, v15
		elseif v21 == v19 then
			return v11, v15
		elseif v21 == v20 then
			return v13, v15
		else
			return p7, v15
		end
	end
end

return function(p1, p2, p3, p4)
	local v5 = p4:Inverse() * p2
	local v6 = v5.X
	local v7 = v5.Y
	local v8 = v5.Z
	local v9 = p1.XAxisLimits
	local v10 = p1.YAxisLimits
	local v11 = p1.ZAxisLimits
	local v12 = p1.AxisLocked[1] and 0 or 1
	local v13 = p1.AxisLocked[2] and 0 or 1
	local v14 = p1.AxisLocked[3] and 0 or 1
	if v9.Min == (-1 / 0) and (v9.Max == (1 / 0) and (v10.Min == (-1 / 0) and (v10.Max == (1 / 0) and (v11.Min == (-1 / 0) and v11.Max == (1 / 0))))) then
		if v12 == 1 and (v13 == 1 and v14 == 1) then
			return p2
		end
		local v15 = v6 * v12
		local v16 = v7 * v13
		local v17 = v8 * v14
		return p4 * Vector3.new(v15, v16, v17)
	end
	local v18 = v9.Min + p1.Radius
	local v19
	if v18 <= v9.Max - p1.Radius then
		v19 = v9.Max - p1.Radius or v18
	else
		v19 = v18
	end
	local v20 = v10.Min + p1.Radius
	local v21
	if v20 <= v10.Max - p1.Radius then
		v21 = v10.Max - p1.Radius or v20
	else
		v21 = v20
	end
	local v22 = v11.Min + p1.Radius
	local v23
	if v22 <= v11.Max - p1.Radius then
		v23 = v11.Max - p1.Radius or v22
	else
		v23 = v22
	end
	if v6 < v18 and v18 then
		v6 = v18
	elseif v19 < v6 then
		v6 = v19 or v6
	end
	if v7 < v20 and v20 then
		v7 = v20
	elseif v21 < v7 then
		v7 = v21 or v7
	end
	if v8 < v22 and v22 then
		v8 = v22
	elseif v23 < v8 then
		v8 = v23 or v8
	end
	local v24 = v6 * v12
	local v25 = v7 * v13
	local v26 = v8 * v14
	local v27 = p4 * Vector3.new(v24, v25, v26)
	local v28 = p4.RightVector
	local v29 = p4.UpVector
	local v30 = p4.LookVector
	local v31 = v27 - p3
	local v32 = v31.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v31.Unit
	if v24 ~= v5.X then
		if v28:Dot(v32) < 0 then
			v28 = -v28 or v28
		end
		p1:ClipVelocity(v27, v28)
	end
	if v25 ~= v5.Y then
		if v29:Dot(v32) < 0 then
			v29 = -v29 or v29
		end
		p1:ClipVelocity(v27, v29)
	end
	if v26 ~= v5.Z then
		if v30:Dot(v32) > 0 then
			v30 = -v30 or v30
		end
		p1:ClipVelocity(v27, v30)
	end
	return v27
end

ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SmartBone.Components.Constraints.RotationConstraint
    [========== SCRIPT: RotationConstraint ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3)
	local v4 = p1.ParentIndex
	local v5 = p3.Bones[v4]
	if not v5 then
		return p2
	end
	local v6 = v5.RotationLimit
	if v6 >= 180 then
		return p2
	end
	local v7 = p3.Bones[v5.ParentIndex]
	if not v7 then
		return p2
	end
	local v8 = v5.Position
	local v9 = v5.Position - v7.Position
	local v10 = v9.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v9.Unit
	local v11 = (p2 - v8).Magnitude
	local v12 = p2 - v8
	local v13 = v12.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v12.Unit
	if v6 <= 0 then
		return v8 + v10 * v11
	end
	local v14 = p1.RotationLimit
	local v15 = math.rad(v14)
	local v16 = v10:Dot(v13)
	if v15 <= math.acos(v16) then
		local v17 = v10:Cross(v13)
		local v18 = v17.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v17.Unit
		v13 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v18, v15) * v10
	end
	if v13 == v13 then
		v10 = v13
	end
	return v8 + v10 * v11
end

ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SmartBone.Components.Constraints.SpringConstraint
    [========== SCRIPT: SpringConstraint ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5)
	local v6 = p4.Settings
	local v7 = v6.Stiffness
	local v8 = v6.Elasticity
	local v9 = p4.Bones[p1.ParentIndex]
	if v9 then
		local v10 = p1.FreeLength
		if v7 > 0 or v8 > 0 then
			local v11 = p3 or (CFrame.new(v9.Position) * v9.TransformOffset.Rotation * CFrame.new(p1.LocalTransformOffset.Position)).Position
			p2 = p2 + (v11 - p2) * (v8 * p5)
			if v7 > 0 then
				local v12 = v11 - p2
				local v13 = v12.Magnitude
				local v14 = v10 * (1 - v7) * 2
				if v14 < v13 then
					p2 = p2 + v12 * ((v13 - v14) / v13)
				end
			end
		end
		local v15 = v9.Position - p2
		local v16 = v15.Magnitude
		if v16 > 0 then
			p2 = p2 + v15 * ((v16 - v10) / v16)
		end
	end
	return p2
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone

		local v_u_141 = false

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

function v_u_4._preventMultiFrameUpdates(p_u_29, p_u_30, ...) -- name: _preventMultiFrameUpdates
	p_u_29._preventMultiDetails = p_u_29._preventMultiDetails or {}

		v_u_31 = {

	end
	v_u_31.callsThisFrame = v_u_31.callsThisFrame + 1
	if v_u_31.callsThisFrame ~= 1 then
		return true
	end
	local v_u_32 = table.pack(...)
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_31, (copy) p_u_29, (copy) p_u_30, (copy) v_u_32

			p_u_29[p_u_30](p_u_29, unpack(v34))
		end
	end)
	return false
end
function v_u_4.update(p_u_35) -- name: update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_3
	if not p_u_35:_preventMultiFrameUpdates("update") then
		p_u_35.totalVolume = 0
		p_u_35.parts = {}
		p_u_35.partToItem = {}

							end

					end
				end
				v_u_40:add(v_u_36.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_40, (copy) p_u_35
					if not v_u_36:IsDescendantOf(game) and (v_u_36.Parent == nil and v_u_40 ~= nil) then
						v_u_40:destroy()
						v_u_40 = nil
						p_u_35:update()
					end
				end), "Disconnect")
				local v43 = p_u_35.items
				table.insert(v43, v_u_36)
			end
		end
		for v44, _ in pairs(p_u_35.baseParts) do
			local v45 = v44.Size

ReplicatedStorage.Templates.Misc.Nhang.LocalScript
    [========== SCRIPT: LocalScript ==========]
local v_u_1 = tick()
local v_u_2 = nil
script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_2
	if tick() - v_u_1 >= 1 then
		v_u_1 = tick()
		v_u_2 = script.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid"):LoadAnimation(script.Animation)
		v_u_2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
		v_u_2.Looped = false
		v_u_2:Play()
		v_u_2.Stopped:Wait()
		v_u_2:Destroy()
	end
end)

function v_u_6.angleBetweenCFrames(p11, p12) -- name: angleBetweenCFrames
	local v13 = p11.UpVector
	local v14 = p11 * CFrame.new(0, 0, 5)
	local v15 = (p11.Position - p12.Position).Unit
	local v16 = (p11.Position - v14.Position).Unit

		if not p122:waitOrDeletePart() then
			return
		end

end

function v_u_1.new(p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v8 = {
		["Parameters"] = p2 or RaycastParams.new(),
		["Penetration"] = p3 or 0,
		["AllowCanCollideFalse"] = p4 or false,
		["InvisiblePartsBlockRaycast"] = p5 or false,
		["MaxPenetrations"] = p6 or 1,
		["MinTransparencyToBeInvisible"] = p7 or 1
	}
	local v9 = v_u_1
	return setmetatable(v8, v9)
end
function v_u_1.Raycast(p10, p11, p12) -- name: Raycast
	local v13 = false
	local v14 = 0
	local v15 = 0
	local v16 = nil
	while true do
		if v13 then
			v17 = v16
			break
		end
		local v17 = workspace:Raycast(p11, p12, p10.Parameters)
		local v18
		if v17 then
			v18 = v17.Instance.Size * v17.Normal
		else
			v18 = v17
		end
		local v19
		if v17 then
			v19 = p12.Unit * (v17.Position - p11).Magnitude
		else
			v19 = v17
		end
		if v14 == 10000 or v17 == nil then
			v17 = v16
			break
		end
		local v20 = v17.Instance.Transparency + 1 * v17.Instance.localTransparencyModifier
		local v21 = not p10.InvisiblePartsBlockRaycast
		if v21 then
			v21 = p10.MinTransparencyToBeInvisible <= v20
		end
		local v22 = p10.AllowCanCollideFalse
		if v22 then
			v22 = v17.Instance.CanCollide == false
		end
		local v23 = v22 or v21
		local v24
		if v15 < p10.MaxPenetrations then
			v24 = v18.Magnitude <= p10.Penetration
		else
			v24 = false
		end
		if v23 then
			p11 = v17.Position - v17.Normal * 0.001
			p12 = p12 - v19
		else
			if not v24 then
				break
			end
			v15 = v15 + 1
			p11 = v17.Position - v17.Normal * v18.Magnitude * 0.999
			p12 = p12 - v19
		end
		v14 = v14 + 1
	end
	return v17, v15
end
return v_u_1

local v_u_5 = {
	["snapToScale"] = function(p1, p2) -- name: snapToScale
		local v3 = p1 / p2
		local v4 = math.round(v3) * p2
		return math.clamp(v4, 0, 1)
	end
}
function lerp(p6, p7, p8) -- name: lerp
	return (1 - p8) * p6 + p8 * p7
end
function v_u_5.map(p9, p10, p11, p12, p13, p14) -- name: map
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v15 = lerp(p12, p13, v_u_5.getAlphaBetween(p10, p11, p9))
	if not p14 then
		return v15
	end

		local v16 = p12
		p12 = p13
		p13 = v16
	end
	local v17 = math.min(v15, p13)
	return math.max(v17, p12)
end
function v_u_5.getNewPosition(p18) -- name: getNewPosition
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v19 = p18._data.Button.AbsoluteSize[p18._config.Axis]

	local v21 = p18._data.Button.AnchorPoint[p18._config.Axis]

	local v23 = v21 * v19 / v20 + v22
	local v24 = 2 * v19 * v21 - v19
	local v25 = 1 - v23 + v24 / v20
	local v26 = v_u_5.map(p18._data._percent, 0, 1, v23, v25, true)
	if p18._config.Axis == "X" then
		return UDim2.fromScale(v26, p18._data.Button.Position.Y.Scale)
	else
		return UDim2.fromScale(p18._data.Button.Position.X.Scale, v26)
	end
end
function v_u_5.getScaleIncrement(p27) -- name: getScaleIncrement
	return 1 / ((p27._config.SliderData.End - p27._config.SliderData.Start) / p27._config.SliderData.Increment)

	return (p30 - p28) / (p29 - p28)
end
function v_u_5.getNewValue(p31) -- name: getNewValue

				v40 = v40 + 1
				v41 = v42
			end
		else
			if v37 then
				for _, v44 in v_u_33.BottomTypes do
					if v42.AssetType == v44 then
						return true, v42
					end
				end
				goto l9
			end
			if v42.AssetType == p36 then
				goto l9
			end
		end
	end
	return v39 <= v40, v41
end

function v_u_79.LoadCurrentOutfit(p_u_122, p123, p_u_124) -- name: LoadCurrentOutfit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_17
	local v125 = p123 or p_u_122.AvatarObjects.Humanoid
	local v126, v127, v_u_128 = v_u_25.GetCurrentOutfit(p_u_122.EquippedItems:get(), v125)
	v126.BodyColors = v_u_25.GetCurrentBodyColors(v125:GetAppliedDescription())
	local v129 = {}
	for v130, v131 in pairs(v126) do
		if v130 ~= "BodyColors" then
			local v132 = v131.AssetId
			v129[tostring(v132)] = v131
		end
	end
	p_u_122.EquippedItems:set(v129)
	local v133 = #v126 > 0
	local v134 = #v127 > 0
	if table.find(v127, "BodyColors") then
		v134 = #v127 - 1 > 0
	end
	if p_u_122.Controllers and p_u_122.Controllers.BodyEditorController then
		p_u_122.Controllers.BodyEditorController:UpdateSliders(v_u_128)
	end
	if v_u_33.PersistentWear then
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_124, (copy) p_u_122, (copy) v_u_128, (ref) v_u_17
			if p_u_124 then
				p_u_122:ApplyOutfit(p_u_122.EquippedItems:get(), v_u_128)
			end
			p_u_122.AvatarObjects.Humanoid:ApplyDescription(v_u_128)
			local v135 = p_u_122.AvatarObjects.Humanoid.Parent
			if not (v135:FindFirstChild("Head") or v135:FindFirstChild("DynamicHead")) then
				v_u_17.pprint("Dynamic head was unable to load due to Roblox bug, reverting to default head")
				v_u_128.Head = 2432102561
				p_u_122.AvatarObjects.Humanoid:ApplyDescription(v_u_128)
			end
			p_u_122.OutfitLoaded:Fire()
		end)
	else
		p_u_122.OutfitLoaded:Fire()
	end
	return v133 or v134
end

function v_u_79.SaveChange(p161) -- name: SaveChange
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_10
	if p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce then
		return
	else
		p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce = true
		local v162 = p161.AvatarObjects.Humanoid
		local v163 = v_u_25.GetCurrentBodyColors(v162:GetAppliedDescription())
		local v164 = p161.EquippedItems:get()
		if p161:IsSavedOutfit(v164, v163) then
			p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce = false
		else
			if v_u_10:InvokeServer(v164, v163) then
				p161.SaveDisabled:set(true)
			else
				p161:UpdateSaveButton()
			end
			p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce = false
		end
	end
end

function v_u_79.GetLastEquippedAsset(p170, p171, p172) -- name: GetLastEquippedAsset
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v_u_173 = type(p171) ~= "table" and { p171 or -1 } or p171

function v_u_79.AddChange(p_u_180, p181, p182) -- name: AddChange

function v_u_79.ReverseChange(p198, p199) -- name: ReverseChange
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_31

			if p199 then
				v202 = v201.Old.Desc

function v_u_45.ResetFeed(p101, p102) -- name: ResetFeed
	local v103 = p101.FeedsById[p102]
	local v104 = v103.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v105 = p101.OutfitsCache
	for _, v106 in ipairs(v104) do
		local v107 = type(v106) == "string" and v106 and v106 or v106.guid
		if v105[v107] then
			v105[v107].Frame:Destroy()
			v105[v107].Frame = nil
			v105[v107] = nil
		end
	end
	v103.Page:set(0)
	v103.LastRefresh:set(tick())
	v103.LoadedOutfits:set({})
	v103.LoadedAll:set(false)
	v103.ScrollY:set(0)
end
function v_u_45.SwitchToFeed(p_u_108, p109, p110) -- name: SwitchToFeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
	p_u_108:CancelLoading()
	if p109 ~= "top" then
		p_u_108.TopDropdownOpen:set(false)
	end
	p_u_108.States.Loading:set(true)
	p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(true)
	local v_u_111 = p_u_108.FeedsById[p109]
	v_u_111.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v_u_111.LoadFailed:set(false)
	local v112 = v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:get() and true or p110
	if not v_u_111.Searchable then
		p_u_108.States.Query:set(v_u_44)
	end
	if v112 or tick() - v_u_111.LastRefresh:get() > 60 then
		v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:set(false)
		p_u_108:ResetFeed(p109)
	end
	local v_u_113 = p_u_108.GuiObjects.ScrollingFrame
	v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	p_u_108:ClearWindow()
	task.wait(0.1)
	local v114 = v112 and {} or v_u_111.LoadedOutfits:get()
	if #v114 > 0 then
		p_u_108:RenderOutfits(v114, 0, true):andThen(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_111
			v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, v_u_111.ScrollY:get() or 0)
		end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108
			p_u_108.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end)
	else
		p_u_108:LoadNextPage()
		v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_45.UpdateFilters(p115) -- name: UpdateFilters
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27
	local v116 = p115.States.Query:get().keywords
	if v116 then
		v116 = #v116 > 0
	end
	local v117 = v_u_27.deepCopy(p115.FilterTabs:get())
	for v118, v119 in pairs(v117) do
		if v116 then
			local v120 = v117[v118]
			local v121 = v119.Internal
			if not v121 then
				local v122 = v119.Searchable or v119.SearchOnly
				v121 = not v122
			end
			v120.Hidden = v121
		else
			v117[v118].Hidden = v119.Internal or v119.SearchOnly
		end
	end
	p115.FilterTabs:set(v117)
	p115:MarkAllForRefresh()
	local v_u_123 = p115.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v125 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p124)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
		return p124.Id == v_u_123
	end)
	if p115.Enabled and (not v125 or v125.Hidden) then
		local v127 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p126)
			return not p126.Hidden
		end)
		p115.States.CurrentFeedId:set(v127.Id)
		p115:SwitchToFeed(v127.Id, true)
	end
end
function v_u_45.LoadNextPage(p_u_128) -- name: LoadNextPage
	p_u_128.States.Loading:set(true)
	local v129 = p_u_128.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v130 = p_u_128.FeedsById[v129]
	v130.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v130.LoadFailed:set(false)
	v130.Page:set(v130.Page:get() + 1)
	local v131 = v130.Page:get()
	local v132 = v130.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v133, v134 = p_u_128:GetOutfitsFromFeedId(v130.Id, p_u_128.States.Query:get(), v131)
	if v133 then
		if #v134 > 0 then
			p_u_128:RenderOutfits(v134, #v132, v131 == 1):andThen(function() end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_128
				p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
				p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
			end)
			for _, v135 in v134 do
				table.insert(v132, v135)
			end
			v130.LoadedOutfits:set(v132)
		else
			v130.LoadedAll:set(true)
			p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end
	else
		p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
		p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		v130.LoadFailed:set(true)
		v130.SwitchFailed:set(v131 == 1)
		v130.Page:set(v131 - 1)
		v130.ErrorType:set(v134.status)
		return
	end
end

function v_u_45.GetServerOutfit(_, p142, p143) -- name: GetServerOutfit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_22
	local v144 = p143:GetAccessories(true)
	local v147 = v_u_27.concat(v_u_27.map(v144, function(p145)
		return p145.AssetId

		return {}

	local v155 = {

	local v157 = {
		["id"] = p143.Torso,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.Torso,
		["name"] = v148[p143.Torso].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.Torso].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v157)
	local v158 = {
		["id"] = p143.RightArm,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.RightArm,
		["name"] = v148[p143.RightArm].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.RightArm].Price

	table.insert(v151, v158)

	local v160 = {

		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.LeftArm,
		["name"] = v148[p143.LeftArm].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.LeftArm].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v160)
	local v161 = {
		["id"] = p143.LeftLeg,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.LeftLeg,
		["name"] = v148[p143.LeftLeg].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.LeftLeg].Price
	}

		["id"] = p143.Head,

function v_u_45.RenderOutfits(p_u_191, p_u_192, p193, p_u_194) -- name: RenderOutfits
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1
	local v_u_195 = p193 or 0
	local v228 = v_u_29.new(function(p196, p197)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_192, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_29, (copy) p_u_191, (ref) v_u_195, (copy) p_u_194
		local v_u_198 = {}
		for _, v199 in ipairs(p_u_192) do
			if type(v199) ~= "string" then
				local v200 = v_u_21.GetOutfitFromServerData(v199)
				for _, v201 in pairs(v200.Items) do
					if v201.AssetId > 0 and not v_u_23.ItemDetailsCache[v201.AssetId] then
						local v202 = v201.AssetId
						table.insert(v_u_198, v202)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, v_u_203 in ipairs(v_u_27.chunk(v_u_198, 100)) do
			v_u_27.pprint(string.format("Getting %s batch items", #v_u_203))
			local v204, v205 = v_u_27.callWithRetry(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_198, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_203
				return #v_u_198 <= 0 and {} or v_u_1:GetBatchItemDetails(v_u_203, 1)
			end, 2)
			v_u_27.pprint("done")
			if v205 then
				for _, v206 in pairs(v204) do
					v_u_23.ItemDetailsCache[v206.Id] = v206
				end
			end
		end
		local v207 = {}
		local v_u_208 = {}
		for _, v_u_209 in ipairs(p_u_192) do
			local v210 = v_u_29.new
			local function v217(p_u_211, _)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_209, (ref) p_u_191, (copy) v_u_208, (ref) v_u_27
				local v_u_212 = false
				v_u_29.try(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_209, (ref) p_u_191, (ref) v_u_208
					local v213 = nil
					local v214 = v_u_209
					if typeof(v214) == "string" then
						v213 = p_u_191:RenderOutfit(v_u_209)
					else
						local v215 = v_u_209
						if typeof(v215) == "table" then
							v213 = p_u_191:RenderOutfit(v_u_209.guid, v_u_209)
						end
					end
					if v213 then
						v_u_208[v_u_209.guid] = v213
						return v213
					end
				end):timeout(4):andThen(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_212, (copy) p_u_211
					if not v_u_212 then
						p_u_211()
					end
				end):catch(function(p216)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_212, (copy) p_u_211
					v_u_27.pprint("outfit load timed out", p216)
					v_u_212 = true
					p_u_211(nil)
				end)
			end
			table.insert(v207, v210(v217))
		end
		local v218, v219 = v_u_29.all(v207):await()
		if v218 then
			local v220 = {}
			local v221 = 0
			for v222, v223 in ipairs(p_u_192) do
				local v224 = nil
				if typeof(v223) == "string" then
					v224 = v_u_208[v223]
				elseif typeof(v223) == "table" then
					v224 = v_u_208[v223.guid]
				end
				if v224 then
					v224.LayoutOrder = v_u_195 + v222
					v224.Parent = p_u_191.GuiObjects.ItemFrame
					table.insert(v220, v224)
				else
					v221 = v221 + 1
				end
			end
			if v221 / #p_u_192 > 0.5 then
				for _, v225 in ipairs(v220) do
					v225:Destroy()
				end
				local v226 = p_u_191.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
				local v227 = p_u_191.FeedsById[v226]
				v227.LoadFailed:set(true)
				v227.ErrorType:set("avatar")
				v227.Page:set(v227.Page:get() - 1)
				if p_u_194 then

function v_u_27.LoadRobloxOutfits(p_u_116) -- name: LoadRobloxOutfits

		while not v119 do

			for _, v_u_121 in v118:GetCurrentPage() do
				if v_u_121.IsEditable then
					local v122 = v_u_14.new

						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_121, (ref) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_117, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) p_u_116
						local v124 = v_u_5:GetOutfitDetails(v_u_121.Id)
						local v125 = {
							["BodyColors"] = v124.BodyColors
						}

							v125[tostring(v127)] = v_u_12.deepCopy(v_u_7.GetItemDataTable(v126.Id))

						end

							["isRoblox"] = v_u_15(true),

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_116
				p_u_116.Controllers.AvatarPreviewController:UpdateSaveButton()
			end):catch(warn)

		end

	end
end

function v_u_26.SwitchToFeed(p_u_124, p125) -- name: SwitchToFeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
	local v126 = p_u_124.CurrentFeedId
	if v126:get() == p125 then
		return
	else
		v126:set(p125)
		p_u_124:CancelLoading()
		local v127 = p_u_124:GetFeed(p125)
		if tick() - p_u_124.LastRefresh > 60 then
			p_u_124:ClearAllFeedsCache()
		elseif v127.ShouldRefresh then
			p_u_124:ClearFeedCache(p125)
		end
		v_u_123(p_u_124.Guis.ShopListFrame)
		local v128 = v127.GetShops()
		if #v128 > 0 then
			local v129 = p_u_124.LoadingPromises

			table.insert(v129, v130:andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_124
				p_u_124.Loading:set(false)
			end))
		else
			p_u_124:LoadNextPage(v127)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_26.LoadFromCache(p_u_131, p_u_132, p_u_133) -- name: LoadFromCache

		local v135 = p_u_131.Guis.ShopListFrame
		if not p_u_133 then
			p_u_131.Loading:set(true)
		end
		for _, v136 in p_u_132 do
			v_u_11(p_u_131, v136).Parent = v135
		end
		p134()
	end)
end
function v_u_26.LoadNextPage(p_u_137, p138, p139) -- name: LoadNextPage
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
	if not p139 then
		p_u_137.Loading:set(true)
	end
	p138.Page = p138.Page + 1
	local v140 = p138.id
	local v141 = p138.Page
	local v142, v143 = p_u_137:GetShopsFromFeedId(v140, v141)
	if v142 then
		if #v143 > 0 then
			local v144 = p138.CacheShops(v143)
			local v145 = p_u_137.LoadingPromises
			local v146 = p_u_137:LoadFromCache(v144, p139)
			table.insert(v145, v146:andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_137
				p_u_137.Loading:set(false)
			end))
		else
			if v141 == 1 then
				v_u_123(p_u_137.Guis.ShopListFrame)
			end
			p138.LoadedAll = true
			p_u_137.Loading:set(false)
		end
	else
		print("Handle page load failed!")
		p138.Page = p138.Page - 1
		p_u_137.Loading:set(false)
		return
	end
end

	end
end

local function v_u_11() -- name: assertBadStreamingEnabledSetup
