function v_u_4.GiveAdNewColor(p13) -- name: GiveAdNewColor
	for _, v14 in pairs(script.Parent.Colors:GetChildren()) do
		if v14.Use.Value == false then
			v14.Use.Value = true
			p13:SetAttribute("AdColor", v14.Value)
			return p13:GetAttribute("AdColor")
		end
	end
	return nil
end
function v_u_4.RemoveAdColor(p15) -- name: RemoveAdColor
	if p15:GetAttribute("AdColor") then
		for _, v16 in pairs(script.Parent.Colors:GetChildren()) do
			if v16.Value == p15:GetAttribute("AdColor") then
				v16.Use.Value = false
				p15:SetAttribute("AdColor", Color3.new())
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_4.GetAdColor(p17) -- name: GetAdColor
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v18 = p17:GetAttribute("AdColor")

		v18 = v_u_4.GiveAdNewColor(p17)
	end

end

return {
	["GetDate"] = function(p1) -- name: GetDate
		local _ = os.time() - p1
		return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(p1):FormatUniversalTime("ll", "en-us")
	end,
	["GetTime"] = function(p2) -- name: GetTime
		local _ = os.time() - p2
		return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(p2):FormatUniversalTime("LT", "en-us")
	end,
	["Format"] = function(p3) -- name: Format
		local v4 = os.time() - p3
		if v4 >= 86400 then
			return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(p3):FormatUniversalTime("ll", "en-us")
		end
		if v4 >= 3600 then
			local v5 = v4 / 3600
			return math.floor(v5) .. "h"
		end
		if v4 < 60 then
			return "Now"
		end
		local v6 = v4 / 60
		return math.floor(v6) .. "m"
	end
}

function v_u_16.GetAdFromInput(p44, p45) -- name: GetAdFromInput
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_16
	local v46 = {
		["ad_format"] = nil,
		["ad_url"] = nil,
		["bloxbiz_ad_id"] = -2,
		["external_link_references"] = {},
		["gif_fps"] = p45,
		["gif_version"] = nil,
		["audio_url"] = nil,
		["show_ad_disclaimer"] = true,
		["ad_disclaimer_url"] = "rbxassetid://7122215099",
		["ad_disclaimer_scale_x"] = 0.117,
		["ad_disclaimer_scale_y"] = 0.08
	}
	if string.match(p44, ",") then
		local v47 = {}
		for v48 in string.gmatch(p44, "([^,]+)") do
			table.insert(v47, {
				["ad_url"] = nil,
				["frames_per_sheet"] = 8,
				["ad_url"] = v48
			})
		end
		v46.ad_format = "gif"
		v46.ad_url = v47
		v46.gif_version = 2
	elseif v_u_9.getAdUsingBloxbizAdId(p44) then
		local v49 = v_u_9.getAdUsingBloxbizAdId(p44)
		v46.ad_format = v49.ad_format
		v46.ad_url = v49.ad_url
		v46.bloxbiz_ad_id = v49.bloxbiz_ad_id
		v46.gif_version = v49.gif_version or 2
		v46.gif_fps = v49.gif_fps or p45
		v46.audio_url = v49.audio_url
		local v50 = v49.ad_format == "static"
		local v51 = v49.ad_format == "portal"
		if v51 then
			v46.destination_place_id = v49.destination_place_id
		end
		if v50 or v51 then
			v46.ad_url = { v49.ad_url }
		end
	elseif string.match(p44, "id") then
		if v_u_16.IsAudioAd then
			v46.ad_format = "audio"
			v46.audio_url = tostring(p44)
			v46.gif_version = nil
		else
			v46.ad_format = "static"
			v46.ad_url = { (tostring(p44)) }
			v46.gif_version = nil
		end
	end
	local v52 = v46.ad_url
	local v53 = v46.ad_format == "3d"
	if v52 or v46.ad_format == "audio" then
		return v46
	end
	if v53 then
		return v_u_9.getAdUsingBloxbizAdId(p44)
	end
end
function v_u_16.ProcessInput() -- name: ProcessInput
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_16
	local v54 = 10
	local v55 = v_u_10.PlayerGui.ScreenshotTool.Main
	local v56 = v55.Ad.TextBox.Text
	local v57 = v55.FPS.TextBox.Text
	local v58 = tonumber(v57)
	if v58 == nil then
		v58 = v54
	elseif v58 <= 0 then
		v58 = v54
	end
	local v59 = v_u_16.GetAdFromInput(v56, v58)
	local v60
	if v59 then
		v60 = v59.ad_format == "3d"
	else
		v60 = v59
	end
	local v61
	if v59 then
		v61 = v59.ad_format == "portal"
	else
		v61 = v59
	end
	local v62
	if v59 then
		v62 = v59.ad_format == "audio"
	else
		v62 = v59
	end
	if v61 then
		v_u_16.TargetPortalAd(v59)
	elseif v60 then
		v_u_16.Target3dAd(v59)
	elseif v62 then
		v_u_16.TargetAudioAd(v59)
	elseif v59 then
		v_u_16.TurnOffTargeting()
		v_u_16.TurnOnTargeting(v59)
	else
		v_u_16.TurnOffTargeting()
	end
	if v_u_16.DebugModeForceEnabled then
		v_u_16.TurnOffDebugMode()
	else
		v_u_16.TurnOnDebugMode()
	end
end

ReplicatedStorage.BloxbizSDK.Utils.Fusion.Animation.springCoefficients
    [========== SCRIPT: springCoefficients ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: springCoefficients
	if p1 == 0 or p3 == 0 then
		return 1, 0, 0, 1
	end
	if p2 > 1 then
		local v4 = p1 * p3
		local v5 = p2 ^ 2 - 1
		local v6 = math.sqrt(v5)
		local v7 = -0.5 / v6
		local v8 = -v6 - p2
		local v9 = 1 / v8
		local v10 = v4 * v8
		local v11 = math.exp(v10)
		local v12 = v4 * v9
		local v13 = math.exp(v12)
		return (v13 * v8 - v11 * v9) * v7, (v11 - v13) * v7 / p3, (v13 - v11) * v7 * p3, (v11 * v8 - v13 * v9) * v7
	end
	if p2 == 1 then
		local v14 = p1 * p3
		local v15 = -v14
		local v16 = math.exp(v15)
		return v16 * (v14 + 1), v16 * p1, v16 * (-v14 * p3), v16 * (1 - v14)
	end
	local v17 = p1 * p3
	local v18 = 1 - p2 ^ 2
	local v19 = math.sqrt(v18)
	local v20 = 1 / v19
	local v21 = v19 * v17
	local v22 = -v17 * p2
	local v23 = math.exp(v22)
	local v24 = v23 * math.sin(v21)
	local v25 = v23 * math.cos(v21)
	local v26 = v24 * v20
	local v27 = v26 * p2
	return v27 + v25, v26, -(v27 * p2 + v24 * v19), v25 - v27
end

			local v16 = v_u_3.DataType[v15] or "Invalid"
			v9.ClassName = v16
			v9[v16] = p8:sub(4, 4 + string.byte(p8:sub(3, 3)))
			v12 = v12 + 5
			v13 = "Val:Prop"
		end
		if v11 == "Root" then
			v9.ClassName = "Root"
			v9.Root = {}
			v12 = v12 - 1
			v13 = "Root:NewRoot"
		end
		while v12 < #p8 do
			v12 = v12 + 1
			string.byte(p8:sub(v12, v12))
			if v13 == "Root:NewRoot" and v12 + 3 < #p8 then
				local v17 = v12 + 1
				local v18 = string.byte(p8:sub(v17, v17))
				local v19 = p8:sub(v12 + 2, v12 + 1 + v18)
				local v20 = v12 + 2 + v18
				local v21 = string.byte(p8:sub(v20, v20))
				local v22 = p8:sub(v12 + 3 + v18, v12 + 3 + v18 + v21)
				local v23 = DecodeData(v22)
				local v24 = v9.Root
				table.insert(v24, { v19, v23 })
				v12 = v12 + (v18 + v21 + 1)
			end
			if v13 == "Ins:Prop" and v12 + 2 < #p8 then
				local v25 = p8:sub(v12, v12 + 1)
				local v26 = string.unpack("H", v25)
				local v27 = v_u_3.ValueType[v26] or "Invalid"
				local v28 = v12 + 1
				local v29 = v28 + 1
				local v30 = string.byte(p8:sub(v29, v29))
				local v31 = p8:sub(v28 + 2, v28 + 1 + v30)
				if v27 ~= "Invalid" then
					v9[v27] = v31
				end
				v12 = v28 + v30 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return v9
end
return {
	["DecodeData"] = DecodeData,
	["describe"] = function(p32, p33)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
		local v34 = v_u_1[p32]
		if v34 and v34[p33] then
			if p32 == "ValueType" then
				return string.pack("H", v34[p33])
			end
			local v35 = v34[p33]
			return string.char(v35) or 0
		end
		if p32 ~= "Value" then
			v_u_2.pprint("[SuperBiz][RBXLSerialize][Binary]:Could not describe", p32, p33)
			return 0
		end
		local v36 = tostring(p33)
		local v37 = #v36
		if v37 <= 255 then
			return string.char(v37) .. v36 or 0
		end
		v_u_2.pprint("[SuperBiz][RBXLSerialize][Binary]:Cannot Encode DataValues more than 255 Bytes.")
	end
}

    [========== SCRIPT: Compress ==========]
local v_u_1 = string.char
local v_u_2 = type
local _ = select
local v_u_3 = string.sub
local v_u_4 = table.concat
local v_u_5 = {}
local v_u_6 = {}
for v7 = 0, 255 do
	local v8 = v_u_1(v7)
	local v9 = v_u_1(v7, 0)
	v_u_5[v8] = v9
	v_u_6[v9] = v8
end
return {
	["compress"] = function(p10) -- name: compress
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_4
		if v_u_2(p10) == "string" then

			if v11 <= 1 then
				return "u" .. p10
			else

				local v14 = 1
				local v15 = { "c" }

				local v18 = 0
				for v19 = 1, v11 do
					local v20 = v_u_3(p10, v19, v19)
					local v21 = v12 .. v20
					if v_u_5[v21] or v13[v21] then
						v12 = v21
					else

						if not v22 then
							return nil, "algorithm error, could not fetch word"
						end
						v15[v16] = v22
						v17 = v17 + #v22
						v16 = v16 + 1
						if v11 <= v17 then
							return "u" .. p10
						end
						if v18 >= 256 then
							v18 = 0
							v14 = v14 + 1

							end
						end

					end

				local _ = v16 + 1
				if v11 <= v23 then
					return "u" .. p10

		end
	end,
	["decompress"] = function(p24) -- name: decompress
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_4

			return nil, "string expected, got " .. v_u_2(p24)

		end

			end

				end

    [========== SCRIPT: Convertors ==========]
function splitbyte(p1) -- name: splitbyte
	local v2 = string.byte(p1)
	local v3 = 128
	local v4 = {
		false,
		false,
		false,
		false,
		false,
		false,
		false,
		false
	}
	for v5 = 1, 8 do
		if v3 <= v2 then
			v2 = v2 - v3
			v4[v5] = true
		end
		v3 = v3 / 2
	end
	return v4
end
function formbyte(...) -- name: formbyte

function v_u_4.Calibrate(p45) -- name: Calibrate
	local v46 = {}
	local v47 = p45.ViewportFrame.AbsoluteSize
	v46.aspect = v47.X / v47.Y
	local v48 = p45.Camera.FieldOfView / 2
	v46.yFov2 = math.rad(v48)
	local v49 = v46.yFov2
	v46.tanyFov2 = math.tan(v49)
	local v50 = v46.tanyFov2 * v46.aspect
	v46.xFov2 = math.atan(v50)
	local v51 = v46.xFov2
	v46.tanxFov2 = math.tan(v51)
	local v52 = v46.tanyFov2
	local v53 = v46.aspect
	local v54 = v52 * math.min(1, v53)
	v46.cFov2 = math.atan(v54)
	local v55 = v46.cFov2
	v46.sincFov2 = math.sin(v55)
	p45._viewport = v46
end

	return (p56._modelRadius + v58) / p56._viewport.sincFov2
end
function v_u_4.GetMinimumFitCFrame(p59, p60) -- name: GetMinimumFitCFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34
	if not p59.Model then
		return CFrame.new()
	end
	local v61 = (p60 - p60.Position):Inverse()
	local v62 = p59._points
	local v63 = { v61 * v62[1] }
	local v64 = v63[1].Z
	for v65 = 2, #v62 do
		local v66 = v61 * v62[v65]
		local v67 = v66.Z
		v64 = math.min(v64, v67)
		v63[v65] = v66
	end
	local v68, v69 = v_u_34(v63, "X", v64, p59._viewport.tanxFov2)
	local v70, v71 = v_u_34(v63, "Y", v64, p59._viewport.tanyFov2)
	local v72 = (v68 - v69) / 2 / p59._viewport.tanxFov2
	local v73 = (v70 - v71) / 2 / p59._viewport.tanyFov2
	local v74 = math.max(v72, v73)
	return p60 * CFrame.new((v68 + v69) / 2, (v70 + v71) / 2, v64 + v74)
end

	["_isValidTrack"] = function(_, p6) -- name: _isValidTrack
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		if p6 then
			local v7 = p6.customMetadata
			if typeof(v7) == "table" then
				local v8 = p6.title
				if typeof(v8) == "string" then
					local v9 = p6.playlistId
					if typeof(v9) == "string" then
						local v10 = p6.customMetadata
						local v11 = v10.key
						if typeof(v11) == "string" then
							local v12 = v10.id
							if typeof(v12) == "string" then
								return true
							end
						end
						v_u_1:Send("Error in track metadata", p6)
						local v13 = warn
						local v14 = p6.artistNames
						v13("Metadata not in correct format", typeof(v14) ~= "table" and "" or table.concat(p6.artistNames, ", "), p6.title)
						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
		v_u_1:Send("There is an issue with the track data", p6)
		warn("Track not in correct format")

	end

		["started"] = p24.started,

	}

		v28 = os.time()

local v_u_9 = v_u_8.C0.Y
local _ = v6.C0.Y

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10

	v_u_8.C0 = CFrame.new(0, v_u_9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -v11.X, 0) * CFrame.Angles(v11.Y, 0, 0)
	v_u_10:FireServer(v_u_8.C0)
end)

    [========== SCRIPT: Rotation ==========]
wait(5)
local v_u_1 = workspace.CurrentCamera
local v2 = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local v3 = v2.Character or v2.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local v_u_4 = v3:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local v5 = v3:FindFirstChild("Neck", true)
local v6 = v3:FindFirstChild("Waist", true)
local v7 = v5:Clone()
v5.Enabled = false
local v_u_8 = v7
v7.Parent = v3.Head
local _ = v6.C0
local v_u_9 = v_u_8.C0.Y
local _ = v6.C0.Y
v3:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
local v_u_10 = script.Parent:WaitForChild("RemoteEvent")
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10
	local v11 = v_u_4.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v_u_1.CFrame).LookVector
	v_u_8.C0 = CFrame.new(0, v_u_9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -v11.X, 0) * CFrame.Angles(v11.Y, 0, 0)
	v_u_10:FireServer(v_u_8.C0)
end)

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p23, p24) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p23 == nil or p24 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v25 = 1, p23.count do
		if p23[v25].anim.AnimationId == p24.AnimationId then
			return v25
		end
	end
	return 0
end

function stepAnimate(p130) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_129, (ref) v_u_78, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_112

	v_u_129 = p130
	if v_u_78 > 0 then
		v_u_78 = v_u_78 - v131
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_78 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v132 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v132 and v132:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v133 = getToolAnim(v132)
		if v133 then
			v_u_76 = v133.Value
			v133.Parent = nil
			v_u_77 = p130 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_77 < p130 then
			v_u_77 = 0
			v_u_76 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_76 = "None"
		v_u_112 = nil
		v_u_77 = 0
	end
end

    [========== SCRIPT: HealthDisplay ==========]
local v_u_1 = game:GetService("TweenService")
return {
	["Init"] = function(_, p_u_2) -- name: Init
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2
			for _, v3 in pairs(p_u_2:GetChildren()) do
				if v3:IsA("UnionOperation") or (v3:IsA("Part") or (v3:IsA("MeshPart") or v3:IsA("BasePart"))) then
					v3.CollisionGroup = "Player"
					v3.CanCollide = false
				elseif v3:IsA("Accessory") then
					for _, v4 in pairs(v3:GetDescendants()) do
						if v4:IsA("UnionOperation") or (v4:IsA("Part") or (v4:IsA("MeshPart") or v4:IsA("BasePart"))) then
							v4.CollisionGroup = "Player"
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		local v_u_5 = p_u_2:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if v_u_5 then
			script.HealthDisplay:Clone().Parent = v_u_5
			local v_u_6 = p_u_2:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
			v_u_6.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_1
				if p_u_2 then
					if v_u_6.Health <= 0.01 then
						return
					else
						v_u_5 = p_u_2:FindFirstChild("Head")
						if v_u_5 then
							local v7 = v_u_5:FindFirstChild("HealthDisplay")
							if v7 then
								v7.Enabled = true
								local v8 = v_u_6.Health / v_u_6.MaxHealth
								if v8 <= 0.5 and v8 > 0.15 then
									v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
										["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(199, 183, 61)
									}):Play()
								elseif v8 <= 0.15 then
									v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
										["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(199, 44, 47)
									}):Play()
								else
									v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
										["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(72, 194, 53)
									}):Play()
								end
								v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
									["Size"] = UDim2.new(v8, 0, 1, 0)
								}):Play()
							end
						end
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end)
		end
	end
}

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count

				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))

	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then

			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do

			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1

		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5

	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)

end

	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)

	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight

	end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118

	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end

			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil

		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)

	end
	return true
end

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25

end

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				end))

				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale

	if not v_u_2 then

		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")

	end

end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1

		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5

		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1

	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation

	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight

	end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then

	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end

	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v93 = 1

		v93 = v90 / 0.5

end

	end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback

	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end

		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()

			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)

		end
	else

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do

	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do

				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()

		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart

			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone

		local v_u_141 = false

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet

		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do
			v32:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_33 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations

	v_u_33 = not v34 and true or v_u_33
	local v35 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_30)

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v38, v39:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do
			if v40:IsA("Animation") then
				local v41 = v40:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.AnimationId = v51.id

			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6

			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude

				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)

		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet

		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do

	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

	local v35 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_30)

		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v38, v39:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do
			if v40:IsA("Animation") then
				local v41 = v40:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.AnimationId = v51.id

			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3
	v_u_3 = "Dead"
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3
	playAnimation("jump", 0.1, v_u_2)
	v_u_84 = 0.31
	v_u_3 = "Jumping"
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_3
	local v140 = p139 / getHeightScale()
	playAnimation("climb", 0.1, v_u_2)
	setAnimationSpeed(v140 / 5)
	v_u_3 = "Climbing"
end

function animateTool() -- name: animateTool
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_82, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_82 == "None" then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
		return
	elseif v_u_82 == "Slash" then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	elseif v_u_82 == "Lunge" then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	end
end
function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim
	for _, v144 in ipairs(p143:GetChildren()) do
		if v144.Name == "toolanim" and v144.className == "StringValue" then
			return v144
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

end)

end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p27, p28) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p27 == nil or p28 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v29 = 1, p27.count do
		if p27[v29].anim.AnimationId == p28.AnimationId then
			return v29
		end
	end
	return 0
end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_14[p_u_30] ~= nil then
		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do
			v32:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_33 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations
	end)
	v_u_33 = not v34 and true or v_u_33
	local v35 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_30)
	if v_u_33 and v35 ~= nil then
		local v36 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v37 = v35.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v36, v37:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v38, v39:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do
			if v40:IsA("Animation") then
				local v41 = v40:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.Name = p_u_30
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.AnimationId = v51.id
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].weight = v51.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148

				if v_u_141 then
					if not v149 then
						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()

					end
				else

						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		v_u_144:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148

				if v_u_141 then

						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()

					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

function v_u_17.trackItem(p_u_218, p_u_219) -- name: trackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v220 = p_u_219:IsA("BasePart")
	local v221
	if v220 then
		v221 = false
	else
		v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v221 then
			v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end
	assert(v220 or v221, "Only BaseParts or Characters/NPCs can be tracked!")
	if not p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] then
		if p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] then
			p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] = nil
		end
		local v222 = p_u_218.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		local v223 = {
			["janitor"] = v222,
			["item"] = p_u_219,
			["isBasePart"] = v220,
			["isCharacter"] = v221
		}
		p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] = v223
		v222:add(p_u_219.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_219, (copy) p_u_218
			if not p_u_219:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				p_u_218:untrackItem(p_u_219)
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		require(v_u_12).itemAdded:Fire(v223)
	end
end

function v_u_4._preventMultiFrameUpdates(p_u_29, p_u_30, ...) -- name: _preventMultiFrameUpdates
	p_u_29._preventMultiDetails = p_u_29._preventMultiDetails or {}
	local v_u_31 = p_u_29._preventMultiDetails[p_u_30]
	if not v_u_31 then
		v_u_31 = {
			["calling"] = false,
			["callsThisFrame"] = 0,

		}

	end
	v_u_31.callsThisFrame = v_u_31.callsThisFrame + 1
	if v_u_31.callsThisFrame ~= 1 then
		return true
	end
	local v_u_32 = table.pack(...)
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_31, (copy) p_u_29, (copy) p_u_30, (copy) v_u_32

end
function v_u_4.update(p_u_35) -- name: update

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then

		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17

				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then

	end

end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)

		end

			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then

		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

		v_u_17 = nil

		v_u_18 = nil

		v_u_19 = nil

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

end
function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103, p104, p105, p106) -- name: switchToAnim

	if p103 ~= v_u_7 then
		if v_u_8 ~= nil then
			v_u_8:Stop(p105)
			v_u_8:Destroy()
		end
		if v_u_11 ~= nil then

			v_u_11:Destroy()
			v_u_11 = nil
		end
		v_u_10 = 1

		v_u_8:Play(p105)
		v_u_6 = p104
		v_u_7 = p103
		if v_u_9 ~= nil then
			v_u_9:disconnect()
		end
		v_u_9 = v_u_8.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		if p104 == "walk" then
			local v107 = rollAnimation("run")
			v_u_11 = p106:LoadAnimation(v_u_14.run[v107].anim)
			v_u_11.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

			if v_u_12 ~= nil then
				v_u_12:disconnect()
			end

		end
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

				end))

				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()

		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_76.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_76.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_77.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end

			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end

	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end

	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148
				local v149 = p_u_137:findPoint(p_u_138.CFrame) or p_u_137:findPart(p_u_138)
				if v_u_141 then
					if not v149 then
						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()
						p_u_137.partExited:Fire(p_u_138)
					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		v_u_144:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end
