function v_u_17.trackItem(p_u_218, p_u_219) -- name: trackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v220 = p_u_219:IsA("BasePart")
	local v221
	if v220 then
		v221 = false
	else
		v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v221 then
			v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end
	assert(v220 or v221, "Only BaseParts or Characters/NPCs can be tracked!")
	if not p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] then
		if p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] then
			p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] = nil
		end
		local v222 = p_u_218.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		local v223 = {
			["janitor"] = v222,
			["item"] = p_u_219,
			["isBasePart"] = v220,
			["isCharacter"] = v221
		}
		p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] = v223
		v222:add(p_u_219.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_219, (copy) p_u_218
			if not p_u_219:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				p_u_218:untrackItem(p_u_219)
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		require(v_u_12).itemAdded:Fire(v223)
	end
end

end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19

		return false

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17

			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)

				resetManagerListeners()

		end)

	end
	return true
end

				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then

	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()

		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")

	end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_76 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_76.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_76.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_77.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end

		end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")

		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p27, p28) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p27 == nil or p28 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v29 = 1, p27.count do
		if p27[v29].anim.AnimationId == p28.AnimationId then
			return v29
		end
	end

end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet

		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))

				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6

		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart

			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback

	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()

			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)

		end
	else

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_5
		if v_u_1:IsServer() then

		end
	end

	end
	function v2.CreateAntiGrav(_) -- name: CreateAntiGrav

		task.delay(0.05, function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6
			v_u_6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
		end)
		if #v_u_10 <= 0 then
			if #v_u_11 > 0 then
				return
			end

			local v25 = Instance.new("Attachment")

			v25.Parent = v_u_6

			table.insert(v26, v25)

			v27.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
			local v28 = workspace.Gravity * v24
			v27.Force = Vector3.new(0, v28, 0)
			v27.Attachment0 = v25

			v27.Parent = v_u_6

			table.insert(v29, v27)

	end

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9
		v_u_9(true, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p27, p28) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p27 == nil or p28 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v29 = 1, p27.count do
		if p27[v29].anim.AnimationId == p28.AnimationId then
			return v29
		end
	end
	return 0
end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_14[p_u_30] ~= nil then
		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do
			v32:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_33 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations
	end)
	v_u_33 = not v34 and true or v_u_33
	local v35 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_30)
	if v_u_33 and v35 ~= nil then
		local v36 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v37 = v35.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v36, v37:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v38, v39:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do
			if v40:IsA("Animation") then
				local v41 = v40:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.Name = p_u_30
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.AnimationId = v51.id
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].weight = v51.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale

		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")

	end

end

end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight

	end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function v_u_17._updateOccupants(p111, p112, p113) -- name: _updateOccupants

			v114[v116] = nil
			if not v115.exited then
				v115.exited = {}

			table.insert(v119, v116)
		end
	end
	for v120, _ in pairs(p113) do

			v114[v120] = v120:IsA("Player") and (v120.Character or true) or true
			if not v115.entered then

		end
	end
	return v115
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end

		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148

				if v_u_141 then

					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

function v_u_4._preventMultiFrameUpdates(p_u_29, p_u_30, ...) -- name: _preventMultiFrameUpdates

		v_u_31 = {
			["calling"] = false,
			["callsThisFrame"] = 0,
			["updatedThisFrame"] = false
		}
		p_u_29._preventMultiDetails[p_u_30] = v_u_31
	end
	v_u_31.callsThisFrame = v_u_31.callsThisFrame + 1
	if v_u_31.callsThisFrame ~= 1 then
		return true
	end
	local v_u_32 = table.pack(...)
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_31, (copy) p_u_29, (copy) p_u_30, (copy) v_u_32
		local v33 = v_u_31.callsThisFrame

		if v33 > 1 then

			p_u_29[p_u_30](p_u_29, unpack(v34))
		end
	end)

end
function v_u_4.update(p_u_35) -- name: update

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then

		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")

	if v_u_5 ~= nil then

	end

end

	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1

		v93 = v90 / 0.5

	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)

end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight

	end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then

		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end

		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25

				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end

	end
	return true
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation

	end

end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do

	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v38, v39:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do
			if v40:IsA("Animation") then
				local v41 = v40:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.AnimationId = v51.id

			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end

				v_u_3:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_38.deselected:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38, (ref) v_u_3
		if v_u_38.chatWasPreviouslyActive then
			v_u_38.chatWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			v_u_3:SetCore("ChatActive", true)
		end
		if v_u_38.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive then
			v_u_38.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = nil
		end
	end)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38
		if v_u_38.activeState == "Deselected" then
			v_u_38.stateChanged:Fire("Deselected")
			v_u_38:refresh()
		end
	end)
	v_u_15.iconAdded:Fire(v_u_38)
	return v_u_38
end

function v_u_15.setState(p68, p69, p70, p71) -- name: setState
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_19
	local v72 = p69 or (p68.isSelected and "Selected" or "Deselected")
	local v73 = v_u_11.formatStateName(v72)
	if p68.activeState ~= v73 then
		local v74 = p68.isSelected
		p68.activeState = v73
		if v73 == "Deselected" then
			p68.isSelected = false
			if v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(false, p70, p71)
				p68.deselected:Fire(p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p70, p71)
		elseif v73 == "Selected" then
			p68.isSelected = true
			if not v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(true, p70, p71)
				p68.selected:Fire(p70, p71)
				v_u_19:Fire(p68, p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p70, p71)
		end
		p68.stateChanged:Fire(v73, p70, p71)
	end
end
function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_75, p_u_76) -- name: getInstance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v77 = p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76]
	if v77 then
		return v77
	end
	local function v_u_81(p_u_78, p_u_79) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75
		if not p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] then
			local v80 = p_u_79:GetAttribute("Collective")
			if v80 then
				v80 = p_u_75.cachedCollectives[v80]
			end
			if v80 then
				table.insert(v80, p_u_79)
			end
			p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = p_u_79
			p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = true
			p_u_79.Destroying:Once(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_75, (copy) p_u_78, (copy) p_u_79
				p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = nil
				p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v82 = p_u_75.widget
	v_u_81("Widget", v82)
	if p_u_76 == "Widget" then
		return v82
	end
	local v_u_83 = nil
	local function v_u_89(p84) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_81, (copy) p_u_76, (ref) v_u_83
		for _, v85 in pairs(p84:GetChildren()) do
			local v86 = v85:GetAttribute("WidgetUID")
			if not v86 or v86 == p_u_75.UID then
				local v87 = v_u_12.getRealInstance(v85) or v85
				v_u_89(v87)
				if v87:IsA("GuiBase") or (v87:IsA("UIBase") or v87:IsA("ValueBase")) then
					local v88 = v87.Name
					v_u_81(v88, v87)
					if v88 == p_u_76 then
						v_u_83 = v87
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	v_u_89(v82)
	return v_u_83
end

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_270, p_u_271, p_u_272) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_270, (copy) p_u_271, (copy) p_u_272
		local v_u_273 = p_u_270:getInstance("IconLabel")
		v_u_273.Transparency = 1
		p_u_271.Parent = v_u_273.Parent
		p_u_271.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p_u_271.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p_u_271.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p_u_271.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p_u_271.ClipsDescendants = false
		for _, v_u_274 in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p_u_271[v_u_274] = v_u_273[v_u_274]

local v_u_110 = nil
function v_u_53.LoadCategory(p111, p112, p113, p114) -- name: LoadCategory
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_35, (ref) v_u_110, (ref) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_11
	local v115 = tonumber(p112)
	p111.Loading:set(true)
	p111:Enable()
	p111:ClearItemFrame()
	local v116 = nil
	if p113 and #p113 == 0 then
		p113 = nil
	end
	local v117
	if p113 and p113 ~= "KEY_INCATEGORY" then
		v117 = "Search"
		if not p114 then
			p111:Deselect()
		end
	else
		local v118 = v_u_6[v115]
		if not v118 then
			error(string.format("Category %s is not found.", (tostring(v115))), 2)
			return
		end
		v117 = v118.name
		if p111.Resetting then
			p111.Resetting = false
		elseif p111.Controllers and p111.Controllers.TopBarController then
			p111.Controllers.OutfitFeedController:Disable()
		end
		v116 = v_u_35[v115]
		if not v116 then
			local v119 = v_u_6[v115] and v_u_6[v115].name or nil
			if v119 then
				v116 = v_u_35[v119]
			end
		end
		if not v116 then
			error(string.format("Category loader for %s is not found.", (tostring(v115))), 2)
		end
	end
	p111.CurrentCategory = {
		["Id"] = nil,
		["Name"] = nil,
		["Page"] = 1,
		["SortType"] = "Relevance",
		["Keyword"] = nil,
		["AllowedTypes"] = nil,
		["Loader"] = nil,
		["SearchPages"] = nil,
		["Content"] = nil,
		["Id"] = tonumber(v115) or 0,
		["Name"] = v115,
		["Keyword"] = p113,
		["AllowedTypes"] = p114,
		["Loader"] = v116,
		["SearchPages"] = {},
		["Content"] = {}
	}
	if v117 ~= v_u_110 then
		v_u_31:FireServer(v117)

function v_u_53.SearchFor(p120, p121) -- name: SearchFor
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6
	p120.ViewingBundleId:set(nil)
	if p121 and #p121 > 0 then
		p120:LoadCategory(p120.CurrentCategory.Id, "KEY_INCATEGORY")
		local v122 = {
			["Categories"] = {},
			["Subcategories"] = {},
			["AssetTypes"] = {}
		}
		local v123 = v_u_6[p120.CurrentCategory.Id].query
		if v123 then
			if v123.AssetTypeId then
				local v124 = v122.AssetTypes
				local v125 = v123.AssetTypeId
				table.insert(v124, v125)
			end
			if v123.Subcategory then
				local v126 = v122.Subcategories
				local v127 = v123.Subcategory
				table.insert(v126, v127)
			end
			if v123.Category then
				local v128 = v122.Categories
				local v129 = v123.Category
				table.insert(v128, v129)
			end
		end
		p120:LoadCategory(p120.CurrentCategory.Name, p121, v122)
	else
		p120:LoadCategory(p120.CurrentCategory.Name)
		p120.CurrentSort:set("Relevance")
	end
end

function v_u_53.LoadItems(p_u_132) -- name: LoadItems

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_139

					p_u_132.SearchFailed:set(true)

				end

				local v142 = v_u_1:SearchCatalog(v_u_139)
				local v143, v144 = v_u_47(v141, false)
				local v145, v146 = v_u_47(v142, true)

					v141 = nil

		v_u_11.pprint(v137)

				["SelectedId"] = p_u_132.SelectedItemId,
				["OnTry"] = function() -- name: OnTry
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_157, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_156, (copy) p_u_132
					local v158 = v_u_157
					if v_u_157.BundleType == 4 then

							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_157
							return v_u_1:GetItemDetails(v_u_157.BundleId, Enum.AvatarItemType.Bundle)

function v_u_27.SaveCurrentOutfitToRoblox(p94) -- name: SaveCurrentOutfitToRoblox

end

function v_u_27.LoadRobloxOutfits(p_u_116) -- name: LoadRobloxOutfits
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_15
	if not p_u_116.LoadedRobloxOutfits then
		local v_u_117 = p_u_116.Outfits:get()
		local v118 = v_u_5:GetOutfits(Enum.OutfitSource.Created)
		local v119 = false
		while not v119 do
			local v120 = {}
			for _, v_u_121 in v118:GetCurrentPage() do
				if v_u_121.IsEditable then
					local v122 = v_u_14.new
					local function v134(p123)
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_121, (ref) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_117, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) p_u_116
						local v124 = v_u_5:GetOutfitDetails(v_u_121.Id)
						local v125 = {
							["BodyColors"] = v124.BodyColors
						}
						for _, v126 in ipairs(v124.Assets) do
							local v127 = v126.Id
							v125[tostring(v127)] = v_u_12.deepCopy(v_u_7.GetItemDataTable(v126.Id))
							if v126.Meta then
								local v128 = v126.Id
								v125[tostring(v128)].Order = v126.Meta.Order
							end
						end
						local v129 = v_u_117
						local v130 = v_u_121.Id
						local v131 = tostring(v130)
						local v132 = {
							["isRoblox"] = v_u_15(true),
							["data"] = v125
						}
						local v133 = v_u_121.Id
						v132.id = tostring(v133)
						v129[v131] = v132
						p_u_116.Outfits:set(v_u_117)
						p123()
					end
					table.insert(v120, v122(v134))
				end
			end
			v_u_14.all(v120):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_116
				p_u_116.Controllers.AvatarPreviewController:UpdateSaveButton()
			end):catch(warn)
			v119 = v118.IsFinished
			if not v119 then
				v118:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
			end
		end
		p_u_116.LoadedRobloxOutfits = true
	end
end
function v_u_27.Enable(p_u_135) -- name: Enable

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9, (copy) p_u_135

			p_u_135.RequestPermFailed = not v_u_9.requestAccess()
			if not p_u_135.RequestPermFailed then
				p_u_135:LoadRobloxOutfits()
			end
		end
	end)
end

end

function v_u_1.GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame(p37) -- name: GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8

		end

		end
		local v52 = (v40 - p37.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v52 > 3.141592653589793 then

		end
		local v53 = (v51 - p37.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil

	end

function v_u_2.OnThrottleAccel(p22, _, p23, _) -- name: OnThrottleAccel

function v_u_2.Update(p30, p31, p32, _) -- name: Update
	if not p30.vehicleSeat then
		return p31, false
	end

		p30.vehicleSeat.ThrottleFloat = p30:ComputeThrottle(v33)
		p30.vehicleSeat.SteerFloat = p30:ComputeSteer(v33)
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), true
	end
	local v34 = p30.steer
	local v35 = p30.throttle
	local v36 = p31 + Vector3.new(v34, 0, v35)
	p30.vehicleSeat.ThrottleFloat = -v36.Z

end
function v_u_2.ComputeThrottle(_, p37) -- name: ComputeThrottle

end
function v_u_2.ComputeSteer(p38, p39) -- name: ComputeSteer
	if p39 == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) then
		return 0
	end
	local v40 = -p39.x
	local v41 = -p39.z
	return -math.atan2(v40, v41) * 57.29577951308232 / p38.autoPilot.MaxSteeringAngle
end
function v_u_2.SetupAutoPilot(p42) -- name: SetupAutoPilot
	p42.autoPilot.MaxSpeed = p42.vehicleSeat.MaxSpeed
	p42.autoPilot.MaxSteeringAngle = 35

	return math.atan2(v61, v62)
end
function v_u_4.RotateVectorByAngleAndRound(p63, p64, p65) -- name: RotateVectorByAngleAndRound
	if p63.Magnitude <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local v66 = p63.Unit
	local v67 = v66.Z
	local v68 = v66.X
	local v69 = math.atan2(v67, v68)
	local v70 = v66.Z
	local v71 = v66.X
	local v72 = (math.atan2(v70, v71) + p64) / p65 + 0.5
	return math.floor(v72) * p65 - v69
end
function v_u_4.GamepadLinearToCurve(p73) -- name: GamepadLinearToCurve
	local v74 = Vector2.new
	local v75 = p73.X
	local v76 = v75 < 0 and -1 or 1
	local v77 = math.abs(v75)
	local v78 = (math.abs(v77) * 2 - 1) * 1.1 - 0.1
	local v79 = math.clamp(v78, -1, 1)
	local v80
	if v79 >= 0 then
		v80 = v79 * 0.35 / (0.35 - v79 + 1)
	else
		v80 = -(-v79 * 0.8 / (v79 + 0.8 + 1))
	end
	local v81 = (v80 / 2 + 0.5) * v76
	local v82 = math.clamp(v81, -1, 1)
	local v83 = p73.Y
	local v84 = v83 < 0 and -1 or 1
	local v85 = math.abs(v83)
	local v86 = (math.abs(v85) * 2 - 1) * 1.1 - 0.1
	local v87 = math.clamp(v86, -1, 1)
	local v88
	if v87 >= 0 then
		v88 = v87 * 0.35 / (0.35 - v87 + 1)
	else
		v88 = -(-v87 * 0.8 / (v87 + 0.8 + 1))
	end
	local v89 = (v88 / 2 + 0.5) * v84
	return v74(v82, (math.clamp(v89, -1, 1)))
end

	elseif p90 == Enum.TouchCameraMovementMode.Classic or (p90 == Enum.DevTouchCameraMovementMode.Classic or (p90 == Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic or p90 == Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Classic)) then

		return Enum.ComputerCameraMovementMode.Follow

	elseif p90 == Enum.DevTouchCameraMovementMode.UserChoice or p90 == Enum.DevComputerCameraMovementMode.UserChoice then

[Module] -> Players.kunexe4.PlayerScripts.BloxbizSDK.Utils.Fusion.Animation.springCoefficients
    [========== SCRIPT: springCoefficients ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: springCoefficients
	if p1 == 0 or p3 == 0 then
		return 1, 0, 0, 1
	end
	if p2 > 1 then
		local v4 = p1 * p3
		local v5 = p2 ^ 2 - 1
		local v6 = math.sqrt(v5)
		local v7 = -0.5 / v6
		local v8 = -v6 - p2
		local v9 = 1 / v8
		local v10 = v4 * v8
		local v11 = math.exp(v10)
		local v12 = v4 * v9
		local v13 = math.exp(v12)
		return (v13 * v8 - v11 * v9) * v7, (v11 - v13) * v7 / p3, (v13 - v11) * v7 * p3, (v11 * v8 - v13 * v9) * v7
	end
	if p2 == 1 then
		local v14 = p1 * p3
		local v15 = -v14
		local v16 = math.exp(v15)
		return v16 * (v14 + 1), v16 * p1, v16 * (-v14 * p3), v16 * (1 - v14)
	end
	local v17 = p1 * p3
	local v18 = 1 - p2 ^ 2
	local v19 = math.sqrt(v18)
	local v20 = 1 / v19
	local v21 = v19 * v17
	local v22 = -v17 * p2
	local v23 = math.exp(v22)
	local v24 = v23 * math.sin(v21)
	local v25 = v23 * math.cos(v21)
	local v26 = v24 * v20
	local v27 = v26 * p2
	return v27 + v25, v26, -(v27 * p2 + v24 * v19), v25 - v27
end

function collidesWith(p24, p25) -- name: collidesWith
	local v26 = p24.AbsolutePosition
	local v27 = v26 + p24.AbsoluteSize
	local v28 = p25.AbsolutePosition
	local v29 = v28 + p25.AbsoluteSize
	local v30
	if v26.x < v29.x and (v27.x > v28.x and v26.y < v29.y) then
		v30 = v27.y > v28.y
	else
		v30 = false
	end
	return v30
end

	local v33 = table.clone(v_u_16)
	table.sort(v33, function(p34, p35)
		return p34.stepIndex < p35.stepIndex
	end)
	for _, v36 in ipairs(v33) do
		if not v36.hit then

			local v38 = v36.stepIndex
			local v39 = v37[tostring(v38)]

				v36.hit = true

	function v_u_123.IsCurrentWaypointReached(_) -- name: IsCurrentWaypointReached
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
		local v152

	function v_u_123.OnPointReached(_, p155) -- name: OnPointReached

	local v177 = v_u_123.TargetPoint + v_u_123.TargetSurfaceNormal * 1.5

function PercentDiffFromA(p96, p97) -- name: PercentDiffFromA
	local v98 = p97 - p96
	if v98 <= 0.00001 then
		return 0
	end
	if p96 == 0 then
		return (1 / 0)
	end
	local v99 = v98 / p96 * 100
	return math.round(v99)
end
function v_u_43._Update(p100, p101) -- name: _Update

		return
	end

			else

			end

				v_u_2.MouseIcon = p100.UnlockedIcon
			else

			end
		end
	end

		p100._CustomMouseIconGUIInstances.Icon.Image = p100.LockedIcon
	end
	if p100.LockedIcon and (p100.MouseLocked == true and (v_u_2.MouseIconEnabled and (p100._CurrentInputMethod == "Touch" or p100._CurrentInputMethod == "Gamepad" and p100.AdjustedControllerIconDisplay))) then

		p100._HidingMouseIcon = true
	else
		p100._CustomMouseIconGUIInstances.Gui.Enabled = false

	end
	p100._ZoomSpring.MinValue = p100.MinZoom
	p100._ZoomSpring.MaxValue = p100.MaxZoom
	p100._ZoomSpring.Freq = p100.ZoomStiffness
	local v102 = p100._Vector3Spring.Spring
	local v103 = p100.VelocityOffsetDamping
	v102.Damping = math.clamp(v103, 0, 1)
	local v104 = p100._Vector3Spring.Spring
	local v105 = p100.VelocityOffsetFrequency
	v104.Frequency = math.clamp(v105, 0.00001, (1 / 0))
	p100._CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = p100.FOV
	local v106 = p100._CurrentRootPart.CFrame.Position
	local v107 = CFrame.new(v106)
	local v108 = CFrame.Angles(0, p100._Yaw, 0)
	local v109 = CFrame.Angles(p100._Pitch, 0, 0)
	local v110 = v107 * v108
	local v111 = p100.CameraOffset.X
	local v112 = p100.CameraOffset.Y
	local v113 = p100.CameraOffset.Z
	local v114 = Vector3.new(v111, v112, v113)
	local v115 = CFrame.new(v114.X, 0, 0)
	local v116 = CFrame.new(0, v114.Y, 0)
	local v117 = CFrame.new(0, 0, v114.Z)
	local v118 = v108 * v115 * (v109 * v116)
	local v119 = p100.FreeCamMode == false and v107 * (v118 * v117) or p100.FreeCamCFrame
	if p100._LastFocusPosition == nil or (p100._LastRootPartPosition == nil or p100._LastCharacterVelocity == nil) then
		p100._LastFocusPosition = v119.Position
		p100._LastRootPartPosition = v106
		p100._LastCharacterVelocity = Vector3.new()
	end
	local v120 = v119.Position - p100._LastFocusPosition
	local v121 = v106 - p100._LastRootPartPosition
	p100._LastFocusPosition = v119.Position
	p100._LastRootPartPosition = v106
	local v122 = PercentDiffFromA(p100._LastCharacterVelocity.Magnitude, v121.Magnitude) > p100._TeleportationThreshold * (p101 / 0.016666666666666666)

		p100._Vector3Spring:Reset((Vector3.new()))
		p100._V3SpringConcluded = true
		v122 = true
	end

		v119 = v119 + p100._Vector3Spring:Step(p101)
		p100._V3SpringConcluded = false
	elseif p100._V3SpringConcluded == false then
		p100._Vector3Spring:SetGoal((Vector3.new()))
		v119 = v119 + p100._Vector3Spring:Step(p101)
		if p100._Vector3Spring:GetDisplacement() <= 0.0001 then
			p100._V3SpringConcluded = true
		end

function v_u_1.detectAndMeasureImpression(p126) -- name: detectAndMeasureImpression

	local _ = v128.unit
	local v129 = v128.Magnitude

	end

		return
	end

	local v136 = timeInMs()
	local v137 = p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image
	local v138 = p126.currentBloxbizAdId
	local v139 = p126.currentURLsDict
	local v140 = p126.currentVideo
	if not (v139[v137] or p126.isClientPart) then
		task.wait(v_u_19)
		return

		{ v136, v131, v132 }
	}

		v142 = p126.debugAPI.StartImpression(p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui, {
			["URL"] = nil,
			["PixelWidth"] = nil,
			["PixelHeight"] = nil,
			["Time"] = 0,
			["VideoTime"] = 0,
			["Per"] = nil,
			["Angle"] = nil,
			["URL"] = v137,
			["PixelWidth"] = v133,
			["PixelHeight"] = v134,
			["Per"] = v132,
			["Angle"] = v131
		})

		v142 = nil
	end
	local v143 = 1
	local v144 = 0
	local v145 = p126.aggregateImpressionTime
	local v146 = not p126.isClientPart
	if v146 then
		v146 = v139[p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image]

		v147 = true
	else
		v147 = false

			break
		end
		local _, v150 = p126:getSizeAtDistance()

		local v151 = { timeInMs(), v149, v150 }
		table.insert(v141, v151)
		if p126.debugAPI then

			if v152 then
				v152 = p126.currentVideo:getAnalytics()
			end
			local v153 = v152 and v152.playEndSeconds or 0
			p126.debugAPI.UpdateImpressions(v142, {
				["URL"] = v137,

			end
		end

	end

function v_u_44.delay(p202) -- name: delay

	return v_u_44._new(debug.traceback(nil, 2), function(p205, _, p206)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_44, (ref) v_u_204, (ref) v_u_201, (ref) v_u_200
		local v207 = v_u_44._getTime()
		local v208 = v207 + v_u_204
		local v_u_209 = {

			["startTime"] = v207,
			["endTime"] = v208
		}

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_44, (ref) v_u_200, (ref) v_u_201

					v_u_200 = v211.next

					end

				end
			end)
		elseif v_u_200.endTime < v208 then
			local v212 = v_u_200
			local v213 = v212.next
			while v213 ~= nil and v213.endTime < v208 do

				v212 = v213

			end

			if v213 ~= nil then
				v_u_209.next = v213
				v213.previous = v_u_209
			end
		else

			v_u_200.previous = v_u_209
			v_u_200 = v_u_209
		end

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_209, (ref) v_u_200, (ref) v_u_201

function v_u_50.SmartCircleBehavior(p109, p110) -- name: SmartCircleBehavior
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
	local v111 = p109.torsoPart.CFrame.upVector.unit
	local v112 = p109.torsoPart.CFrame.rightVector.unit
	p110[#p110 + 1] = p109.torsoPart.CFrame.p
	p110[#p110 + 1] = p109.torsoPart.CFrame.p + v111
	p110[#p110 + 1] = p109.torsoPart.CFrame.p - v111
	p110[#p110 + 1] = p109.torsoPart.CFrame.p + v112

		p110[#p110 + 1] = p109.headPart.CFrame.p
	end

		local v117 = math.cos(v116)
		local v118 = math.sin(v116)

		local v121 = Ray.new(v114, v119 - v114)
		local v122, v123, v124 = game.Workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(v121, { p109.char }, false, false)

			local v128 = (v125 - p109.camera.CFrame.p).unit

			end

		local v36 = math.sqrt(v35)
		local v37 = p26 * v28 * v36
		local v38 = math.cos(v37)
		local v39 = p26 * v28 * v36
		local v40 = math.sin(v39)
		p25.Position = (v32 * v38 + (v31 + v32 * (v27 * v28)) * v40 / (v28 * v36)) * v34 + v29
		p25.Velocity = (v31 * (v38 * v36) - (v31 * v27 + v32 * v28) * v40) * (v34 / v36)
	else
		local v41 = v27 * v27 - 1
		local v42 = math.sqrt(v41)
		local v43 = -v28 * (v27 - v42)
		local v44 = -v28 * (v27 + v42)
		local v45 = (v31 - v32 * v43) / (2 * v28 * v42)
		local v46 = v32 - v45
		local v47 = v43 * p26
		local v48 = v46 * math.exp(v47)
		local v49 = v44 * p26
		local v50 = v45 * math.exp(v49)
		p25.Position = v48 + v50 + v29
		p25.Velocity = v43 * v48 + v44 * v50
	end

function v_u_45.ResetFeed(p101, p102) -- name: ResetFeed
	local v103 = p101.FeedsById[p102]
	local v104 = v103.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v105 = p101.OutfitsCache
	for _, v106 in ipairs(v104) do
		local v107 = type(v106) == "string" and v106 and v106 or v106.guid
		if v105[v107] then
			v105[v107].Frame:Destroy()
			v105[v107].Frame = nil
			v105[v107] = nil
		end
	end
	v103.Page:set(0)
	v103.LastRefresh:set(tick())
	v103.LoadedOutfits:set({})
	v103.LoadedAll:set(false)
	v103.ScrollY:set(0)
end
function v_u_45.SwitchToFeed(p_u_108, p109, p110) -- name: SwitchToFeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
	p_u_108:CancelLoading()
	if p109 ~= "top" then
		p_u_108.TopDropdownOpen:set(false)
	end
	p_u_108.States.Loading:set(true)
	p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(true)
	local v_u_111 = p_u_108.FeedsById[p109]
	v_u_111.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v_u_111.LoadFailed:set(false)
	local v112 = v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:get() and true or p110
	if not v_u_111.Searchable then
		p_u_108.States.Query:set(v_u_44)
	end
	if v112 or tick() - v_u_111.LastRefresh:get() > 60 then
		v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:set(false)
		p_u_108:ResetFeed(p109)
	end
	local v_u_113 = p_u_108.GuiObjects.ScrollingFrame
	v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	p_u_108:ClearWindow()
	task.wait(0.1)
	local v114 = v112 and {} or v_u_111.LoadedOutfits:get()
	if #v114 > 0 then
		p_u_108:RenderOutfits(v114, 0, true):andThen(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_111
			v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, v_u_111.ScrollY:get() or 0)
		end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108
			p_u_108.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end)
	else
		p_u_108:LoadNextPage()
		v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_45.UpdateFilters(p115) -- name: UpdateFilters
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27
	local v116 = p115.States.Query:get().keywords
	if v116 then
		v116 = #v116 > 0
	end
	local v117 = v_u_27.deepCopy(p115.FilterTabs:get())
	for v118, v119 in pairs(v117) do
		if v116 then
			local v120 = v117[v118]
			local v121 = v119.Internal
			if not v121 then
				local v122 = v119.Searchable or v119.SearchOnly
				v121 = not v122
			end
			v120.Hidden = v121
		else
			v117[v118].Hidden = v119.Internal or v119.SearchOnly
		end
	end
	p115.FilterTabs:set(v117)
	p115:MarkAllForRefresh()
	local v_u_123 = p115.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v125 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p124)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
		return p124.Id == v_u_123
	end)
	if p115.Enabled and (not v125 or v125.Hidden) then
		local v127 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p126)
			return not p126.Hidden
		end)
		p115.States.CurrentFeedId:set(v127.Id)
		p115:SwitchToFeed(v127.Id, true)
	end
end
function v_u_45.LoadNextPage(p_u_128) -- name: LoadNextPage
	p_u_128.States.Loading:set(true)
	local v129 = p_u_128.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v130 = p_u_128.FeedsById[v129]
	v130.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v130.LoadFailed:set(false)
	v130.Page:set(v130.Page:get() + 1)
	local v131 = v130.Page:get()
	local v132 = v130.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v133, v134 = p_u_128:GetOutfitsFromFeedId(v130.Id, p_u_128.States.Query:get(), v131)
	if v133 then
		if #v134 > 0 then
			p_u_128:RenderOutfits(v134, #v132, v131 == 1):andThen(function() end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_128
				p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
				p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
			end)

				table.insert(v132, v135)
			end
			v130.LoadedOutfits:set(v132)
		else
			v130.LoadedAll:set(true)
			p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end
	else

		v130.LoadFailed:set(true)
		v130.SwitchFailed:set(v131 == 1)
		v130.Page:set(v131 - 1)

	end
end

function v_u_45.RenderOutfits(p_u_191, p_u_192, p193, p_u_194) -- name: RenderOutfits
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1
	local v_u_195 = p193 or 0
	local v228 = v_u_29.new(function(p196, p197)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_192, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_29, (copy) p_u_191, (ref) v_u_195, (copy) p_u_194
		local v_u_198 = {}
		for _, v199 in ipairs(p_u_192) do
			if type(v199) ~= "string" then
				local v200 = v_u_21.GetOutfitFromServerData(v199)
				for _, v201 in pairs(v200.Items) do
					if v201.AssetId > 0 and not v_u_23.ItemDetailsCache[v201.AssetId] then
						local v202 = v201.AssetId
						table.insert(v_u_198, v202)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, v_u_203 in ipairs(v_u_27.chunk(v_u_198, 100)) do
			v_u_27.pprint(string.format("Getting %s batch items", #v_u_203))
			local v204, v205 = v_u_27.callWithRetry(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_198, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_203
				return #v_u_198 <= 0 and {} or v_u_1:GetBatchItemDetails(v_u_203, 1)
			end, 2)
			v_u_27.pprint("done")
			if v205 then
				for _, v206 in pairs(v204) do
					v_u_23.ItemDetailsCache[v206.Id] = v206
				end
			end
		end
		local v207 = {}
		local v_u_208 = {}
		for _, v_u_209 in ipairs(p_u_192) do
			local v210 = v_u_29.new
			local function v217(p_u_211, _)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_209, (ref) p_u_191, (copy) v_u_208, (ref) v_u_27
				local v_u_212 = false
				v_u_29.try(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_209, (ref) p_u_191, (ref) v_u_208
					local v213 = nil
					local v214 = v_u_209
					if typeof(v214) == "string" then
						v213 = p_u_191:RenderOutfit(v_u_209)
					else
						local v215 = v_u_209
						if typeof(v215) == "table" then
							v213 = p_u_191:RenderOutfit(v_u_209.guid, v_u_209)

function v_u_79.GetLastEquippedAsset(p170, p171, p172) -- name: GetLastEquippedAsset

function v_u_79.AddChange(p_u_180, p181, p182) -- name: AddChange

local function v_u_8(p5) -- name: notation_to_skeleton
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4
	local v6, v7
	if p5.type == v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC then
		v6 = true
		v7 = p5.power10Scale == 3 and "engineering" or "scientific"
		if p5.minExponentDigits ~= 1 then
			v7 = v7 .. "/*" .. string.rep("e", p5.minExponentDigits)
		end
		if p5.exponentSignDisplay ~= v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO then
			return v6, v7 .. "/" .. v_u_4[p5.exponentSignDisplay]
		end
	else
		if p5.type == v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SIMPLE then
			return true, nil
		end
		v6 = false
		v7 = "Compact notation skeleton is not supported for being represented as a skeleton string in this module"
	end
	return v6, v7
end
local function v_u_19(p9) -- name: precision_to_skeleton
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v10 = nil
	local v11 = nil
	local v12 = nil
	local v13 = nil
	local v14 = nil
	local v15 = nil
	local v16 = nil
	if p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION then
		v13 = p9.min
		v14 = p9.max
	elseif p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.SIGNFICANT then
		v15 = p9.min
		v16 = p9.max
	elseif p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT then
		v13 = p9.minFractionDigits
		v14 = p9.maxFractionDigits
		if p9.sourcedWithSignificantDigits then
			v15 = p9.minSignificantDigits
			v16 = p9.maxSignificantDigits
		elseif p9.roundingPriority == v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED then
			v15 = p9.maxSignificantDigits
			v16 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
		else
			v16 = p9.maxSignificantDigits
			v15 = 1
		end
	else
		v10 = "precision-unlimited"
	end
	if v13 then
		if v14 == 0 then
			v11 = "precision-integer"
		else
			local v17 = "." .. string.rep("0", v13)
			if v14 == v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION then
				v11 = v17 .. "*"
			else
				v11 = v17 .. string.rep("#", v14 - v13)
			end
		end
	end
	if v15 then
		local v18 = string.rep("@", v15)
		if v16 == v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION then
			v12 = v18 .. "*"
		else
			v12 = v18 .. string.rep("#", v16 - v15)
		end
	end
	if v11 then
		if v12 then
			v11 = v11 .. "/" .. v12
			if p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT and p9.sourcedWithSignificantDigits then
				if p9.roundingPriority == v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED then
					return v11 .. "r"
				else
					return v11 .. "s"
				end
			end
		end
	else
		v11 = v12 or v10
	end
	return v11
end

local function v_u_43(p37) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_1
	local v38, v40, v40 = string.match(p37, "^(%a+)/?([^/]*)/?([^/]*)$")
	local v41 = 1
	local v42 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
	if v38 == "scientific" or v38 == "engineering" then
		if string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		elseif string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		end
		if v40 ~= "" then
			if string.sub(v40, 1, 5) ~= "sign-" then
				return nil
			end
			v42 = v_u_36[v40]
		end
		if v41 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			return table.freeze({
				["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
				["power10Scale"] = v38 == "engineering" and 3 or 1,
				["minExponentDigits"] = v41,
				["exponentSignDisplay"] = v42,
				["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v42)
			})
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_50(p44) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation_concise
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v45, v46 = string.match(p44, "^(EE?)(.+)$")
	if v45 then

		local v49
		if v47 then
			v49 = v_u_36[v47]
		else
			v49 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
			v48 = v46
		end
		if string.match(v48, "^0+$") then
			if #v48 > 999 then
				return nil
			else
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
					["power10Scale"] = v45 == "EE" and 3 or 1,
					["minExponentDigits"] = #v48,
					["exponentSignDisplay"] = v49,
					["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v49)
				})
			end
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_71(p51) -- name: skeleton_to_precision
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v52, v53, v54 = string.match(p51, "^%.((0*)#*)(.*)$")
	if not v52 then
		v52, v54 = string.match(p51, "^(precision%-integer)(.*)$")
	end
	if v52 then
		local v55, v56
		if v52 == "precision-integer" then
			v55 = 0
			v56 = 0
		else
			v55 = #v53
			v56 = #v52
		end
		if string.match(v54, "^[%*%+]") and v53 == v52 then
			v54 = string.sub(v54, 2)
			v56 = -1
		end
		if v55 > 999 or v56 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			if v56 == -1 then
				v56 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
			end
			if string.sub(v54, 1, 1) == "/" then
				local v57 = false
				local v58, v59, v60 = string.match(v54, "^/((@+)#*)([%*%+rs]?)$")
				if not v58 or v60 == "" and v59 ~= "@" or (v60 == "*" or v60 == "+") and v59 ~= v58 then
					return nil
				end
				local v61, v62
				if v60 == "" then
					v61 = #v58
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "s"
				elseif v60 == "*" or v60 == "+" then
					v61 = #v59
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "r"
				else
					v62 = #v59
					v61 = #v58
					v57 = true
				end
				if v62 > 999 or v61 > 999 then
					return nil
				end
				local v63 = table.freeze
				local v64 = {
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT,
					["minFractionDigits"] = v55,
					["maxFractionDigits"] = v56,
					["minSignificantDigits"] = v62,
					["maxSignificantDigits"] = v61
				}
				local v65
				if v60 == "r" then
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED
				else
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.STRICT
				end
				v64.roundingPriority = v65
				v64.sourcedWithSignificantDigits = v57
				return v63(v64)
			elseif v54 == "" then
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION,
					["min"] = v55,
					["max"] = v56
				})
			else
				return nil
			end

end

function v_u_17.GetSubjectCFrame(p32) -- name: GetSubjectCFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	local v33 = p32.lastSubjectCFrame
	local v34 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v34 then
		v34 = v34.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v34 then
		return v33
	end
	if v34:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v35 = v34:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
		local v36 = v34.CameraOffset
		if v_u_6 and p32:GetIsMouseLocked() then
			v36 = Vector3.new()
		end
		local v37 = v34.RootPart
		if v35 and (v34.Parent and v34.Parent:IsA("Model")) then
			v37 = v34.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") or v37
		end
		if v37 and v37:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v38
			if v34.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
				if v34.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
					v38 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
					local v39 = v34.RootPart
					if v37 == v39 then
						local v40 = (v39.Size.Y - 2) / 2
						v38 = v38 + Vector3.new(0, v40, 0)
					end
				else
					v38 = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
				end
			else
				v38 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			end
			v33 = v37.CFrame * CFrame.new((v35 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v38) + v36)
		end
	elseif v34:IsA("BasePart") then
		v33 = v34.CFrame
	elseif v34:IsA("Model") then
		if v34.PrimaryPart then
			v33 = v34:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()
		else
			v33 = CFrame.new()
		end
	end
	if v33 then
		p32.lastSubjectCFrame = v33
	end
	return v33
end
function v_u_17.GetSubjectVelocity(_) -- name: GetSubjectVelocity
	local v41 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v41 then
		v41 = v41.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v41 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if v41:IsA("BasePart") then
		return v41.Velocity
	end
	if v41:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v42 = v41.RootPart
		if v42 then
			return v42.Velocity
		end
	else
		local v43 = v41:IsA("Model") and v41.PrimaryPart
		if v43 then
			return v43.Velocity
		end
	end
	return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

function v_u_17.StepZoom(p47) -- name: StepZoom
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8
	local v48 = p47.currentSubjectDistance
	local v49 = v_u_10.getZoomDelta()
	if math.abs(v49) > 0 then
		local v50
		if v49 > 0 then
			local v51 = v48 + v49 * (v48 * 0.5 + 1)
			local v52 = p47.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD
			v50 = math.max(v51, v52)
		else
			local v53 = (v48 + v49) / (1 - v49 * 0.5)
			v50 = math.max(v53, 0.5)
		end
		p47:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v50 < p47.FIRST_PERSON_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD and 0.5 or v50)
	end
	return v_u_8.GetZoomRadius()
end
function v_u_17.GetSubjectPosition(p54) -- name: GetSubjectPosition
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	local v55 = p54.lastSubjectPosition
	local v56 = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v56 then
		v56 = v56.CameraSubject
	end
	if not v56 then
		return nil
	end
	if v56:IsA("Humanoid") then
		local v57 = v56:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
		local v58 = v56.CameraOffset
		if v_u_6 and p54:GetIsMouseLocked() then
			v58 = Vector3.new()
		end
		local v59 = v56.RootPart
		if v57 and (v56.Parent and v56.Parent:IsA("Model")) then
			v59 = v56.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") or v59
		end
		if v59 and v59:IsA("BasePart") then
			local v60
			if v56.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
				if v56.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
					v60 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
					if v59 == v56.RootPart then
						local v61 = v56.RootPart.Size.Y / 2 - 1
						v60 = v60 + Vector3.new(0, v61, 0)
					end
				else
					v60 = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
				end
			else
				v60 = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			end
			v55 = v59.CFrame.p + v59.CFrame:vectorToWorldSpace((v57 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v60) + v58)
		end
	elseif v56:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		v55 = v56.CFrame.p + v56.CFrame:vectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
	elseif v56:IsA("SkateboardPlatform") then
		v55 = v56.CFrame.p + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	elseif v56:IsA("BasePart") then
		v55 = v56.CFrame.p
	elseif v56:IsA("Model") then
		if v56.PrimaryPart then
			v55 = v56:GetPrimaryPartCFrame().p
		else
			v55 = v56:GetModelCFrame().p
		end
	end
	p54.lastSubject = v56
	p54.lastSubjectPosition = v55
	return v55
end

function v_u_17.GamepadZoomPress(p75) -- name: GamepadZoomPress
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_5
	local v76 = p75:GetCameraToSubjectDistance()
	local v77 = v_u_16.CameraMaxZoomDistance
	for v78 = #p75.gamepadZoomLevels, 1, -1 do
		local v79 = p75.gamepadZoomLevels[v78]
		if v77 >= v79 then
			if v79 < v_u_16.CameraMinZoomDistance then
				v79 = v_u_16.CameraMinZoomDistance
				if v_u_5 and v77 == v79 then
					break
				end
			end
			if not v_u_5 and v77 == v79 then
				break
			end
			if v79 + (v77 - v79) / 2 < v76 then
				p75:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(v79)
				return
			end
			v77 = v79
		end
	end
	p75:SetCameraToSubjectDistance(p75.gamepadZoomLevels[#p75.gamepadZoomLevels])
end

		p80:OnEnabledChanged()
	end

function v_u_17.OnEnabledChanged(p_u_82) -- name: OnEnabledChanged
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_16
	if p_u_82.enabled then
		v_u_10.setInputEnabled(true)
		p_u_82.gamepadZoomPressConnection = v_u_10.gamepadZoomPress:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_82
			p_u_82:GamepadZoomPress()
		end)
		if v_u_16.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
			p_u_82.currentSubjectDistance = 0.5
			if not p_u_82.inFirstPerson then
				p_u_82:EnterFirstPerson()
			end
		end
		if p_u_82.cameraChangedConn then
			p_u_82.cameraChangedConn:Disconnect()
			p_u_82.cameraChangedConn = nil
		end
		p_u_82.cameraChangedConn = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_82
			p_u_82:OnCurrentCameraChanged()
		end)
		p_u_82:OnCurrentCameraChanged()
	else
		v_u_10.setInputEnabled(false)
		if p_u_82.gamepadZoomPressConnection then
			p_u_82.gamepadZoomPressConnection:Disconnect()
			p_u_82.gamepadZoomPressConnection = nil
		end
		p_u_82:Cleanup()
	end
end

	if p84.cameraChangedConn then
		p84.cameraChangedConn:Disconnect()

	p84.lastSubjectCFrame = nil
	v_u_7.restoreMouseBehavior()
end
function v_u_17.UpdateMouseBehavior(p85) -- name: UpdateMouseBehavior
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_7
	local v86 = v_u_15.ComputerMovementMode == Enum.ComputerMovementMode.ClickToMove
	if p85.isCameraToggle and v86 == false then
		v_u_11.setCameraModeToastEnabled(true)
		v_u_10.enableCameraToggleInput()
		v_u_9(p85.inFirstPerson)
		return
	else
		v_u_11.setCameraModeToastEnabled(false)
		v_u_10.disableCameraToggleInput()
		if p85.inFirstPerson or p85.inMouseLockedMode then
			v_u_7.setRotationTypeOverride(Enum.RotationType.CameraRelative)
			v_u_7.setMouseBehaviorOverride(Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter)
			return
		else
			v_u_7.restoreRotationType()
			if v_u_10.getRotationActivated() then
				v_u_7.setMouseBehaviorOverride(Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition)
			else
				v_u_7.restoreMouseBehavior()
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_17.SetCameraToSubjectDistance(p88, p89) -- name: SetCameraToSubjectDistance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_8
	local v90 = p88.currentSubjectDistance
	if v_u_16.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then
		p88.currentSubjectDistance = 0.5
		if not p88.inFirstPerson then
			p88:EnterFirstPerson()
		end
	else
		local v91 = v_u_16.CameraMinZoomDistance
		local v92 = v_u_16.CameraMaxZoomDistance
		local v93 = math.clamp(p89, v91, v92)
		if v93 < 1 then
			p88.currentSubjectDistance = 0.5
			if not p88.inFirstPerson then
				p88:EnterFirstPerson()
			end
		else
			p88.currentSubjectDistance = v93
			if p88.inFirstPerson then
				p88:LeaveFirstPerson()
			end
		end
	end
	local v94 = v_u_8.SetZoomParameters
	local v95 = p88.currentSubjectDistance
	local v96 = p89 - v90
	v94(v95, (math.sign(v96)))
	return p88.currentSubjectDistance
end

function v_u_17.CalculateNewLookCFrameFromArg(p114, p115, p116) -- name: CalculateNewLookCFrameFromArg
	local v117 = p115 or p114:GetCameraLookVector()
	local v118 = v117.Y
	local v119 = math.asin(v118)
	local v120 = p116.Y
	local v121 = v119 + -1.3962634015954636
	local v122 = v119 + 1.3962634015954636
	local v123 = math.clamp(v120, v121, v122)
	local v124 = Vector2.new(p116.X, v123)
	local v125 = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v117)
	return CFrame.Angles(0, -v124.X, 0) * v125 * CFrame.Angles(-v124.Y, 0, 0)
end
function v_u_17.CalculateNewLookVectorFromArg(p126, p127, p128) -- name: CalculateNewLookVectorFromArg
	return p126:CalculateNewLookCFrameFromArg(p127, p128).LookVector
end
function v_u_17.CalculateNewLookVectorVRFromArg(p129, p130) -- name: CalculateNewLookVectorVRFromArg
	local v131 = ((p129:GetSubjectPosition() - game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.p) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).unit
	local v132 = Vector2.new(p130.X, 0)
	local v133 = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v131)
	return ((CFrame.Angles(0, -v132.X, 0) * v133 * CFrame.Angles(-v132.Y, 0, 0)).LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).unit
end
function v_u_17.GetHumanoid(p134) -- name: GetHumanoid

function v_u_1.GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame(p37) -- name: GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v38 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.Head)
	local _, v39, _ = v38:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
	local v40 = -v39
	if v_u_8:GetUserCFrameEnabled(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand) and v_u_8:GetUserCFrameEnabled(Enum.UserCFrame.LeftHand) then
		local v41 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.LeftHand)
		local v42 = v_u_8:GetUserCFrame(Enum.UserCFrame.RightHand)
		local v43 = v38.Position - v41.Position
		local v44 = v38.Position - v42.Position
		local v45 = v43.X
		local v46 = v43.Z
		local v47 = -math.atan2(v45, v46)
		local v48 = v44.X
		local v49 = v44.Z
		local v50 = (-math.atan2(v48, v49) - v47 + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v50 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v50 = v50 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v51 = (v47 + v50 / 2 + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v51 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v51 = v51 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v52 = (v40 - p37.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v52 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v52 = v52 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v53 = (v51 - p37.currentTorsoAngle + 12.566370614359172) % 6.283185307179586
		if v53 > 3.141592653589793 then
			v53 = v53 - 6.283185307179586
		end
		local v54
		if v53 > -1.5707963267948966 then
			v54 = v53 < 1.5707963267948966
		else
			v54 = false
		end
		if not v54 then
			v53 = v52
		end
		local v55 = math.min(v53, v52)
		local v56 = math.max(v53, v52)
		local v57 = 0

			v56 = v55

function v_u_1.calculateRawMoveVector(p71, p72, p73) -- name: calculateRawMoveVector
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_70
	local v74 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v74 then
		return p73
	end
	local v75 = v74.CFrame
	if v_u_8.VREnabled and p72.RootPart then

		local v76 = p71:GetEstimatedVRTorsoFrame()

			v75 = v75 * v76
		else
			v75 = v74.CFrame * (v76.Rotation + v76.Position * v74.HeadScale)
		end

		local _, _, _, v81, v78, v79, _, _, v80, _, _, v81 = v75:GetComponents()

			v79 = -v78 * math.sign(v80)
		end
