		local v83 = math.sqrt(v82)
		local v84 = (v81 * p73.X + v79 * p73.Z) / v83
		local v85 = (v81 * p73.Z - v79 * p73.X) / v83
		return Vector3.new(v84, 0, v85)
	end

		return v75:VectorToWorldSpace(p73)
	end

	local v87 = p73.Z
	local v88 = Vector3.new(v86, 0, v87)
	if v88.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v89 = -v_u_70().Y * 1.3962634015954636
	local v90 = -v88.X
	local v91 = -v88.Z
	local v92 = math.atan2(v90, v91)

function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_71, p_u_72) -- name: getInstance

		return v73

	local function v_u_77(p_u_74, p_u_75) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_71

				p_u_71.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_74] = nil
				p_u_71.cachedInstances[p_u_75] = nil

		end
	end
	local v78 = p_u_71.widget
	v_u_77("Widget", v78)
	if p_u_72 == "Widget" then
		return v78
	end
	local v_u_79 = nil
	local function v_u_85(p80) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_71, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_85, (copy) v_u_77, (copy) p_u_72, (ref) v_u_79

end

function v_u_15.bindEvent(p_u_201, p202, p_u_203) -- name: bindEvent

		if typeof(v204) == "table" then
			v205 = v204.Connect

			v205 = false

	assert(v205, "argument[1] must be a valid topbarplus icon event name!")
	local v206 = typeof(p_u_203) == "function"

	p_u_201.bindedEvents[p202] = v204:Connect(function(...)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_203, (copy) p_u_201

end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone

function v_u_12.OnCategoryClick(p36, p37) -- name: OnCategoryClick

function v_u_2.loadAnimation(p44, p45, p46) -- name: loadAnimation

    [================================]
[Module] -> Players.kunexe4.PlayerScripts.BloxbizSDK.Utils.Fusion.Animation.springCoefficients
    [========== SCRIPT: springCoefficients ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: springCoefficients
	if p1 == 0 or p3 == 0 then
		return 1, 0, 0, 1
	end
	if p2 > 1 then
		local v4 = p1 * p3
		local v5 = p2 ^ 2 - 1
		local v6 = math.sqrt(v5)
		local v7 = -0.5 / v6
		local v8 = -v6 - p2
		local v9 = 1 / v8
		local v10 = v4 * v8
		local v11 = math.exp(v10)
		local v12 = v4 * v9
		local v13 = math.exp(v12)
		return (v13 * v8 - v11 * v9) * v7, (v11 - v13) * v7 / p3, (v13 - v11) * v7 * p3, (v11 * v8 - v13 * v9) * v7
	end
	if p2 == 1 then
		local v14 = p1 * p3
		local v15 = -v14
		local v16 = math.exp(v15)
		return v16 * (v14 + 1), v16 * p1, v16 * (-v14 * p3), v16 * (1 - v14)
	end
	local v17 = p1 * p3
	local v18 = 1 - p2 ^ 2
	local v19 = math.sqrt(v18)
	local v20 = 1 / v19
	local v21 = v19 * v17
	local v22 = -v17 * p2
	local v23 = math.exp(v22)
	local v24 = v23 * math.sin(v21)
	local v25 = v23 * math.cos(v21)
	local v26 = v24 * v20
	local v27 = v26 * p2
	return v27 + v25, v26, -(v27 * p2 + v24 * v19), v25 - v27
end

    [========== SCRIPT: MinigameController ==========]
local v1 = game:GetService("Players")
local v2 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local v_u_3 = game:GetService("TweenService")
local v_u_4 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local v_u_5 = game:GetService("GuiService")
game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local v_u_6 = require(v2.KnitPackages.Knit)
local v_u_7 = v2:WaitForChild("Templates")
local v_u_8 = v1.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local v_u_9 = nil
local v_u_10 = nil
local v_u_11 = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.5)
local v_u_12 = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.5)
local v_u_13 = nil
local v_u_14 = {
	["Up"] = -90,
	["Down"] = 90,
	["Left"] = 180,
	["Right"] = 0,
	["W"] = -90,
	["S"] = 90,
	["A"] = 180,
	["D"] = 0
}
local v_u_15 = nil
local v_u_16 = {}
local v_u_17 = nil
local v_u_18 = 1
local v_u_19 = {}
local v_u_20 = {}
local v_u_21 = nil
local v_u_22 = nil
local v23 = v_u_6.CreateController({
	["Name"] = "MinigameController"
})
function collidesWith(p24, p25) -- name: collidesWith
	local v26 = p24.AbsolutePosition
	local v27 = v26 + p24.AbsoluteSize
	local v28 = p25.AbsolutePosition
	local v29 = v28 + p25.AbsoluteSize
	local v30
	if v26.x < v29.x and (v27.x > v28.x and v26.y < v29.y) then
		v30 = v27.y > v28.y
	else
		v30 = false
	end
	return v30
end
function sendArrowInput(p31) -- name: sendArrowInput
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_3
	local v32 = v_u_6.GetService("MinigameService")
	local v33 = table.clone(v_u_16)
	table.sort(v33, function(p34, p35)
		return p34.stepIndex < p35.stepIndex
	end)
	for _, v36 in ipairs(v33) do
		if not v36.hit then
			local v37 = v_u_9.Arrow.List
			local v38 = v36.stepIndex
			local v39 = v37[tostring(v38)]
			if v_u_14[p31] == v39.ImageLabel.Rotation then
				v36.hit = true
				local v40 = v_u_3
				local v41 = v_u_9.Arrow.List
				local v42 = v36.stepIndex
				v_u_15 = v40:Create(v41[tostring(v42)], TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
					["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(118, 255, 94)
				})
				v_u_15:Play()
				v32:ArrowChain_Input("InputArrow", {
					["id"] = v36.id,
					["key"] = p31
				})
			else
				for _, v43 in ipairs(v33) do
					v43.hit = false
				end
				v32:ArrowChain_Input("InputArrow", {
					["id"] = v36.id,
					["key"] = p31
				})
			end
		end
	end
end
function offdefaultUI() -- name: offdefaultUI
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_4
	local v44 = v_u_8:WaitForChild("Toolbar")
	local v45 = v_u_8:WaitForChild("Profile")

function PercentDiffFromA(p96, p97) -- name: PercentDiffFromA
	local v98 = p97 - p96
	if v98 <= 0.00001 then
		return 0
	end
	if p96 == 0 then
		return (1 / 0)
	end
	local v99 = v98 / p96 * 100
	return math.round(v99)
end

function v_u_43._GetCollisionRadius(p166) -- name: _GetCollisionRadius
	if p166._CurrentCamera == nil then
		return 0
	end
	local v167 = p166._CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
	local v168 = v167.X / v167.Y
	local v169 = p166.FOV
	local v170 = math.rad(v169)
	local v171 = math.tan(v170)
	local v172 = p166._CurrentCamera.NearPlaneZ
	local v173 = v171 * math.abs(v172)
	local v174 = v173 * v168
	local v175 = p166._CurrentCamera.NearPlaneZ
	return Vector3.new(v174, v173, v175).Magnitude
end
function v_u_43._GetProperCorrection(p176, p177, p178, p179, p180) -- name: _GetProperCorrection
	local v181 = p176[p180].LastCorrectionReturned
	local v182 = p176[p180].LastMangitude
	if p176[p180].LastCorrection == 0 and p178 == 0 then
		local v183 = p176[p180]
		v183.Time0Preserved = v183.Time0Preserved + p177
	else
		p176[p180].Time0Preserved = 0
	end
	local v184 = p176[p180].Time0Preserved
	if p179 < v182 then
		local v185 = v181 - (v182 - p179)
		v181 = math.max(0, v185)
	end
	if p176.CorrectionReversion == false then
		v181 = p178
	elseif p176.TimeUntilCorrectionReversion <= v184 or p180 == "_ZoomCorrectionValues" and p176.TimeUntilCorrectionReversion / 2 < v184 then
		if p180 == "_ZoomCorrectionValues" then
			local v186 = v181 - p179 * p177 * (p176.CorrectionReversionSpeed * 1.75)
			v181 = math.max(0, v186)
		else
			local v187 = v181 - p179 * p177 * p176.CorrectionReversionSpeed
			v181 = math.max(0, v187)
		end
	elseif v181 < p178 then
		v181 = p178
	end
	p176[p180].LastCorrectionReturned = v181
	p176[p180].LastMangitude = p179
	p176[p180].LastCorrection = p178
	return v181
end
function v_u_43._ApplyCorrectionForAxis(p188, p189, p190, p191, p192, p193, p194) -- name: _ApplyCorrectionForAxis
	local v195 = p188.RaycastChannel:Cast(p190, p192 + p192.Unit * p188._CollisionRadius)
	local v196
	if v195 then
		v196 = p188:_GetProperCorrection(p193, (v195.Position + v195.Normal * p188._CollisionRadius - p191).Magnitude, p192.Magnitude, p194)
	else
		v196 = p188:_GetProperCorrection(p193, 0, p192.Magnitude, p194)
	end
	return p189 + -p192.Unit * v196
end

			p234._CurrentGamepadSpeed = 0
		end
	else

		p234._CurrentGamepadSpeed = p234._CurrentGamepadSpeed + 6 * (v239 ^ 2 / 0.7)

function v_u_43._OnInputChanged(p242, p243, p244) -- name: _OnInputChanged
	if p244 == true or (p242.MouseLocked == false or p242.FreeCamMode == true) then
		return
	elseif p243.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		p242:_ApplyInput(-p243.Delta.X * p242.MouseRadsPerPixel.X, -p243.Delta.Y * p242.MouseRadsPerPixel.Y)
		return
	elseif p243.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
		p242._GamepadPan = Vector2.new(p243.Position.X, p243.Position.Y)
	elseif p243.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if #p242._ActiveTouchInputs == 1 then
			local v245 = Vector2.new(p243.Delta.X, p243.Delta.Y) * -1 * p242.TouchSensitivityModifier
			p242:_ApplyInput(v245.X, v245.Y)
			return
		end
		if #p242._ActiveTouchInputs == 2 and (p242.ZoomLocked == false and p242._SyncingZoom == false) then
			local v246 = (p242._ActiveTouchInputs[1].Position - p242._ActiveTouchInputs[2].Position).Magnitude
			if p242._LastPinchDiameter then
				p242:_ProcessZoomDelta((v246 - p242._LastPinchDiameter) * -1 * p242.ZoomSpeedTouch)
			end
			p242._LastPinchDiameter = v246
			return
		end
		p242._LastPinchDiameter = nil
	end
end

		end
	end
	return false
end

		return

		p250._ZoomInKeyDown = true
		return

		p250._ActiveTouchInputs[#p250._ActiveTouchInputs + 1] = p251
	end
end

function v_u_1.checkAd(p23) -- name: checkAd
	if not p23.adPart:IsA("Part") then
		error("[SuperBiz] Don\'t modify the AdUnit\'s class, it has to be a Part")
	end
	if not p23.adPart:FindFirstChild("AdSurfaceGui") then
		error("[SuperBiz] Ad part must have a SurfaceGui attached to it with the name \'AdSurfaceGui\'")
	end
end
function v_u_1.gridOfRays(p24) -- name: gridOfRays
	local v25 = p24.adPart
	local _ = p24.adPart.Size.X
	local _ = p24.adPart.Size.Y
	local v26 = { 1, 1, -1 }
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		v26[1] = v26[1] - 0.05
		local v27 = v26[1]
		for _ = 1, 4 do
			v26[2] = v26[2] - 0.1
			local _, _ = p24:buildRay((v25.CFrame * CFrame.new(v25.size.X / 2 * v26[1], v25.size.Y / 2 * v26[2], v25.size.Z / 2 * v26[3])).Position)
		end
		v26[1] = v27
	end
end
function v_u_1.getCornerScreenPoints(p28) -- name: getCornerScreenPoints
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v29 = p28.adPart
	local v30 = require(script.FaceToCorners)[v29.AdSurfaceGui.Face]
	local v31 = {}
	for _, v32 in pairs(v30) do
		local v33, v34 = v_u_11:WorldToViewportPoint((v29.CFrame * CFrame.new(v29.size.X / 2 * v32[1], v29.size.Y / 2 * v32[2], v29.size.Z / 2 * v32[3])).Position)
		if not v34 then
			if v33.X < 0 then
				local v35 = v33.Y
				local v36 = v33.Z
				v33 = Vector3.new(0, v35, v36)
			elseif v33.X > v_u_11.ViewportSize.X then
				local v37 = v_u_11.ViewportSize.X
				local v38 = v33.Y
				local v39 = v33.Z
				v33 = Vector3.new(v37, v38, v39)
			end
			if v33.Y < 0 then
				local v40 = v33.X
				local v41 = v33.Z
				v33 = Vector3.new(v40, 0, v41)
			elseif v33.Y > v_u_11.ViewportSize.Y then
				local v42 = v33.X
				local v43 = v_u_11.ViewportSize.Y
				local v44 = v33.Z
				v33 = Vector3.new(v42, v43, v44)
			end
		end
		table.insert(v31, v33)
	end
	return v31
end
function v_u_1.vectorFromCameraToPosition(_, p45) -- name: vectorFromCameraToPosition
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	return p45 - v_u_11.CFrame.Position
end
function v_u_1.isFirstPerson(_, p46) -- name: isFirstPerson
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	return (p46.CFrame.p - v_u_11.CFrame.p).Magnitude < 1.75
end
function v_u_1.buildRay(p47, p48) -- name: buildRay
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_21
	local v49 = RaycastParams.new()
	local v50 = v_u_17:read("RaycastFilterList")()
	v49.FilterType = v_u_17:read("RaycastFilterType")
	if v49.FilterType == Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist then
		local v51 = game.Players.LocalPlayer
		local v52 = v51.Character or v51.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local v53 = v52:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if v53 and p47:isFirstPerson(v53) then
			local v54 = v52:GetDescendants()
			for _, v55 in ipairs(v54) do
				table.insert(v50, v55)
			end
		end
	end
	v49.FilterDescendantsInstances = v50
	local v56 = v_u_8.new(v49, 0, false, false, 0)
	local v57 = v_u_11.CFrame.Position
	local v58 = p48 - v57
	local v59 = v58.unit
	local v60 = v58.Magnitude
	local v61 = v56:Raycast(v57, v59 * v60)
	if v_u_21 then
		p47:drawRaycast(v57, v60, p48)
	end
	return v61, v58
end
function v_u_1.areaOfTriangle(_, p62, p63, p64) -- name: areaOfTriangle
	local v65 = (p62.x * (p63.y - p64.y) + p63.x * (p64.y - p62.y) + p64.x * (p62.y - p63.y)) / 2
	return math.abs(v65)
end
function v_u_1.getSizeAtDistance(_) -- name: getSizeAtDistance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_1
	local v66 = v_u_11.ViewportSize
	local v67 = v_u_1:getCornerScreenPoints()
	local v68 = v_u_1:areaOfTriangle(v67[1], v67[2], v67[3]) + v_u_1:areaOfTriangle(v67[3], v67[4], v67[1])
	local v69 = v66.Y * v66.X
	local v70 = v68 / v69 * 100
	local v71 = v67[2].x - v67[3].x
	local v72 = math.abs(v71)
	local v73 = v67[2].y - v67[1].y
	return v69, v70, v72, math.abs(v73)
end
function v_u_1.drawRaycast(_, p74, p75, p76) -- name: drawRaycast
	local v77 = Instance.new("Part")
	v77.Name = "Raycast"
	v77.Anchored = true
	v77.CanCollide = false
	v77.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, p75)
	v77.CFrame = lookAt(p76, p74) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -p75 / 2)
	v77.Parent = workspace
end
function v_u_1.detectRaycast(p78) -- name: detectRaycast
	local v79 = p78.adPart.Transparency
	p78.adPart.Transparency = 0
	local v80, v81 = p78:buildRay(p78.adPart.Position)
	p78.adPart.Transparency = v79
	if not v80 or v80.Instance ~= p78.adPart then
		return false
	end
	if normalToFace(v80.Normal, p78.adPart, { p78.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.Face }) then
		local v82 = v81.Unit:Dot(v80.Normal.Unit)
		local v83 = math.acos(v82)
		return v81, 180 - math.deg(v83)
	end
end
function lookAt(p84, p85) -- name: lookAt
	local v86 = (p84 - p85).Unit
	local v87 = v86:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	local v88 = v87:Cross(v86)
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(p85, v87, v88)
end
function normalToFace(p89, p90, p91) -- name: normalToFace
	for _, v92 in pairs(p91) do
		if getNormalFromFace(p90, v92):Dot(p89) > 0.999 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
function getNormalFromFace(p93, p94) -- name: getNormalFromFace
	return p93.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.FromNormalId(p94))
end
function v_u_1.detectScreenpoint(p95) -- name: detectScreenpoint
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local _, v96 = v_u_11:WorldToViewportPoint(p95.adPart.Position)
	return v96 and true or false
end

end

	if p107 == "hover" then

function v_u_1.needsAdRotationForImgOrGifAd(p115) -- name: needsAdRotationForImgOrGifAd
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_20
	local v116 = v_u_20 <= p115.aggregateImpressionTime
	local v117 = not p115.isClientPart
	local v118 = not p115.currentGIF
	if v118 then
		v118 = not p115.currentVideo
	end
	local v119 = not v118
	if v119 then
		v119 = p115.currentGIF
	end
	return (v118 or v119) and (v116 and v117) and true or false
end

	p120.updateAdEvent:FireServer(v_u_9:getClientPlayerStats(v_u_10))

function v_u_1.waitOrDeletePart(p121) -- name: waitOrDeletePart
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_1
	while p121.adPart == nil or p121.adPart.Parent == nil do
		p121.isAdDisplaying = false
		if not v_u_12:WaitForChild("updateAdEvent-" .. p121.adPartName, 5) then
			v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Ad client stopped!")
			p121:cleanupGif()
			p121:cleanupVideo()
			script:Destroy()
			return false
		end
		p121.adPart = v_u_1:waitForPart(p121.adPartName, 120)
	end
	return p121.adPart
end
function v_u_1.backgroundProcess(p122) -- name: backgroundProcess
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_19
	while true do
		if p122.debugAPI and (p122.adPart and p122.adPart.Parent) then
			p122.debugAPI.EndImpression(p122.adPart.AdSurfaceGui)
		end
		if not p122:waitOrDeletePart() then
			return
		end
		local v123 = not p122.currentGIF
		if v123 then
			v123 = not p122.currentVideo
		end
		if not p122.isAdDisplaying and (p122.currentURL and v123) then
			p122:displayAd(p122.currentAdFormat, p122.currentURL, p122.currentBloxbizAdId, p122.currentAdExternalLinkReferences, p122.currentGIFFPS, p122.currentGIFVersion, p122.currentAudioUrl, p122.showAdDisclaimer, p122.ad_disclaimer_url, p122.ad_disclaimer_scale_x, p122.ad_disclaimer_scale_y, p122.currentBillType)
		end
		p122.isAdDisplaying = true
		local v124, v125 = pcall(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			v_u_1:detectAndMeasureImpression()
		end)
		if not v124 or p122.adPart.Parent == nil then
			if v125 then
				v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Error: " .. v125)
			else
				v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Warning: Ad part has no parent. Possibly due to streaming.")
			end
		end
		if p122:needsAdRotationForImgOrGifAd() then
			p122:requestAdRotation()
		end
		task.wait(v_u_19)
	end
end
function timeInMs() -- name: timeInMs
	return os.clock()
end
function v_u_1.detectAndMeasureImpression(p126) -- name: detectAndMeasureImpression
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_19
	local v127 = v_u_11.CFrame.Position
	local v128 = p126.adPart.Position - v127
	local _ = v128.unit
	local v129 = v128.Magnitude
	if p126.isClientPart and v_u_22 < v129 then
		return
	end
	local v130, v131 = p126:detectImpression()
	if not v130 then
		return
	end
	local _, v132, v133, v134 = p126:getSizeAtDistance(v129)
	local v135 = os.time()
	local v136 = timeInMs()
	local v137 = p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image
	local v138 = p126.currentBloxbizAdId
	local v139 = p126.currentURLsDict
	local v140 = p126.currentVideo
	if not (v139[v137] or p126.isClientPart) then
		task.wait(v_u_19)
		return
	end
	local v141 = {
		{ v136, v131, v132 }
	}
	local v142
	if p126.debugAPI then
		v142 = p126.debugAPI.StartImpression(p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui, {
			["URL"] = nil,
			["PixelWidth"] = nil,
			["PixelHeight"] = nil,
			["Time"] = 0,
			["VideoTime"] = 0,
			["Per"] = nil,
			["Angle"] = nil,
			["URL"] = v137,
			["PixelWidth"] = v133,
			["PixelHeight"] = v134,
			["Per"] = v132,
			["Angle"] = v131
		})
	else
		v142 = nil
	end
	local v143 = 1
	local v144 = 0
	local v145 = p126.aggregateImpressionTime
	local v146 = not p126.isClientPart
	if v146 then
		v146 = v139[p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image]
	end
	local v147
	if v140 == p126.currentVideo then
		v147 = true
	else
		v147 = false
	end
	while v146 and (v147 and (v143 < 200 and not p126:needsAdRotationForImgOrGifAd())) do
		local v148, v149 = p126:detectImpression()
		if not v148 then
			p126.viewabilityMetEvent:Fire(false)
			break
		end
		local _, v150 = p126:getSizeAtDistance()
		p126.viewabilityMetEvent:Fire(true, v150, v149)
		local v151 = { timeInMs(), v149, v150 }
		table.insert(v141, v151)
		if p126.debugAPI then
			local v152 = p126.currentVideo
			if v152 then
				v152 = p126.currentVideo:getAnalytics()
			end
			local v153 = v152 and v152.playEndSeconds or 0
			p126.debugAPI.UpdateImpressions(v142, {
				["URL"] = v137,
				["PixelWidth"] = v133,
				["PixelHeight"] = v134,
				["Time"] = timeInMs() - v136,
				["VideoTime"] = v153,
				["Per"] = v150,
				["Angle"] = v149
			})
		end
		v143 = v143 + 1
		task.wait(v_u_19)
		v144 = timeInMs() - v136
		p126.aggregateImpressionTime = v145 + v144
		v146 = not p126.isClientPart
		if v146 then
			v146 = v139[p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image]
		end
		v147 = v140 == p126.currentVideo
	end
	if p126.debugAPI then
		local v154 = p126.currentVideo
		if v154 then
			v154 = p126.currentVideo:getAnalytics()
		end
		local v155 = v154 and v154.playEndSeconds or 0
		p126.debugAPI.UpdateImpressions(v142, {
			["URL"] = v137,
			["PixelWidth"] = v133,
			["PixelHeight"] = v134,
			["Time"] = timeInMs() - v136,
			["VideoTime"] = v155,
			["Per"] = v132,
			["Angle"] = v131
		})
		p126.debugAPI.EndImpression(p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui)
	end
	p126:sendImpression(v137, v138, v135, v144, v141, p126.isClientPart)
end
function v_u_1.detectImpression(p156) -- name: detectImpression
	if p156:detectScreenpoint() then
		return p156:detectRaycast()
	else
		return false
	end
end

end

function v_u_1.isAdCompliantWithPolicy(_, p169) -- name: isAdCompliantWithPolicy
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10
	if #p169 == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local v170 = v_u_9:getPlayerPolicyInfo(v_u_10).AllowedExternalLinkReferences
	local v171 = tableToDict(v170)
	local v172 = true
	for _, v173 in ipairs(p169) do
		if not v171[v173] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return v172
end
function v_u_1.displayAd(p_u_174, p_u_175, p_u_176, p_u_177, p178, p_u_179, p_u_180, p_u_181, p_u_182, p_u_183, p_u_184, p_u_185, p_u_186) -- name: displayAd
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7
	if p_u_174:isAdCompliantWithPolicy(p178) then
		local v187
		if (p_u_175 == "gif" or p_u_175 == "video") and p_u_180 ~= 1 then
			v187 = {}
			for _, v188 in ipairs(p_u_176) do
				local v189 = v188.ad_url
				table.insert(v187, v189)
			end
		else
			v187 = p_u_176
		end
		p_u_174.currentAdFormat = p_u_175
		p_u_174.currentURL = p_u_176
		p_u_174.currentURLsDict = tableToDict(v187)
		p_u_174.currentBloxbizAdId = p_u_177
		p_u_174.currentBillType = p_u_186
		p_u_174.currentAdExternalLinkReferences = p178
		p_u_174.currentGIFFPS = p_u_179
		p_u_174.currentGIFVersion = p_u_180
		p_u_174.currentAudioUrl = p_u_181
		p_u_174.aggregateImpressionTime = 0
		p_u_174.showAdDisclaimer = p_u_182
		p_u_174.ad_disclaimer_url = p_u_183
		p_u_174.ad_disclaimer_scale_x = p_u_184
		p_u_174.ad_disclaimer_scale_y = p_u_185
		local _, _ = pcall(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_174, (copy) p_u_182, (copy) p_u_183, (copy) p_u_184, (copy) p_u_185, (copy) p_u_175, (copy) p_u_176, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_179, (copy) p_u_180, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) p_u_181, (copy) p_u_177, (copy) p_u_186
			p_u_174:setDisclaimer(p_u_182, p_u_183, p_u_184, p_u_185)
			p_u_174:cleanupGif()
			p_u_174:cleanupVideo()
			if p_u_175 == "static" then
				p_u_174.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image = p_u_176[1]
			elseif p_u_175 == "gif" then
				if not p_u_174.currentGIF then
					p_u_174.currentGIF = v_u_6:init(p_u_176, p_u_179, p_u_174.adPart, p_u_180)
					return
				end
			elseif p_u_175 == "video" and not p_u_174.currentVideo then
				p_u_174.currentVideo = v_u_7:init(p_u_174, p_u_176, p_u_179, p_u_174.adPart, p_u_180, p_u_181, p_u_177, p_u_186)
			end
		end)
	end
end

	local v192 = p190:split(".")
	table.remove(v192, 1)
	local v193 = workspace
	for _, v194 in ipairs(v192) do

end
function v_u_1.initAd(p_u_195, p196, p197, p198) -- name: initAd
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_5
	local v199 = nil
	local v200 = nil
	if v_u_17:read("DebugMode") or v_u_17:read("DebugModeVideoAd") then
		p_u_195.debugAPI = require(v_u_17:read("DebugAPI")())
	end
	if p197 then
		p_u_195.isClientPart = true
	else
		p_u_195.isClientPart = false
		p197 = v199
	end
	while p197 == nil do
		p197 = v_u_1:waitForPart(p196, 120)
		v200 = v_u_12:WaitForChild("updateAdEvent-" .. p196, 5)
		if v200 == nil then
			v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Ad client never started, possibly due to streaming.")
			script:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end
	v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Ad client started!")
	p_u_195.adPart = p197
	p_u_195.adPartName = p196
	p_u_195.viewabilityMetEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	p_u_195.updateAdEvent = v200
	p_u_195:checkAd()
	if p_u_195.isClientPart then
		if p_u_195.isClientPart then
			if p198 then
				p_u_195.clientPartData = p198
				p_u_195.currentBloxbizAdId = p198.bloxbiz_ad_id
			elseif p_u_195.adPart:FindFirstChild("BLOXBIZ_CONSTANT_ID") then
				p_u_195.currentBloxbizAdId = p_u_195.adPart.BLOXBIZ_CONSTANT_ID.Value
			end
		end
	else
		v200.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p201)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_195

function v_u_44.prototype.cancel(p291) -- name: cancel

function v_u_45.MarkAllForRefresh(p98, p99) -- name: MarkAllForRefresh
	for _, v100 in pairs(p98.FeedsById) do
		if not p99 or p99(v100) then
			v100.ShouldRefresh:set(true)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_45.ResetFeed(p101, p102) -- name: ResetFeed
	local v103 = p101.FeedsById[p102]
	local v104 = v103.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v105 = p101.OutfitsCache
	for _, v106 in ipairs(v104) do
		local v107 = type(v106) == "string" and v106 and v106 or v106.guid
		if v105[v107] then
			v105[v107].Frame:Destroy()
			v105[v107].Frame = nil
			v105[v107] = nil
		end
	end
	v103.Page:set(0)
	v103.LastRefresh:set(tick())
	v103.LoadedOutfits:set({})
	v103.LoadedAll:set(false)
	v103.ScrollY:set(0)
end
function v_u_45.SwitchToFeed(p_u_108, p109, p110) -- name: SwitchToFeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
	p_u_108:CancelLoading()
	if p109 ~= "top" then
		p_u_108.TopDropdownOpen:set(false)
	end
	p_u_108.States.Loading:set(true)
	p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(true)
	local v_u_111 = p_u_108.FeedsById[p109]
	v_u_111.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v_u_111.LoadFailed:set(false)
	local v112 = v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:get() and true or p110
	if not v_u_111.Searchable then
		p_u_108.States.Query:set(v_u_44)
	end
	if v112 or tick() - v_u_111.LastRefresh:get() > 60 then
		v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:set(false)
		p_u_108:ResetFeed(p109)
	end
	local v_u_113 = p_u_108.GuiObjects.ScrollingFrame
	v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	p_u_108:ClearWindow()
	task.wait(0.1)
	local v114 = v112 and {} or v_u_111.LoadedOutfits:get()
	if #v114 > 0 then
		p_u_108:RenderOutfits(v114, 0, true):andThen(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_111
			v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, v_u_111.ScrollY:get() or 0)
		end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108
			p_u_108.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end)
	else
		p_u_108:LoadNextPage()
		v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_45.UpdateFilters(p115) -- name: UpdateFilters
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27
	local v116 = p115.States.Query:get().keywords
	if v116 then
		v116 = #v116 > 0
	end
	local v117 = v_u_27.deepCopy(p115.FilterTabs:get())
	for v118, v119 in pairs(v117) do
		if v116 then
			local v120 = v117[v118]
			local v121 = v119.Internal
			if not v121 then
				local v122 = v119.Searchable or v119.SearchOnly
				v121 = not v122
			end
			v120.Hidden = v121
		else
			v117[v118].Hidden = v119.Internal or v119.SearchOnly
		end
	end
	p115.FilterTabs:set(v117)
	p115:MarkAllForRefresh()
	local v_u_123 = p115.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v125 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p124)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
		return p124.Id == v_u_123
	end)
	if p115.Enabled and (not v125 or v125.Hidden) then
		local v127 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p126)
			return not p126.Hidden
		end)
		p115.States.CurrentFeedId:set(v127.Id)
		p115:SwitchToFeed(v127.Id, true)
	end
end
function v_u_45.LoadNextPage(p_u_128) -- name: LoadNextPage
	p_u_128.States.Loading:set(true)
	local v129 = p_u_128.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v130 = p_u_128.FeedsById[v129]
	v130.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v130.LoadFailed:set(false)
	v130.Page:set(v130.Page:get() + 1)
	local v131 = v130.Page:get()
	local v132 = v130.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v133, v134 = p_u_128:GetOutfitsFromFeedId(v130.Id, p_u_128.States.Query:get(), v131)
	if v133 then
		if #v134 > 0 then
			p_u_128:RenderOutfits(v134, #v132, v131 == 1):andThen(function() end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_128
				p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
				p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
			end)
			for _, v135 in v134 do
				table.insert(v132, v135)

local function v_u_77(p67, p68) -- name: IsSameOutfit
	for v69, v70 in pairs(p68) do
		if not p67[v69] then
			return false
		end
		if v69 == "BodyColors" then
			for v71, v72 in pairs(p68.BodyColors) do
				if v70[v71] ~= v72 then
					return false
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for v73, v74 in pairs(p67) do
		if not p68[v73] then
			return false
		end
		if v73 == "BodyColors" then
			for v75, v76 in pairs(p67.BodyColors) do
				if v74[v75] ~= v76 then
					return false
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function v_u_79.LoadCurrentOutfit(p_u_122, p123, p_u_124) -- name: LoadCurrentOutfit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_17
	local v125 = p123 or p_u_122.AvatarObjects.Humanoid
	local v126, v127, v_u_128 = v_u_25.GetCurrentOutfit(p_u_122.EquippedItems:get(), v125)
	v126.BodyColors = v_u_25.GetCurrentBodyColors(v125:GetAppliedDescription())

			local v132 = v131.AssetId

	local v134 = #v127 > 0

		v134 = #v127 - 1 > 0
	end

		p_u_122.Controllers.BodyEditorController:UpdateSliders(v_u_128)
	end
	if v_u_33.PersistentWear then
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_124, (copy) p_u_122, (copy) v_u_128, (ref) v_u_17
			if p_u_124 then
				p_u_122:ApplyOutfit(p_u_122.EquippedItems:get(), v_u_128)

			if not (v135:FindFirstChild("Head") or v135:FindFirstChild("DynamicHead")) then
				v_u_17.pprint("Dynamic head was unable to load due to Roblox bug, reverting to default head")
				v_u_128.Head = 2432102561

			end

		end)

		p_u_122.OutfitLoaded:Fire()

end

function v_u_79.SaveChange(p161) -- name: SaveChange
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_10
	if p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce then
		return
	else
		p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce = true
		local v162 = p161.AvatarObjects.Humanoid
		local v163 = v_u_25.GetCurrentBodyColors(v162:GetAppliedDescription())
		local v164 = p161.EquippedItems:get()
		if p161:IsSavedOutfit(v164, v163) then
			p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce = false
		else
			if v_u_10:InvokeServer(v164, v163) then
				p161.SaveDisabled:set(true)
			else
				p161:UpdateSaveButton()
			end
			p161.Debounces.SaveOutfitDebounce = false
		end
	end
end
function v_u_79.GetMaxOrder(p165) -- name: GetMaxOrder
	local v166 = p165.AvatarObjects.Humanoid:GetAppliedDescription():GetAccessories(false)
	local v167 = 0

		v167 = math.max(v167, v169)
	end

end

[Module] -> ReplicatedStorage.KnitPackages._Index.sleitnick_tree@1.1.0.tree
    [========== SCRIPT: tree ==========]
return {
	["Find"] = function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: Find
		local v4 = p1
		for _, v5 in p2:split("/") do
			if v5 == "" then
				error(("Invalid path: %*"):format(p2), 2)
			end
			p1 = p1:FindFirstChild(v5)
			if p1 == nil then
				error(("Failed to find %* in %*"):format(p2, (v4:GetFullName():gsub("%.", "/"))), 2)
			end
		end
		if p3 and not p1:IsA(p3) then
			error(("Got class %*; expected to be of type %*"):format(p1.ClassName, p3), 2)
		end
		return p1
	end,
	["Exists"] = function(p6, p7, p8) -- name: Exists
		for _, v9 in p7:split("/") do

		p_u_19.leftValue = p22 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and -1 or 0
		p_u_19:UpdateMovement(p22)
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end, false, p_u_19.CONTROL_ACTION_PRIORITY, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterLeft)
	v_u_2:BindActionAtPriority("moveRightAction", function(_, p23, _)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_19
		p_u_19.rightValue = p23 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and 1 or 0
		p_u_19:UpdateMovement(p23)
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end, false, p_u_19.CONTROL_ACTION_PRIORITY, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterRight)
	v_u_2:BindActionAtPriority("jumpAction", function(_, p24, _)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_19
		local v25 = p_u_19
		local v26 = p_u_19.jumpEnabled
		if v26 then
			v26 = p24 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin
		end
		v25.jumpRequested = v26
		p_u_19:UpdateJump()
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end, false, p_u_19.CONTROL_ACTION_PRIORITY, Enum.PlayerActions.CharacterJump)
	if v_u_4 then
		p_u_19._connections:connectManual("moveForwardAction", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
			v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveForwardAction")
		end)
		p_u_19._connections:connectManual("moveBackwardAction", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
			v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveBackwardAction")
		end)
		p_u_19._connections:connectManual("moveLeftAction", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
			v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveLeftAction")
		end)
		p_u_19._connections:connectManual("moveRightAction", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
			v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveRightAction")
		end)
		p_u_19._connections:connectManual("jumpAction", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
			v_u_2:UnbindAction("jumpAction")
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_7.UnbindContextActions(_) -- name: UnbindContextActions
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveForwardAction")
	v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveBackwardAction")
	v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveLeftAction")
	v_u_2:UnbindAction("moveRightAction")
	v_u_2:UnbindAction("jumpAction")
end
function v_u_7.ConnectFocusEventListeners(p_u_27) -- name: ConnectFocusEventListeners
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1
	local function v28() -- name: onFocusReleased
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_27, (ref) v_u_5
		p_u_27.moveVector = v_u_5
		p_u_27.forwardValue = 0
		p_u_27.backwardValue = 0
		p_u_27.leftValue = 0
		p_u_27.rightValue = 0
		p_u_27.jumpRequested = false
		p_u_27:UpdateJump()
	end
	local function v29(_) -- name: onTextFocusGained
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_27
		p_u_27.jumpRequested = false
		p_u_27:UpdateJump()
	end
	if v_u_4 then
		p_u_27._connections:connect("textBoxFocusReleased", v_u_1.TextBoxFocusReleased, v28)
		p_u_27._connections:connect("textBoxFocused", v_u_1.TextBoxFocused, v29)
		p_u_27._connections:connect("windowFocusReleased", v_u_1.WindowFocused, v28)
	else
		p_u_27.textFocusReleasedConn = v_u_1.TextBoxFocusReleased:Connect(v28)
		p_u_27.textFocusGainedConn = v_u_1.TextBoxFocused:Connect(v29)
		p_u_27.windowFocusReleasedConn = v_u_1.WindowFocused:Connect(v28)
	end
end
function v_u_7.DisconnectFocusEventListeners(p30) -- name: DisconnectFocusEventListeners
	if p30.textFocusReleasedConn then
		p30.textFocusReleasedConn:Disconnect()
		p30.textFocusReleasedConn = nil
	end
	if p30.textFocusGainedConn then
		p30.textFocusGainedConn:Disconnect()
		p30.textFocusGainedConn = nil
	end
	if p30.windowFocusReleasedConn then
		p30.windowFocusReleasedConn:Disconnect()
		p30.windowFocusReleasedConn = nil
	end
end
return v_u_7

[REMOTE] RemoteEvent (RemoteEvent) -> Workspace.NPCs.VehicleShop.VehicleSeller.npc ban xe.Rotation.RemoteEvent
    Родитель: Script (Workspace.NPCs.VehicleShop.VehicleSeller.npc ban xe.Rotation)
Workspace.NPCs.VehicleShop.VehicleSeller.npc ban xe.Rotation.Rotation
    [========== SCRIPT: Rotation ==========]
wait(5)
local v_u_1 = workspace.CurrentCamera
local v2 = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local v3 = v2.Character or v2.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local v_u_4 = v3:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local v5 = v3:FindFirstChild("Neck", true)
local v6 = v3:FindFirstChild("Waist", true)
local v7 = v5:Clone()
v5.Enabled = false
local v_u_8 = v7
v7.Parent = v3.Head
local _ = v6.C0
local v_u_9 = v_u_8.C0.Y
local _ = v6.C0.Y
v3:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
local v_u_10 = script.Parent:WaitForChild("RemoteEvent")
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10
	local v11 = v_u_4.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v_u_1.CFrame).LookVector
	v_u_8.C0 = CFrame.new(0, v_u_9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -v11.X, 0) * CFrame.Angles(v11.Y, 0, 0)
	v_u_10:FireServer(v_u_8.C0)

    [========== SCRIPT: Rotation ==========]
wait(5)
local v_u_1 = workspace.CurrentCamera
local v2 = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local v3 = v2.Character or v2.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local v_u_4 = v3:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local v5 = v3:FindFirstChild("Neck", true)
local v6 = v3:FindFirstChild("Waist", true)
local v7 = v5:Clone()
v5.Enabled = false
local v_u_8 = v7
v7.Parent = v3.Head
local _ = v6.C0
local v_u_9 = v_u_8.C0.Y
local _ = v6.C0.Y
v3:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
local v_u_10 = script.Parent:WaitForChild("RemoteEvent")
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10
	local v11 = v_u_4.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v_u_1.CFrame).LookVector
	v_u_8.C0 = CFrame.new(0, v_u_9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, -v11.X, 0) * CFrame.Angles(v11.Y, 0, 0)
	v_u_10:FireServer(v_u_8.C0)
end)

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p23, p24) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p23 == nil or p24 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v25 = 1, p23.count do
		if p23[v25].anim.AnimationId == p24.AnimationId then
			return v25
		end
	end
	return 0
end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_26, p_u_27) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_20[p_u_26] ~= nil then
		for _, v28 in pairs(v_u_20[p_u_26].connections) do
			v28:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_20[p_u_26] = {}
	v_u_20[p_u_26].count = 0
	v_u_20[p_u_26].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_20[p_u_26].connections = {}
	local v_u_29 = true
	local v30, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29
		v_u_29 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations
	end)
	v_u_29 = not v30 and true or v_u_29
	local v31 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_26)
	if v_u_29 and v31 ~= nil then
		local v32 = v_u_20[p_u_26].connections
		local v33 = v31.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v32, v33:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_26, (copy) p_u_27
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_26, p_u_27)
		end))
		local v34 = v_u_20[p_u_26].connections
		local v35 = v31.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v34, v35:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_26, (copy) p_u_27
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_26, p_u_27)
		end))
		for _, v36 in pairs(v31:GetChildren()) do
			if v36:IsA("Animation") then
				local v37 = v36:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v38 = v37 == nil and 1 or v37.Value
				v_u_20[p_u_26].count = v_u_20[p_u_26].count + 1
				local v39 = v_u_20[p_u_26].count
				v_u_20[p_u_26][v39] = {}
				v_u_20[p_u_26][v39].anim = v36
				v_u_20[p_u_26][v39].weight = v38
				v_u_20[p_u_26].totalWeight = v_u_20[p_u_26].totalWeight + v_u_20[p_u_26][v39].weight
				local v40 = v_u_20[p_u_26].connections
				local v41 = v36.Changed
				table.insert(v40, v41:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_26, (copy) p_u_27
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_26, p_u_27)
				end))
				local v42 = v_u_20[p_u_26].connections
				local v43 = v36.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v42, v43:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_26, (copy) p_u_27
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_26, p_u_27)
				end))
				local v44 = v_u_20[p_u_26].connections
				local v45 = v36.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_26, (copy) p_u_27
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_26, p_u_27)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_20[p_u_26].count <= 0 then
		for v46, v47 in pairs(p_u_27) do
			v_u_20[p_u_26][v46] = {}
			v_u_20[p_u_26][v46].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_20[p_u_26][v46].anim.Name = p_u_26
			v_u_20[p_u_26][v46].anim.AnimationId = v47.id
			v_u_20[p_u_26][v46].weight = v47.weight
			v_u_20[p_u_26].count = v_u_20[p_u_26].count + 1
			v_u_20[p_u_26].totalWeight = v_u_20[p_u_26].totalWeight + v47.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v48 in pairs(v_u_20) do
		for v49 = 1, v48.count do
			if v_u_19[v48[v49].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v48[v49].anim)
				v_u_19[v48[v49].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_10()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_10()
	end
	local v82 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_11 == nil then
		v_u_11 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_11 ~= nil then
		v82 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_11.Value / 2
	end
	return v82
end
local function v_u_88(p83) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_17
	local v84 = p83 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v85 = 0.0001
	local v86 = 0.0001
	local v87 = 1
	if v84 <= 0.5 then
		v87 = v84 / 0.5
		v85 = 1
	elseif v84 < 1 then
		v86 = (v84 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v85 = 1 - v86
	else
		v87 = v84 / 1
		v86 = 1
	end
	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v85)
	v_u_17:AdjustWeight(v86)
	v_u_14:AdjustSpeed(v87)
	v_u_17:AdjustSpeed(v87)
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_22, (ref) v_u_79, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2

function rollAnimation(p94) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_20
	local v95 = math.random(1, v_u_20[p94].totalWeight)
	local v96 = 1
	while v_u_20[p94][v96].weight < v95 do
		v95 = v95 - v_u_20[p94][v96].weight
		v96 = v96 + 1
	end
	return v96
end

function stepAnimate(p130) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_129, (ref) v_u_78, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_112
	local v131 = p130 - v_u_129
	v_u_129 = p130
	if v_u_78 > 0 then
		v_u_78 = v_u_78 - v131
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_78 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v132 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v132 and v132:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v133 = getToolAnim(v132)
		if v133 then
			v_u_76 = v133.Value
			v133.Parent = nil
			v_u_77 = p130 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_77 < p130 then
			v_u_77 = 0
			v_u_76 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_76 = "None"
		v_u_112 = nil
		v_u_77 = 0
	end
end

    [========== SCRIPT: HealthDisplay ==========]
local v_u_1 = game:GetService("TweenService")
return {
	["Init"] = function(_, p_u_2) -- name: Init
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2
			for _, v3 in pairs(p_u_2:GetChildren()) do
				if v3:IsA("UnionOperation") or (v3:IsA("Part") or (v3:IsA("MeshPart") or v3:IsA("BasePart"))) then
					v3.CollisionGroup = "Player"
					v3.CanCollide = false
				elseif v3:IsA("Accessory") then
					for _, v4 in pairs(v3:GetDescendants()) do
						if v4:IsA("UnionOperation") or (v4:IsA("Part") or (v4:IsA("MeshPart") or v4:IsA("BasePart"))) then
							v4.CollisionGroup = "Player"
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		local v_u_5 = p_u_2:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if v_u_5 then
			script.HealthDisplay:Clone().Parent = v_u_5
			local v_u_6 = p_u_2:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
			v_u_6.HealthChanged:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2, (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_1
				if p_u_2 then
					if v_u_6.Health <= 0.01 then
						return
					else
						v_u_5 = p_u_2:FindFirstChild("Head")
						if v_u_5 then
							local v7 = v_u_5:FindFirstChild("HealthDisplay")
							if v7 then
								v7.Enabled = true
								local v8 = v_u_6.Health / v_u_6.MaxHealth
								if v8 <= 0.5 and v8 > 0.15 then
									v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
										["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(199, 183, 61)
									}):Play()
								elseif v8 <= 0.15 then
									v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
										["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(199, 44, 47)
									}):Play()
								else
									v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
										["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(72, 194, 53)
									}):Play()
								end
								v_u_1:Create(v7.CanvasGroup.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
									["Size"] = UDim2.new(v8, 0, 1, 0)
								}):Play()
							end
						end
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end)
		end
	end
}

	function v2.Start(p12) -- name: Start

		if v_u_1:IsServer() then

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48

			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),

		end
	end
	for v120, _ in pairs(p113) do

		end
	end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")

			["Seat"] = true,

		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end

		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)

					end

						return
					end

						v_u_144:cleanup()

					end
				end
			end

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()

		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart

			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)

		end

			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then

		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p27, p28) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p27 == nil or p28 == nil then
		return 0
	end
	for v29 = 1, p27.count do
		if p27[v29].anim.AnimationId == p28.AnimationId then
			return v29
		end
	end
	return 0
end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_14[p_u_30] ~= nil then
		for _, v32 in pairs(v_u_14[p_u_30].connections) do
			v32:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_14[p_u_30] = {}
	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33
		v_u_33 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations
	end)
	v_u_33 = not v34 and true or v_u_33
	local v35 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_30)
	if v_u_33 and v35 ~= nil then
		local v36 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v37 = v35.ChildAdded
		table.insert(v36, v37:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		local v38 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v38, v39:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
		end))
		for _, v40 in pairs(v35:GetChildren()) do
			if v40:IsA("Animation") then
				local v41 = v40:FindFirstChild("Weight")
				local v42 = v41 == nil and 1 or v41.Value
				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight = v42
				v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].weight
				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed
				table.insert(v44, v45:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.Name = p_u_30
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim.AnimationId = v51.id
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].weight = v51.weight
			v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
			v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight + v51.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do
		for v53 = 1, v52.count do
			if v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] == nil then
				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)
				v_u_13[v52[v53].anim.AnimationId] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback

		p_u_239()

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil

				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144

			["Seat"] = true,

		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end

		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144

				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)

					end

function v_u_17.getRandomPoint(p203) -- name: getRandomPoint

	local v207 = Random.new()
	local v208 = nil
	repeat
		local v209 = v206 * CFrame.new(v207:NextNumber(-v205.X / 2, v205.X / 2), v207:NextNumber(-v205.Y / 2, v205.Y / 2), v207:NextNumber(-v205.Z / 2, v205.Z / 2))

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then

		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then

end

end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6

		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart

			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)

		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then

		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value

		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end

	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end

	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")

	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25

				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					p52.Values[v54] = v55
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._update(p_u_82) -- name: _update

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)

					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true

						return
					end

						v_u_144:cleanup()

					end
				end
			end

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146

			p_u_138.CanTouch = true

			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001

end

function v_u_17.getParts(p197) -- name: getParts

	else

		for _, v202 in pairs(v201) do

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count

				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))

	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then

			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do

			end
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1

		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5

	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)

end

	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)

	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight

	end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then

			end

		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do

			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}

function v_u_17._update(p_u_82) -- name: _update

		end
	end
	local v98 = { "Size", "Position" }

function v_u_17._updateOccupants(p111, p112, p113) -- name: _updateOccupants

	for v116, v117 in pairs(v114) do

			v114[v116] = nil
			if not v115.exited then
				v115.exited = {}
			end
			local v119 = v115.exited
			table.insert(v119, v116)
		end
	end
	for v120, _ in pairs(p113) do

			v114[v120] = v120:IsA("Player") and (v120.Character or true) or true
			if not v115.entered then

			table.insert(v121, v120)
		end
	end
	return v115
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148
				local v149 = p_u_137:findPoint(p_u_138.CFrame) or p_u_137:findPart(p_u_138)
				if v_u_141 then
					if not v149 then
						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()
						p_u_137.partExited:Fire(p_u_138)
					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		v_u_144:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

		v208 = v210 and true or v208

function v_u_17.trackItem(p_u_218, p_u_219) -- name: trackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v220 = p_u_219:IsA("BasePart")
	local v221
	if v220 then
		v221 = false
	else
		v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v221 then
			v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end
	assert(v220 or v221, "Only BaseParts or Characters/NPCs can be tracked!")
	if not p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] then
		if p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] then
			p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] = nil
		end
		local v222 = p_u_218.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		local v223 = {
			["janitor"] = v222,
			["item"] = p_u_219,
			["isBasePart"] = v220,
			["isCharacter"] = v221
		}
		p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] = v223
		v222:add(p_u_219.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_219, (copy) p_u_218
			if not p_u_219:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				p_u_218:untrackItem(p_u_219)
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		require(v_u_12).itemAdded:Fire(v223)
	end
end
function v_u_17.untrackItem(p224, p225) -- name: untrackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v226 = p224.trackedItems[p225]
	if v226 then
		v226.janitor:destroy()
	end
	p224.trackedItems[p225] = nil
	require(v_u_12).itemRemoved:Fire(v226)
end

			v230._memberZones[p229.zoneId] = nil
		end
		p229.settingsGroupName = nil
	end
end
function v_u_17.relocate(p231) -- name: relocate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13
	if not p231.hasRelocated then
		local v232 = require(v_u_13).setupWorldModel(p231)
		p231.worldModel = v232
		p231.hasRelocated = true
		local v233 = p231.container
		if typeof(v233) == "table" then
			v233 = Instance.new("Folder")
			for _, v234 in pairs(p231.zoneParts) do
				v234.Parent = v233
			end
		end
		p231.relocationContainer = p231.janitor:add(v233, "Destroy", "RelocationContainer")
		v233.Parent = v232
	end
end
function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_17.onItemEnter(p243, ...) -- name: onItemEnter

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil

	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				end))

				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1

		v93 = v90 / 0.5

		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5

	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)

end

	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)

	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do

	end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function animateTool() -- name: animateTool
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_82, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_82 == "None" then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
		return
	elseif v_u_82 == "Slash" then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	elseif v_u_82 == "Lunge" then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	end
end
function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim
	for _, v144 in ipairs(p143:GetChildren()) do
		if v144.Name == "toolanim" and v144.className == "StringValue" then
			return v144
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count

				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))

	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then

			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

	for _, v52 in pairs(v_u_14) do

			end
		end
	end
end
