function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1

		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5

	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)

end

	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)

	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight

	end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim

			return v144
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

	local v151 = ""

		v151 = string.sub(p150, 4)

		v151 = string.sub(p150, 8)
	end
	if v_u_3 == "Standing" and v_u_16[v151] ~= nil then
		playAnimation(v151, 0.1, v_u_2)
	end
end)

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_8
	if v_u_3 == "Standing" then
		if v_u_16[p152] ~= nil then
			playAnimation(p152, 0.1, v_u_2)
			return true, v_u_8
		end
		if typeof(p152) ~= "Instance" or not p152:IsA("Animation") then
			return false
		end
		playEmote(p152, 0.1, v_u_2)
		return true, v_u_8
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil

		end)

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()

			end

	end
	return true
end

end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation

	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1

	end

end

		end
		v_u_10 = 1
		v_u_8 = p106:LoadAnimation(p103)
		v_u_8.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

			v_u_9:disconnect()

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function animateTool() -- name: animateTool
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_82, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_82 == "None" then

		return
	elseif v_u_82 == "Slash" then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
		return
	elseif v_u_82 == "Lunge" then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, v_u_2, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	end
end
function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim

	return nil
end
local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

		v_u_17 = nil

		v_u_19 = nil

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then

	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118

			end

		end

		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),

function v_u_17._updateOccupants(p111, p112, p113) -- name: _updateOccupants

		end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148
				local v149 = p_u_137:findPoint(p_u_138.CFrame) or p_u_137:findPart(p_u_138)
				if v_u_141 then
					if not v149 then
						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()
						p_u_137.partExited:Fire(p_u_138)
					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		v_u_144:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

function v_u_17.trackItem(p_u_218, p_u_219) -- name: trackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v220 = p_u_219:IsA("BasePart")
	local v221
	if v220 then
		v221 = false
	else
		v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v221 then
			v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end
	assert(v220 or v221, "Only BaseParts or Characters/NPCs can be tracked!")
	if not p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] then
		if p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] then
			p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] = nil
		end
		local v222 = p_u_218.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		local v223 = {
			["janitor"] = v222,
			["item"] = p_u_219,
			["isBasePart"] = v220,
			["isCharacter"] = v221
		}
		p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] = v223
		v222:add(p_u_219.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_219, (copy) p_u_218
			if not p_u_219:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				p_u_218:untrackItem(p_u_219)
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		require(v_u_12).itemAdded:Fire(v223)
	end
end

end

function v_u_17.relocate(p231) -- name: relocate

		p231.worldModel = v232
		p231.hasRelocated = true
		local v233 = p231.container
		if typeof(v233) == "table" then
			v233 = Instance.new("Folder")
			for _, v234 in pairs(p231.zoneParts) do

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p27, p28) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p27 == nil or p28 == nil then
		return 0

	for v29 = 1, p27.count do

end

		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")

	end

end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_76 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_76.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_76.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_77.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion

		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end

			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55

		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),

			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),

			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25

				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p27, p28) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet

		local v39 = v35.ChildRemoved

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_77, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()

		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_76.SensedPart

			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_76.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_77.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end

			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)

		end

			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then

		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback

	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
			return
		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()
				if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

	local v_u_10 = {}
	local v_u_11 = {}
	function v2.Start(p12) -- name: Start
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_5
		if v_u_1:IsServer() then
			return

			v_u_9(false, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming)

				local v13 = v_u_6.AssemblyMass

				v16.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true

				local v18 = v_u_11

			end

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_6

	end
	function v2.Stop(p19) -- name: Stop

		end
	end

	end
	function v2.CreateAntiGrav(_) -- name: CreateAntiGrav

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6
			v_u_6.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
		end)
		if #v_u_10 <= 0 then

			end

			v25.Parent = v_u_6

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback

	end

		p_u_239()

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil

				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning

function v_u_17._onItemCallback(p_u_235, p236, p237, p_u_238, p_u_239) -- name: _onItemCallback
	local v240 = p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238]
	if not v240 then
		v240 = {}
		p_u_235.onItemDetails[p_u_238] = v240
	end
	if #v240 == 0 then
		p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = true
	end
	table.insert(v240, p_u_238)
	p_u_235:trackItem(p_u_238)
	if p_u_235:findItem(p_u_238) == p237 then
		p_u_239()
		if p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] then
			p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
			p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)

		end
	else
		local v_u_241 = nil
		v_u_241 = p_u_235[p236]:Connect(function(p242)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_241, (copy) p_u_238, (copy) p_u_239, (copy) p_u_235
			if v_u_241 and p242 == p_u_238 then
				v_u_241:Disconnect()
				v_u_241 = nil
				p_u_239()

					p_u_235.itemsToUntrack[p_u_238] = nil
					p_u_235:untrackItem(p_u_238)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148

				if v_u_141 then

						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()

					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

function v_u_17.trackItem(p_u_218, p_u_219) -- name: trackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v220 = p_u_219:IsA("BasePart")
	local v221
	if v220 then
		v221 = false
	else
		v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v221 then
			v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end
	assert(v220 or v221, "Only BaseParts or Characters/NPCs can be tracked!")
	if not p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] then
		if p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] then
			p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] = nil
		end
		local v222 = p_u_218.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		local v223 = {
			["janitor"] = v222,
			["item"] = p_u_219,
			["isBasePart"] = v220,
			["isCharacter"] = v221
		}
		p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] = v223
		v222:add(p_u_219.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_219, (copy) p_u_218
			if not p_u_219:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				p_u_218:untrackItem(p_u_219)
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		require(v_u_12).itemAdded:Fire(v223)
	end
end

function v_u_4._preventMultiFrameUpdates(p_u_29, p_u_30, ...) -- name: _preventMultiFrameUpdates
	p_u_29._preventMultiDetails = p_u_29._preventMultiDetails or {}
	local v_u_31 = p_u_29._preventMultiDetails[p_u_30]
	if not v_u_31 then
		v_u_31 = {
			["calling"] = false,
			["callsThisFrame"] = 0,
			["updatedThisFrame"] = false
		}
		p_u_29._preventMultiDetails[p_u_30] = v_u_31
	end
	v_u_31.callsThisFrame = v_u_31.callsThisFrame + 1
	if v_u_31.callsThisFrame ~= 1 then
		return true
	end
	local v_u_32 = table.pack(...)
	task.defer(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_31, (copy) p_u_29, (copy) p_u_30, (copy) v_u_32
		local v33 = v_u_31.callsThisFrame

	end)

end
function v_u_4.update(p_u_35) -- name: update

					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_40, (copy) p_u_35

function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end

		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18

		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then

			end

	end
	return true
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6

			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude

				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)

	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate

		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then

		end

			v_u_82 = "None"
		end

	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31) -- name: configureAnimationSet

	v_u_14[p_u_30].count = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_14[p_u_30].connections = {}
	local v_u_33 = true
	local v34, _ = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_33

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				v_u_14[p_u_30].count = v_u_14[p_u_30].count + 1
				local v43 = v_u_14[p_u_30].count
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43] = {}
				v_u_14[p_u_30][v43].anim = v40

				local v44 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v45 = v40.Changed

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v46 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
			end
		end
	end
	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then
		for v50, v51 in pairs(p_u_31) do
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50] = {}
			v_u_14[p_u_30][v50].anim = Instance.new("Animation")

				v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v52[v53].anim)

		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

end
function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103, p104, p105, p106) -- name: switchToAnim
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_12
	if p103 ~= v_u_7 then
		if v_u_8 ~= nil then
			v_u_8:Stop(p105)
			v_u_8:Destroy()
		end
		if v_u_11 ~= nil then

		end
		v_u_10 = 1

		v_u_8:Play(p105)
		v_u_6 = p104
		v_u_7 = p103
		if v_u_9 ~= nil then
			v_u_9:disconnect()
		end
		v_u_9 = v_u_8.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		if p104 == "walk" then
			local v107 = rollAnimation("run")
			v_u_11 = p106:LoadAnimation(v_u_14.run[v107].anim)
			v_u_11.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core

			if v_u_12 ~= nil then
				v_u_12:disconnect()
			end
			v_u_12 = v_u_11.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
	end
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Disconnect()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	if v_u_18 then
		v_u_18:Disconnect()
		v_u_18 = nil
	end
	if v_u_19 then
		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end
local function v_u_94(p89) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_11
	local v90 = p89 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v91 = 0.0001
	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1
	if v90 <= 0.5 then
		v93 = v90 / 0.5
		v91 = 1
	elseif v90 < 1 then
		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v91 = 1 - v92
	else
		v93 = v90 / 1
		v92 = 1
	end
	v_u_8:AdjustWeight(v91)
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v92)
	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v93)
end

function rollAnimation(p100) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v101 = math.random(1, v_u_14[p100].totalWeight)
	local v102 = 1
	while v_u_14[p100][v102].weight < v101 do
		v101 = v101 - v_u_14[p100][v102].weight
		v102 = v102 + 1
	end
	return v102
end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6

		v_u_19:Disconnect()
		v_u_19 = nil
	end
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_19
	if p_u_22.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_21 ~= p_u_22 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_20 = p_u_22.GroundSensor
		v_u_17 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_17
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_17:Disconnect()
				v_u_17 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_18 = p_u_22:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_22, (ref) v_u_18
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_22) then
				v_u_18:Disconnect()
				v_u_18 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_19 = p_u_22.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p23)
			if p23 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_22
	end
	return true
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_20 = nil
	v_u_21 = nil
	local v24 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
	if v24 then
		processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v24)
	end
	if v_u_21 == nil then
		local v_u_25 = nil
		v_u_25 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p26)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25
			if p26:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p26) then
				v_u_25:Disconnect()
				v_u_25 = nil
			end
		end)
	end
end

	local v_u_33 = true

					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

				local v47 = v40.ChildAdded
				table.insert(v46, v47:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31
					configureAnimationSet(p_u_30, p_u_31)
				end))
				local v48 = v_u_14[p_u_30].connections
				local v49 = v40.ChildRemoved
				table.insert(v48, v49:connect(function(_)
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (copy) p_u_31

	if v_u_14[p_u_30].count <= 0 then

		end

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v88 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v88 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v88
end

	local v92 = 0.0001
	local v93 = 1

		v93 = v90 / 0.5

		v92 = (v90 - 0.5) / 0.5

	v_u_8:AdjustSpeed(v93)

end

	end

function onRunning(p128) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_77, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_6
	local v129 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_77 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v130 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v131 = v_u_77.SensedPart
		if v131 then
			local v132 = v131:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_77.HitFrame.Position)
			local v133 = v130.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v134 = v133.X - v132.X
			local v135 = v133.Z - v132.Z
			local v136 = Vector3.new(v134, 0, v135).Magnitude
			local v137 = v_u_76.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v137 < 0.1 then
				v136 = 0
				v137 = 0
			elseif v137 > 1 then
				v137 = 1
			end
			p128 = v136 * v137
		end
	end
	local v138 = v_u_85
	if v138 then
		v138 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v138 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v129 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v129 < p128 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p128 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_16[v_u_6] == nil and not v_u_85 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
		v_u_3 = "Standing"
	end
end

function getToolAnim(p143) -- name: getToolAnim
	for _, v144 in ipairs(p143:GetChildren()) do
		if v144.Name == "toolanim" and v144.className == "StringValue" then
			return v144
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local v_u_145 = 0
function stepAnimate(p146) -- name: stepAnimate
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_145, (ref) v_u_84, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_82, (ref) v_u_83, (ref) v_u_118
	local v147 = p146 - v_u_145
	v_u_145 = p146
	if v_u_84 > 0 then
		v_u_84 = v_u_84 - v147
	end
	if v_u_3 == "FreeFall" and v_u_84 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.2, v_u_2)
	else
		if v_u_3 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, v_u_2)
			return
		end
		if v_u_3 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		elseif v_u_3 == "Dead" or (v_u_3 == "GettingUp" or (v_u_3 == "FallingDown" or (v_u_3 == "Seated" or v_u_3 == "PlatformStanding"))) then
			stopAllAnimations()
		end
	end
	local v148 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if v148 and v148:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local v149 = getToolAnim(v148)
		if v149 then
			v_u_82 = v149.Value
			v149.Parent = nil
			v_u_83 = p146 + 0.3
		end
		if v_u_83 < p146 then
			v_u_83 = 0
			v_u_82 = "None"
		end
		animateTool()
	else
		stopToolAnimations()
		v_u_82 = "None"
		v_u_118 = nil
		v_u_83 = 0
	end
end

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2
	local v151 = ""
	if string.sub(p150, 1, 3) == "/e " then
		v151 = string.sub(p150, 4)

		v151 = string.sub(p150, 8)
	end
	if v_u_3 == "Standing" and v_u_16[v151] ~= nil then
		playAnimation(v151, 0.1, v_u_2)
	end
end)
script:WaitForChild("PlayEmote").OnInvoke = function(p152)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_8
	if v_u_3 == "Standing" then

		end
		if typeof(p152) ~= "Instance" or not p152:IsA("Animation") then
			return false
		end
		playEmote(p152, 0.1, v_u_2)
		return true, v_u_8
	end
end

    [========== SCRIPT: DriverInput ==========]
local v_u_1 = game:GetService("RunService")

local v_u_3 = v_u_2.TouchEnabled
local v_u_4 = {}

function v_u_4.new(p5, p6, p7, p8) -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v9 = v_u_4
	local v10 = setmetatable({}, v9)
	v10.W = p5
	v10.A = p6
	v10.S = p7
	v10.D = p8
	v10.SteerFloat = 0
	v10.ThrottleFloat = 0

	v10.Changed = v10._Event.Event
	return v10
end
function v_u_4.Connect(p_u_11) -- name: Connect
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	p_u_11:Disconnect()
	if v_u_3 then
		p_u_11._cn = v_u_1.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_11
			local v12 = 0
			local v13 = 0
			if p_u_11.W.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v13 = v13 + 1
			end
			if p_u_11.S.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v13 = v13 - 1
			end
			if p_u_11.A.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v12 = v12 - 1
			end
			if p_u_11.D.GuiState == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				v12 = v12 + 1
			end
			p_u_11:_Check(v12, v13)
		end)
	else
		p_u_11._cn = v_u_1.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (copy) p_u_11
			local v14 = 0
			local v15 = 0
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
				v15 = v15 + 1
			end
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
				v15 = v15 - 1
			end
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
				v14 = v14 - 1
			end
			if v_u_2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
				v14 = v14 + 1
			end
			p_u_11:_Check(v14, v15)
		end)
	end
end
function v_u_4._Check(p16, p17, p18) -- name: _Check
	if p17 ~= p16.SteerFloat or p18 ~= p16.ThrottleFloat then
		p16.SteerFloat = p17
		p16.ThrottleFloat = p18
		p16._Event:Fire(p18, p17)

	v_u_6.Adapter = p4
	local v_u_7 = v_u_6.Adapter.Frame

	local function v_u_10(p9) -- name: onInputEnded
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_8
		if p9.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p9.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			v_u_2 = nil
			v_u_8:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_7.InputBegan:Connect(function(p11)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_10

				v_u_2 = v_u_6

				v_u_6.startPos = v_u_7.Position

			v_u_8 = v_u_1.InputEnded:Connect(v_u_10)
		end
	end)
	return v_u_6
end
function v_u_3.Update(p12, p13) -- name: Update
	local v14 = p13.Position - p12.dragStart
	p12.Adapter.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(p12.startPos.X.Scale, p12.startPos.X.Offset + v14.X, p12.startPos.Y.Scale, p12.startPos.Y.Offset + v14.Y)
	p12.Adapter.OriginPosition = p12.Adapter.Frame.Position
end
v_u_1.InputChanged:Connect(function(p15, _)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
	if p15.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or p15.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if v_u_2 then
			v_u_2:Update(p15)
		end
	else

	end
end)
return v_u_3

local v_u_1 = {}

end
function v2.name(p4) -- name: name
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	for _, v5 in v_u_1.all do
		if v5.Name == p4 then
			return v5
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.new(p_u_6, p7) -- name: new
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v8 = v_u_1
	local v9 = setmetatable({
		["Frame"] = p_u_6,
		["Name"] = p7
	}, v8)
	v9.OriginPosition = p_u_6.Position
	v9.ClosePosition = UDim2.new(p_u_6.Position.X.Scale, p_u_6.Position.X.Offset, p_u_6.Position.Y.Scale + 1, p_u_6.Position.Y.Offset)
	p_u_6.Position = v9.ClosePosition
	p_u_6.Visible = true
	v_u_1.all[p_u_6] = v9
	p_u_6.Destroying:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_6

function v_u_1.get(p10) -- name: get
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if v_u_1.all[p10] then
		return v_u_1.all[p10]
	else
		return v_u_1.new(p10)
	end
end
function v_u_1.Open(p11) -- name: Open
	p11.IsOpen = true
	p11.Frame:TweenPosition(p11.OriginPosition, "Out", "Back", 1, true)
end
function v_u_1.Close(p12) -- name: Close
	p12.IsOpen = false
	p12.Frame:TweenPosition(p12.ClosePosition, "Out", "Back", 1, true)
end
function v_u_1.Toggle(p13, p14) -- name: Toggle
	p13.IsOpen = p14 or not p13.IsOpen
	if p13.IsOpen then
		p13:Open()
	else
		p13:Close()
	end
end

function v_u_3.Update(p15, p16) -- name: Update
	local v17 = p15.Model
	local v18 = p15.Driver
	local v19 = p15.Config
	if v17 and v17.Parent then
		if v17:GetAttribute("IsTurn") then
			local v20 = -p15.SteerFloat * v19.MaxTurnAngle
			local v21 = p15.ThrottleFloat * v19.MaxSpeed
			local v22 = not p15.IsLift and 0 or v19.MaxUpAngle
			if p15.Speed < 0 and v21 == 0 then
				p15.Speed = 0
			end
			p15.SteerAngle = p15.SteerAngle + (v20 - p15.SteerAngle) * p16 * v19.TurnSpeed
			p15.Speed = p15.Speed + (v21 - p15.Speed) * p16 * v19.Torque
			if v22 > 0 then
				p15.Up = p15.Up + (v22 - p15.Up) * p16 * v19.UpSpeed
				p15.BalanceOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
			else
				p15.Up = p15.Up * (p15.Up / v19.MaxUpAngle)
				p15.BalanceOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
				local v23 = p15.Speed
				if math.abs(v23) < 0.3 * v19.MaxSpeed or p15.Up < 5 then
					p15.Up = 0
					p15.BalanceOrientation.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.PrimaryAxisPerpendicular
				end
			end
			local v24 = p15.SteerAngle
			local v25 = p15.Speed
			local v26 = p15.Up
			local v27 = workspace:Raycast(p15.Model.BackWheel.Position, v18.CFrame.UpVector * -5, p15.Raypara)
			local v28 = v27 and v27.Normal or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local v29 = v18.CFrame.LookVector:Cross(v28):Cross(v28)
			local v30 = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -v29, v28)
			local v31 = CFrame.new(v18.Position - v28 * 10) * v30 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
			p15.RootAttachment.WorldCFrame = p15.RootAttachment.WorldCFrame:Lerp(v31, 0.5)
			local v32 = v18.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * v25
			local v33 = math.abs(v25)
			local v34 = v32 / math.max(v33, 0.001)
			if v34 < 0 then
				local _ = v34 * 5
			end
			local v35 = -(-p15.SteerFloat) * v19.SteerPerSpeed * v18.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
			local v36 = -v19.MaxSteerSpeed
			local v37 = v19.MaxSteerSpeed
			local v38 = math.clamp(v35, v36, v37)
			if v26 == 0 then
				p15.BalanceOrientation.Attachment0.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, v38)
			else
				local v39 = p15.BalanceOrientation.Attachment0
				local v40 = CFrame.Angles
				local v41 = -math.rad(v26)
				local v42 = -v24
				v39.CFrame = v40(v41, math.rad(v42), (math.rad(v38))) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 1.5707963267948966)
			end
			local v43 = -v19.MaxTurnAngle
			local v44 = v19.MaxTurnAngle
			local v45 = math.clamp(v24, v43, v44)
			local v46 = math.rad(v45)
			local v47 = v19.SteerAngleDivSpeed
			local v48 = p15.Speed
			local v49 = math.abs(v48)
			local v50 = v47 / math.max(v49, 0.001)
			local v51 = v46 / math.max(1, v50)
			v17.Handle.HandleMotor.DesiredAngle = v51
			v17.BackWheel.BackMotor.AngularVelocity = math.max(v25, -10)
			p15:UpdateAnimation()
		end
	else
		p15:Stop()
		return
	end
end

function v_u_6.UpdateAnimation(p14) -- name: UpdateAnimation

	local v19 = p14.Speed
	local v20 = p14.Up or 0
	local v21 = v16.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude / p14.Config.MaxSpeed
	if v18 > 0 then
		if v15.Right then
			v15.Right:Play()
			v15.Right:AdjustSpeed(0)
			v15.Right.TimePosition = v18 / v17.MaxTurnAngle * v15.Right.Length
		end
	elseif v18 < 0 and v15.Left then
		v15.Left:Play()
		v15.Left:AdjustSpeed(0)
		v15.Left.TimePosition = -v18 / v17.MaxTurnAngle * v15.Right.Length
	end

			if v15.FastMove and not v15.FastMove.IsPlaying then
				v15.FastMove:Play()
			end

			if v15.FastMove then

			v15.Back:Stop()

			v15.Idle:Stop()
		end
	elseif v19 < 0 then
		if v15.Back and not v15.Back.IsPlaying then
			v15.Back:Play()
		end
		if v15.Idle and v15.Idle.IsPlaying then
			v15.Idle:Stop()
		end

			v15.BocDau:Play()
			return
		end
	elseif v15.BocDau and v15.BocDau.IsPlaying then

				p8(1, 2)

			local function v14(p11, p12, p13) -- name: callback
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9
				v_u_10 = v_u_10 + 1
				expect(p11).to.equal(v_u_9)
				expect(p12).to.equal(1)
				expect(p13).to.equal(2)
			end
			local v15 = v_u_1.onUnhandledRejection(v14)
			v_u_6()
			expect(v_u_10).to.equal(1)
			v15()
			v_u_1.new(function(_, p16)
				p16(3, 4)
			end)
			v_u_6()
			expect(v_u_10).to.equal(1)
		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise:cancel", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should mark promises as cancelled and not resolve or reject them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_132 = 0
			local v_u_133 = 0
			local v134 = v_u_1.new(function() end):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_132

			expect(v_u_133).to.equal(1)

		end)
		it("should call the cancellation hook once", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_135 = 0
			local v137 = v_u_1.new(function(_, _, p136)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_135

					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_135
					v_u_135 = v_u_135 + 1

	local v10 = type(v9) == "string"
	assert(v10, "Skeleton provided must be a string")
	local v11 = v_u_4[v9]
	if not v11 then
		local v12
		v12, v11 = v_u_2.NumberFormatter.forSkeleton(v9)
		assert(v12, v11)
		v_u_4[v9] = v11
	end
	return v11:Format(p6)
end
function v3.FormatCompact(p13, p14) -- name: FormatCompact
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v15 = type(p13) == "number"
	assert(v15, "Value provided must be a number")

		if type(p28) == "string" then
			v32 = p28
			v31 = true
		elseif type(p28) == "number" then

		end

		else

		end
	elseif string.sub(p29, 1, 1) == "{" then
		local v33 = string.sub(p29, 2, -2)

					error(string.format("Values inside the table argument must be a %s, index %d got %s", v33, v34, (type(v35))), 3)
				end
			end
			v31 = true
		else
			p29 = "table"
		end
	elseif v_u_1.is_a(p28, p29) then
		v32 = v_u_3[p28].data

	end

function v_u_1.try_coerce_range(p36, p37, p38, p39, p40) -- name: try_coerce_range

		local v42 = tonumber(p37)
		if v42 then

				if p40 > p39 then

				end
			else

			end
		else
			p40 = v41
		end
	end
	return p40 or error(string.format("Argument #%d provided must be an integer that is in the range of %d to (and including) %d", p36, p38, p39), 3)

function v_u_1.try_coerce_enum(p43, p44, p45, p46) -- name: try_coerce_enum

function v_u_1.double_to_int32(p50) -- name: double_to_int32
	if p50 > -2147483649 and p50 < 2147483648 then
		if p50 <= -1 then
			return math.ceil(p50)
		else
			return p50 < 1 and 0 or math.floor(p50)
		end
	else
		return UDim.new(nil, p50).Offset
	end

local function v_u_14(p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: internal_get_digits
	local v8
	if p6 <= 0 then
		v8 = string.rep("0", -p6 + 1)
		p6 = 1
	else
		v8 = ""
	end
	local v9 = p6 - 1
	local v10 = p7 - math.max(p5, v9)
	local v11
	if v10 <= 0 then

	else

		p7 = p5
	end
	local v12
	if p5 < p6 then
		v12 = ""
	else
		local v13 = table.unpack
		v12 = string.char(v13(p4, p6, p7))
	end
	return v8 .. v12 .. v11
end
function v_u_3.strip_trailing_zero(p15, p16) -- name: strip_trailing_zero

		return 0
	end

		p16 = p16 - 1

function v_u_3.round_sig(p17, p18, p19, p20, p21) -- name: round_sig
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3
	local v22 = 0
	if p19 < p18 then
		local v23 = nil
		local v24 = p19 < 0 and -1 or (p17[p19 + 1] > 5 and 1 or (p17[p19 + 1] == 5 and (p19 + 1 < p18 and 1 or 0) or -1))
		local v25
		if p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.CEILING then
			v25 = p20 and 1 or -2
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.FLOOR then
			v25 = p20 and -2 or 1
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.UP then
			v25 = -2
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.DOWN then
			v25 = 1
		elseif p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN then
			v25 = p19 <= 0 and 0 or p17[p19] % -2
		else
			v25 = p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.HALF_DOWN and 0 or (p21 == v_u_1.RoundingMode.HALF_UP and -1 or v23)
		end
		if v25 < v24 then
			while p17[p19] == 9 and p19 > 0 do
				p19 = p19 - 1
			end
			if p19 <= 0 then
				p17[1] = 1
				v22 = 1 - p19
				p19 = 1
			else
				p17[p19] = p17[p19] + 1
			end
		end
		p18 = v_u_3.strip_trailing_zero(p17, p19)
	end
	return p18, v22
end
function v_u_3.resolve_int_frac(p26, p27, p28, p29, p30, p31, p32) -- name: resolve_int_frac

		p26[v33] = p26[v33] + 48
	end
	local v34, v35
	if p28 < p29 and p30 < p28 + 1 then
		v34 = "0"
		v35 = ""
	else
		v34 = v_u_14(p26, p27, p29, p28)
		v35 = v_u_14(p26, p27, p28 + 1, p30)
	end
	if p31 and p31 <= p28 - p29 + 1 then
		local v36
		if p32 == "%" then
			v36 = "%0%%"
		elseif #p32 > 1 then

		else
			v36 = "%0" .. p32
		end
		v34 = string.reverse((string.gsub(string.reverse(v34), "...", v36, (p28 - p29) / 3)))
	end

end
function v_u_3.format_expt(p37, p38, p39, p40) -- name: format_expt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1

	local v42
	if p37 < 0 then
		local v43 = -p37
		v42 = tostring(v43)
		if p40.negative then
			v41 = p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kMinusSignSymbol]
		end
	elseif p37 == 0 then
		v42 = "0"

			v41 = p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kPlusSignSymbol]
		end
	else
		v42 = tostring(p37)
		if p40.positive then
			v41 = p38[v_u_1.ENumberFormatSymbols.kPlusSignSymbol]
		end
	end
	local v44 = string.rep("0", p39 - #v42) .. v42

end
function v_u_3.resolve_with_notation(_, p45, p46, p47, p48) -- name: resolve_with_notation

	local v49 = nil
	local v50 = nil
	local v51 = nil
	if p45 <= 0 then
		if p47.type == v_u_1._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC then
			v49 = v_u_3.format_expt(0, p48, p47.minExponentDigits, p47.displayExponentSignAt)
		end
	elseif p47.type == v_u_1._Internal.NotationType.SIMPLE then

	else

			end

function v_u_3.format_unsigned_finite(p57, p58, p59, p60, p61) -- name: format_unsigned_finite

		v70, v77 = v_u_2.resolve_min_max_sig(p61.precision, 1)

	end

		v63 = v62
	elseif v63 == -1 or v63 >= v66 then

	end

local function v_u_19(p9) -- name: precision_to_skeleton

	local v14 = nil
	local v15 = nil
	local v16 = nil
	if p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION then

		v14 = p9.max
	elseif p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.SIGNFICANT then

	elseif p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT then
		v13 = p9.minFractionDigits
		v14 = p9.maxFractionDigits
		if p9.sourcedWithSignificantDigits then
			v15 = p9.minSignificantDigits
			v16 = p9.maxSignificantDigits
		elseif p9.roundingPriority == v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED then
			v15 = p9.maxSignificantDigits
			v16 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
		else
			v16 = p9.maxSignificantDigits
			v15 = 1
		end
	else
		v10 = "precision-unlimited"
	end
	if v13 then
		if v14 == 0 then
			v11 = "precision-integer"
		else
			local v17 = "." .. string.rep("0", v13)
			if v14 == v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION then
				v11 = v17 .. "*"
			else
				v11 = v17 .. string.rep("#", v14 - v13)
			end
		end
	end
	if v15 then
		local v18 = string.rep("@", v15)
		if v16 == v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION then
			v12 = v18 .. "*"
		else
			v12 = v18 .. string.rep("#", v16 - v15)
		end
	end
	if v11 then
		if v12 then
			v11 = v11 .. "/" .. v12
			if p9.type == v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT and p9.sourcedWithSignificantDigits then
				if p9.roundingPriority == v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED then
					return v11 .. "r"
				else
					return v11 .. "s"
				end
			end
		end
	else
		v11 = v12 or v10
	end
	return v11
end

	if p22.max == -1 then
		return "integer-width/*" .. string.rep("0", p22.min)
	else
		return p22.max == 0 and p22.min == 0 and "integer-width-trunc" or "integer-width/" .. string.rep("#", p22.max - p22.min) .. string.rep("0", p22.min)
	end
end

function v3.settings_to_skeleton(p25) -- name: settings_to_skeleton
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_24
	local v26 = {}
	local v27 = nil
	local v28
	if p25.notation then
		local v29
		v28, v29 = v_u_8(p25.notation)
		if v28 then
			table.insert(v26, v29)
		else
			v27 = v29
		end
	else
		v28 = true
	end
	if v28 then
		if p25.precision then
			local v30 = v_u_19(p25.precision)
			table.insert(v26, v30)
		end
		if p25.roundingMode then

		if p25.grouping then

	end

end

local function v_u_43(p37) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_1
	local v38, v40, v40 = string.match(p37, "^(%a+)/?([^/]*)/?([^/]*)$")
	local v41 = 1
	local v42 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
	if v38 == "scientific" or v38 == "engineering" then
		if string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		elseif string.match(v40, "^[%*%+]e+$") then
			v41 = #v40 - 1
		end
		if v40 ~= "" then
			if string.sub(v40, 1, 5) ~= "sign-" then
				return nil
			end
			v42 = v_u_36[v40]
		end
		if v41 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			return table.freeze({
				["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
				["power10Scale"] = v38 == "engineering" and 3 or 1,
				["minExponentDigits"] = v41,
				["exponentSignDisplay"] = v42,
				["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v42)
			})
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_50(p44) -- name: skeleton_to_scientific_notation_concise
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	local v45, v46 = string.match(p44, "^(EE?)(.+)$")
	if v45 then
		local v47, v48 = string.match(v46, "^(%+[!%?])(.+)$")
		local v49
		if v47 then
			v49 = v_u_36[v47]
		else
			v49 = v_u_2.SignDisplay.AUTO
			v48 = v46
		end
		if string.match(v48, "^0+$") then
			if #v48 > 999 then
				return nil
			else
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.NotationType.SCIENTIFIC,
					["power10Scale"] = v45 == "EE" and 3 or 1,
					["minExponentDigits"] = #v48,
					["exponentSignDisplay"] = v49,
					["displayExponentSignAt"] = v_u_1.generate_from_sign_enum(v49)
				})
			end
		else
			return nil
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_71(p51) -- name: skeleton_to_precision
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
	local v52, v53, v54 = string.match(p51, "^%.((0*)#*)(.*)$")
	if not v52 then
		v52, v54 = string.match(p51, "^(precision%-integer)(.*)$")
	end
	if v52 then
		local v55, v56
		if v52 == "precision-integer" then
			v55 = 0
			v56 = 0
		else
			v55 = #v53
			v56 = #v52
		end
		if string.match(v54, "^[%*%+]") and v53 == v52 then
			v54 = string.sub(v54, 2)
			v56 = -1
		end
		if v55 > 999 or v56 > 999 then
			return nil
		else
			if v56 == -1 then
				v56 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
			end
			if string.sub(v54, 1, 1) == "/" then
				local v57 = false
				local v58, v59, v60 = string.match(v54, "^/((@+)#*)([%*%+rs]?)$")
				if not v58 or v60 == "" and v59 ~= "@" or (v60 == "*" or v60 == "+") and v59 ~= v58 then
					return nil
				end
				local v61, v62
				if v60 == "" then
					v61 = #v58
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "s"
				elseif v60 == "*" or v60 == "+" then
					v61 = #v59
					v62 = 1
					v60 = "r"
				else
					v62 = #v59
					v61 = #v58
					v57 = true
				end
				if v62 > 999 or v61 > 999 then
					return nil
				end
				local v63 = table.freeze
				local v64 = {
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION_SIGNIFICANT,
					["minFractionDigits"] = v55,
					["maxFractionDigits"] = v56,
					["minSignificantDigits"] = v62,
					["maxSignificantDigits"] = v61
				}
				local v65
				if v60 == "r" then
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.RELAXED
				else
					v65 = v_u_2.RoundingPriority.STRICT
				end
				v64.roundingPriority = v65
				v64.sourcedWithSignificantDigits = v57
				return v63(v64)
			elseif v54 == "" then
				return table.freeze({
					["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.FRACTION,
					["min"] = v55,
					["max"] = v56
				})
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	else
		local v66, v67, v68 = string.match(p51, "^((@+)#*)([%*%+]?)$")
		if not v66 then
			return nil
		end
		local v69 = #v67
		local v70 = #v66
		if v68 ~= "" then
			if v69 ~= v70 then
				return nil
			end
			string.sub(v68, 2)
			v70 = -1
		end
		if v69 > 999 or v70 > 999 then
			return nil
		end
		if v70 == -1 then
			v70 = v_u_1.MAX_PRECISION
		end
		return table.freeze({
			["type"] = v_u_2._Internal.PrecisionType.SIGNFICANT,
			["min"] = v69,
			["max"] = v70
		})
	end
end
local function v_u_76(p72) -- name: skeleton_to_int_width
	if p72 == "integer-width-trunc" then
		return table.freeze({
			["min"] = 0,
			["max"] = 0
		})
	else
		local v73 = string.match(p72, "^integer%-width/[%*%+](0*)$")
		if v73 then
			if #v73 > 999 then
				return nil
			else
				return table.freeze({
					["min"] = nil,
					["max"] = -1,
					["min"] = #v73
				})
			end
		else
			local v74, v75 = string.match(p72, "^integer%-width/(#*(0*))$")
			if v74 and (v74 ~= "" and (#v74 <= 999 and #v75 <= 999)) then
				return table.freeze({
					["min"] = #v75,
					["max"] = #v74
				})
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_78(p77) -- name: skeleton_to_int_width_concise
	if string.match(p77, "^0+$") and #p77 < 1000 then
		return table.freeze({
			["min"] = nil,
			["max"] = -1,
			["min"] = #p77
		})
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function v3.to_option_linked_list(p79) -- name: to_option_linked_list
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_50, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_78
	local v80 = {}
	local v81 = nil
	for v82, v83 in string.gmatch(p79, "()(%S+)") do
		local v84 = v_u_35[v83]
		local v85
		if v84 then
			v85 = v_u_36[v83]
		else
			v85 = nil
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_43(v83) or v_u_50(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "notation"
			end
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_71(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "precision"
			end
		end
		if not v85 then
			v85 = v_u_76(v83) or v_u_78(v83)
			if v85 then
				v84 = "integerWidth"
			end
		end
		if not v84 or v80[v84] then
			return false, string.format("number skeleton syntax error near \'%*\' at position %d", string.gsub(v83, "\'", "\\\'"), v82)
		end
		v80[v84] = true
		v81 = {
			["key"] = v84,
			["value"] = v85,
			["parent"] = v81
		}
	end
	return true, v81
end

function v_u_20.m_UpdateBoneTree(p75, p76, p77, p78) -- name: m_UpdateBoneTree
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	if p76.Destroyed then
		p76:Destroy()
		table.remove(p75.BoneTrees, p77)
	else
		p76:PreUpdate(p78)
		if p76.InView then
			local v79 = p76.UpdateRate
			if math.floor(v79) ~= 0 and p76.InWorkspace then
				for _, v80 in p75.ColliderObjects do
					v80:Step()
				end
				local v81 = 1 / p76.UpdateRate
				p76.AccumulatedDelta = p76.AccumulatedDelta + p78
				local v82 = false
				while v81 < p76.AccumulatedDelta do
					p76.AccumulatedDelta = p76.AccumulatedDelta - v81
					p76:StepPhysics(v81)
					p76:Constrain(p75.ColliderObjects, v81)
					p76:SolveTransform(v81)
					v82 = true
				end
				if v82 then
					task.synchronize()
					p76:ApplyTransform()
				end
				return
			end
		end
		local v83 = p76.IsSkippingUpdates
		p76:SkipUpdate()
		if not v83 then
			task.synchronize()
			p76:ApplyTransform()
			local v84 = v_u_18
			local v85 = p76.InView
			local v86 = p76.UpdateRate
			v84((("Skipping BoneTree, InView: %*, Update Rate == 0: %*, InWorkspace: %*"):format(v85, math.floor(v86) == 0, p76.InWorkspace)))
		end
	end
end

function v_u_20.LoadObject(p88, p89) -- name: LoadObject

				warn((("[SmartBone2::LoadObject] Duplicate bones of name: %* in RootPart: %*"):format(v93.Name, p89.Name)))
			else
				v92[v93.Name] = v93
			end
		end
		for _, v94 in v91 do
			local v95 = v92[v94]
			if v95 then
				p88:m_CreateBoneTree(p89, v95)

				warn((("[SmartBone2::LoadObject] Couldn\'t find Root Bone of name: %* in RootPart: %*"):format(v94, p89.Name)))
			end
		end
	else
		warn((("[SmartBone2::LoadObject] Cannot load an object with no roots defined %*"):format(p89.Name)))
	end
end

						v71[1].BackgroundColor3 = v71[2].ButtonHoveredColor
						v71[1].BackgroundTransparency = v71[2].ButtonHoveredTransparency
					end
					if p70.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
						v71[1].BackgroundColor3 = v71[2].ButtonColor
						v71[1].BackgroundTransparency = v71[2].ButtonTransparency
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		p63.SelectionImageObject = p_u_2.SelectionImageObject
	end
	function v_u_1.applyTextInteractionHighlights(p72, p_u_73, p_u_74) -- name: applyTextInteractionHighlights
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2
		local v_u_75 = false
		p72.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_73, (copy) p_u_74, (ref) v_u_75
			p_u_73.TextColor3 = p_u_74.ButtonHoveredColor
			p_u_73.TextTransparency = p_u_74.ButtonHoveredTransparency

		end)
		p72.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_73, (copy) p_u_74, (ref) v_u_75
			p_u_73.TextColor3 = p_u_74.ButtonColor
			p_u_73.TextTransparency = p_u_74.ButtonTransparency
			v_u_75 = true
		end)
		p72.InputBegan:Connect(function(p76)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_73, (copy) p_u_74
			if p76.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p76.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
				p_u_73.TextColor3 = p_u_74.ButtonActiveColor
				p_u_73.TextTransparency = p_u_74.ButtonActiveTransparency
			end
		end)
		p72.InputEnded:Connect(function(p77)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_75, (copy) p_u_73, (copy) p_u_74
			if (p77.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p77.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1) and not v_u_75 then
				if p77.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
					p_u_73.TextColor3 = p_u_74.ButtonHoveredColor
					p_u_73.TextTransparency = p_u_74.ButtonHoveredTransparency
				end

					p_u_73.TextColor3 = p_u_74.ButtonColor
					p_u_73.TextTransparency = p_u_74.ButtonTransparency

			end

	end
	function v_u_1.applyFrameStyle(p78, p79, p80) -- name: applyFrameStyle
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_2, (ref) v_u_1
		local v81 = p_u_2._config.FramePadding
		local v82 = p_u_2._config.FrameBorderSize
		local v83 = p_u_2._config.BorderColor
		local v84 = p_u_2._config.ButtonTransparency
		local v85 = p_u_2._config.FrameRounding
		if v82 > 0 and v85 > 0 then
			p78.BorderSizePixel = 0
			local v86 = Instance.new("UIStroke")
			v86.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
			v86.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
			v86.Transparency = v84
			v86.Thickness = v82
			v86.Color = v83
			v_u_1.UICorner(p78, v85)
			v86.Parent = p78
			if not p79 then
				v_u_1.UIPadding(p78, p_u_2._config.FramePadding)
				return
			end
		elseif v82 < 1 and v85 > 0 then
			p78.BorderSizePixel = 0
			v_u_1.UICorner(p78, v85)
			if not p79 then
				v_u_1.UIPadding(p78, p_u_2._config.FramePadding)
				return
			end
		elseif v85 < 1 then
			p78.BorderSizePixel = v82
			p78.BorderColor3 = v83
			p78.BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset
			if not p79 then
				v_u_1.UIPadding(p78, v81 - Vector2.new(v82, v82))
				return
			end
			if not p80 then
				v_u_1.UIPadding(p78, -Vector2.new(v82, v82))
			end
		end
	end
	function v_u_1.discardState(p87) -- name: discardState
		for _, v88 in p87.state do
			v88.ConnectedWidgets[p87.ID] = nil
		end
	end

	local function v_u_9(p5, p6, p7) -- name: getValueByIndex

			end

	local function v_u_23(p10, p11, p12, p13) -- name: updateValueByIndex

	function v105.Update(p140) -- name: Update
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1
		local v141 = p140.Instance.WindowButton
		local v142 = v141.TitleBar
		local v143 = v142.Title
		local v144 = v141:FindFirstChild("MenuBar")

		else

		end
		if p140.arguments.NoScrollbar then
			v145.ScrollBarThickness = 0
		else
			v145.ScrollBarThickness = p_u_1._config.ScrollbarSize
		end
		if p140.arguments.NoTitleBar then
			v142.Visible = false
		else
			v142.Visible = true

			v148 = v148 + v149
		end
		if v144 then
			if p140.arguments.NoMenu then
				v144.Visible = false
			else
				v144.Visible = true

			end

		end
		if p140.arguments.NoBackground then
			v145.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		else
			v145.BackgroundTransparency = p_u_1._config.WindowBgTransparency
		end
		local v150 = p_u_1._config.FramePadding.X + p_u_1._config.TextSize + p_u_1._config.FramePadding.X * 2

			if p153.usesScreenGUI then

		end

		else

			v160.UIStroke.Color = p_u_1._config.BorderColor

		end
		if v_u_158 and v_u_158 ~= 0 then

	end
	function v105.GenerateState(p167) -- name: GenerateState
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_1, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_67, (copy) v_u_49

		end
		if p167.state.position == nil then

			local v169 = p_u_1._widgetState
			local v170 = "position"
			local v171
			if v_u_27 and v_u_26 then
				v171 = v_u_26.state.position.value + Vector2.new(15, 45)
			else
				v171 = Vector2.new(150, 250)
			end
			v168.position = v169(p167, v170, v171)
		end
		p167.state.position.value = v_u_67(p167, p167.state.position.value)
		p167.state.size.value = v_u_49(p167, p167.state.size.value)
		if p167.state.isUncollapsed == nil then
			p167.state.isUncollapsed = p_u_1._widgetState(p167, "isUncollapsed", true)
		end
		if p167.state.isOpened == nil then
			p167.state.isOpened = p_u_1._widgetState(p167, "isOpened", true)
		end
		if p167.state.scrollDistance == nil then
			p167.state.scrollDistance = p_u_1._widgetState(p167, "scrollDistance", 0)
		end
	end
	v104("Window", v105)
end
