		local v18 = v14 * Vector3.new(v16, v17, 0)
		local v19 = -v12
		local v20 = v14 * Vector3.new(v13, v19, 0)
		return (v6 * CFrame.new(0, 0, -v10)):Inverse(), v13, v12, v10, v9:Cross(v20 - v7).Unit, v9:Cross(v18 - v7).Unit, v8:Cross(v7 - v15).Unit, v8:Cross(v7 - v20).Unit, v6
	end,
	["InViewFrustum"] = function(p21, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28, p29, p30) -- name: InViewFrustum
		local v31 = p30.Position
		local v32 = p22 * p21
		if p23 < v32.X or (v32.X < -p23 or (p24 < v32.Y or (v32.Y < -p24 or (p25 < v32.Z or v32.Z < -p25)))) then
			return false
		end
		local v33 = p21 - v31
		return p26:Dot(v33) >= 0 and (p27:Dot(v33) <= 0 and (p28:Dot(v33) >= 0 and p29:Dot(v33) <= 0))
	end,
	["ObjectInFrustum"] = function(p34, p35, p36, p37, p38, p39, p40, p41, p42, p43) -- name: ObjectInFrustum
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_51
		local v44 = p34.CFrame
		local v45 = p34.Size
		local v46 = v_u_2.FAR_PLANE * 0.5
		local v47 = p43.Position + p43.LookVector * v46

		local v49, v50 = v_u_3.ClosestPointInBox(v44, v45, v48)
		return v49 and true or (v_u_51.InViewFrustum(v50, p35, p36, p37, p38, p39, p40, p41, p42, p43) and true or false)
	end
}

		local v19 = (1 / 0)

			local v30 = (v29.x - v18) / (v15 - v18) * 1 + -0.5
			local v31 = (v29.y - v19) / (v16 - v19) * 1 + -0.5

		end

		warn("Expected text to ImOverlay::Text", debug.traceback())

	end
end

	for _, v30 in p29.BackFrame:GetChildren() do

			v30.Visible = false
			local v31 = p29.m_ItemPool
			table.insert(v31, v30)
		end
	end
end

	p32.m_Indent = 0
	p32.m_RenderGroup = {}
end

function v_u_3.Render(p42) -- name: Render
	if p42.m_State == "" then
		p42:m_Pool()
		p42:m_Cleanup()
		p42.DidUpdate = false
		return
	else
		p42.m_State = p42.m_State .. ("%*|%*"):format(p42.DefaultY, p42.TextSize)
		if p42.m_State == p42.m_PreviousState then
			p42:m_Cleanup()
			p42.DidUpdate = false
		else
			p42:m_Pool()
			p42.m_PreviousState = p42.m_State
			p42.DidUpdate = true
			for v43, v44 in p42.m_RenderGroup do
				if #p42.m_ItemPool == 0 then
					local v45 = p42:m_CreateLabel(v44.Text, v44.TextColor, v44.BackgroundColor, v44.Indent)
					v45.LayoutOrder = v43
					v45.Parent = p42.BackFrame
				else
					local v46 = table.remove(p42.m_ItemPool, #p42.m_ItemPool)
					local v47 = v46.TaskText
					v46.LayoutOrder = v43
					v46.BackgroundColor3 = v44.BackgroundColor
					v47.Text = v44.Text
					v47.TextColor3 = v44.TextColor
					v47.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(50 * v44.Indent, 0)
					v46.Visible = true
					v46.Parent = p42.BackFrame
				end
			end
			p42:m_Cleanup()
		end
	end
end
function v_u_3.Destroy(p48) -- name: Destroy
	p48.BackFrame:Destroy()
	setmetatable(p48, nil)
end

local function v_u_20(p15) -- name: QueryTransformedWorldCFrameNonSmartbone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_20

		return v16.CFrame
	end

local function v_u_26(p21, p22) -- name: QueryTransformedWorldCFrame
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_26

	local v23 = p22.ParentIndex
	local v24 = p22.Bone

		return v_u_20(v24)

	if not v25.SolvedAnimatedCFrame then
		v25.AnimatedWorldCFrame = v_u_26(p21, v25)

local function v_u_92(p27, p_u_28, p29) -- name: SolveWind
	local v30 = p_u_28.Settings
	local v31 = v30.WindType
	if v31 ~= "Sine" and (v31 ~= "Noise" and v31 ~= "Hybrid") then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v32 = p_u_28.WindOffset + (os.clock() - p27.HeirarchyLength * 0.2 + (p27.TransformOffset.Position - p_u_28.Root.WorldPosition).Magnitude * 0.2) * v30.WindInfluence
	local v33 = v30.WindSpeed
	local v_u_34 = v30.WindStrength
	if v33 <= 1e-6 or v_u_34 <= 1e-6 then
		return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	local v_u_35 = v30.WindDirection
	local v36 = p29.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or p29.Unit
	local v37 = v36:Dot(v_u_35)
	local v38 = 1 - math.abs(v37)
	if v33 > 0 then
		if v36:Dot(v_u_35) > 0 then
			local v39 = 1 - p29.Magnitude / v33
			v38 = v38 * math.abs(v39)
		else
			v38 = v38 * (1 + p29.Magnitude / v33)
		end
	end
	local v40 = v33 * v38
	local v41 = p29.Magnitude < 100 and p29.Magnitude or 100
	local v42 = v41 == 0 and 0 or 2 ^ (v41 * 10 - 10)
	local v43 = math.min(v42, 100)
	local v_u_44 = v32 * math.max(v43, 1)
	local v_u_45
	if v40 < 1 then
		v_u_45 = v40 * v43
	else
		local v46 = v43 / 2
		v_u_45 = v40 * (v46 > 1 and v46 and v46 or 1)
	end
	local v47 = nil
	local function v63() -- name: SampleSin
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_45, (ref) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_35
		local v48 = v_u_34 ^ 0.8
		local v49 = v_u_45 * 2
		local v50 = v_u_44 * v48
		local v51 = math.sin(v50)
		local v52 = v_u_44 / 10 * v48
		local v53 = math.cos(v52)
		local v54 = v_u_44 * 2 * v48
		local v55 = math.sin(v54)
		local v56 = v_u_44 * 3 * v48
		local v57 = math.cos(v56)
		local v58 = (v51 + v53 + v55 + v57) / 4
		local v59 = v58 * 0.5 + 0.5
		local v60 = v58 * v49
		local v61 = v59 * v49
		local v62 = v_u_35
		if v60 < v61 then
			v60 = v61 or v60
		end
		return v62 * v60
	end
	local function v79(p64, p65) -- name: SampleNoise
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (ref) v_u_45, (copy) p_u_28, (copy) v_u_35
		local v66 = p64 or 0
		local v67 = v_u_34 ^ 0.8
		local v68 = v_u_45 * 2

function v_u_10.UpdateBoundingBox(p19) -- name: UpdateBoundingBox
	if p19.InView then
		local v20 = Vector3.new(inf, inf, inf)
		local v21 = Vector3.new(-inf, -inf, -inf)
		for _, v22 in p19.Bones do
			local v23 = v22.Position - v22.LastPosition
			local v24 = v22.Position + v23

			v21 = v21:Max(v24)
		end

		p19.BoundingBoxCFrame = CFrame.new(v25)
		p19.BoundingBoxSize = p19.RootPartSize:Max(v21 - v20)

function v_u_10.UpdateThrottling(p26, p27) -- name: UpdateThrottling
	local v28 = p26.Settings
	local v29 = (p27 - workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
	if v28.ActivationDistance < v29 then
		p26.UpdateRate = 0
	else
		local v30 = v28.ThrottleDistance
		local v31 = v28.ActivationDistance
		local v32 = (v29 - v30) / (v31 - v30) * 1 + 0
		local v33 = 1 - ((v32 < 1 and v32 and v32 or 1) > 0 and (v32 < 1 and v32 and v32 or 1) or 0)
		p26.UpdateRate = v28.UpdateRate * v33
	end
end

    [========== SCRIPT: Box ==========]
local function v_u_35(p1, p2, p3) -- name: ClosestPointFunc
	local v4 = p1:pointToObjectSpace(p3)
	local v5 = p2.x
	local v6 = p2.y
	local v7 = p2.z
	local v8 = v4.x
	local v9 = v4.y
	local v10 = v4.z
	local v11 = -v5 * 0.5
	local v12 = v5 * 0.5
	local v13 = math.clamp(v8, v11, v12)
	local v14 = -v6 * 0.5
	local v15 = v6 * 0.5
	local v16 = math.clamp(v9, v14, v15)
	local v17 = -v7 * 0.5
	local v18 = v7 * 0.5
	local v19 = math.clamp(v10, v17, v18)
	if v13 == v8 and (v16 == v9 and v19 == v10) then
		local v20 = v8 - v5 * 0.5
		local v21 = v9 - v6 * 0.5
		local v22 = v10 - v7 * 0.5
		local v23 = -v8 - v5 * 0.5
		local v24 = -v9 - v6 * 0.5
		local v25 = -v10 - v7 * 0.5
		local v26 = math.max(v20, v21, v22, v23, v24, v25)
		if v26 == v20 then
			local v27 = v5 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v27, v9, v10), p1.XVector
		elseif v26 == v21 then
			local v28 = v6 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v28, v10), p1.YVector
		elseif v26 == v22 then
			local v29 = v7 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v9, v29), p1.ZVector
		elseif v26 == v23 then
			local v30 = -v5 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v30, v9, v10), -p1.XVector
		elseif v26 == v24 then
			local v31 = -v6 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v31, v10), -p1.YVector
		elseif v26 == v25 then
			local v32 = -v7 * 0.5
			return true, p1 * Vector3.new(v8, v9, v32), -p1.ZVector
		else
			warn("CLOSEST POINT ON BOX FAIL")
			return false, p1.Position, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end
	else

		local v34 = p3 - v33
		return false, v33, v34.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v34.Unit
	end
end

local function v_u_39(p1, p2, p3) -- name: ClosestPointFunc

	local v5 = p2.X * 0.5
	local v6 = p1.Position
	local v7 = p1.RightVector

	local v12 = p1.Position + -p1.RightVector * v5
	local v13 = p1.Position + p1.RightVector * v5
	local v14 = -p1.RightVector
	local v15 = p1.RightVector
	local v16 = p3 - (p3 - v12):Dot(v14) * v14
	local v17 = p3 - (p3 - v13):Dot(v15) * v15
	local v18 = v16 - v12

	local v21
	if v20 < v4 then
		v21 = v20 or v4
	else
		v21 = v4
	end
	local v22 = v12 + v19 * v21
	local v23 = v17 - v13
	local v24 = v23.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v23.Unit
	local v25 = (v17 - v13).Magnitude
	local v26
	if v25 < v4 then
		v26 = v25 or v4
	else
		v26 = v4

	local v27 = v13 + v24 * v26

	local v29 = p3 - v11
	local v30 = v29.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v29.Unit
	local v31 = v28 <= v4
	local v32 = v11 + v30 * v4
	local v33 = (v27 - p3).Magnitude
	local v34 = (v22 - p3).Magnitude
	local v35 = (v32 - p3).Magnitude
	local v36 = math.min(v33, v34, v35)
	if v10 == v5 or v36 == v33 then
		local v37 = p3 - v27
		return (v37.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v37.Unit):Dot(v15) < 0, v27, v15
	end
	if v10 ~= -v5 and v36 ~= v34 then
		return v31, v32, v30
	end
	local v38 = p3 - v22
	return (v38.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v38.Unit):Dot(v14) < 0, v22, v14
end

ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SmartBone.Components.Collision.Colliders.Triangle
    [========== SCRIPT: Triangle ==========]
local v_u_1 = Vector3.new().Dot
local v_u_2 = Vector3.new().Cross
local v_u_3 = math.clamp
return function(p4, p5, p6, p7) -- name: ClosestPointOnTri
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v8 = p5 - p4
	local v9 = p4 + v_u_3(v_u_1(p7 - p4, v8) / v_u_1(v8, v8), 0, 1) * v8
	local v10 = p6 - p5
	local v11 = p5 + v_u_3(v_u_1(p7 - p5, v10) / v_u_1(v10, v10), 0, 1) * v10
	local v12 = p4 - p6
	local v13 = p6 + v_u_3(v_u_1(p7 - p6, v12) / v_u_1(v12, v12), 0, 1) * v12
	local v14 = v_u_2(p5 - p4, p6 - p4)
	local v15 = v14.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v14.Unit
	local v16 = p7 - (p7 - (p4 + p5 + p6) * 0.3333):Dot(v15) * v15
	local v17
	if v_u_1(v_u_2(p6 - p5, p7 - p5), (v_u_2(p6 - p5, p4 - p5))) >= 0 and v_u_1(v_u_2(p6 - p4, p7 - p4), (v_u_2(p6 - p4, p5 - p4))) >= 0 then
		v17 = v_u_1(v_u_2(p5 - p4, p7 - p4), (v_u_2(p5 - p4, p6 - p4))) >= 0
	else
		v17 = false
	end
	if v17 then
		return v16, v15
	else
		local v18 = (v9 - p7).Magnitude
		local v19 = (v11 - p7).Magnitude
		local v20 = (v13 - p7).Magnitude
		local v21 = math.min(v18, v19, v20)
		if v21 == v18 then
			return v9, v15
		elseif v21 == v19 then
			return v11, v15
		elseif v21 == v20 then
			return v13, v15
		else
			return p7, v15
		end
	end
end

ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SmartBone.Components.Constraints.AxisConstraint
    [========== SCRIPT: AxisConstraint ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3, p4)
	local v5 = p4:Inverse() * p2
	local v6 = v5.X
	local v7 = v5.Y
	local v8 = v5.Z
	local v9 = p1.XAxisLimits
	local v10 = p1.YAxisLimits
	local v11 = p1.ZAxisLimits
	local v12 = p1.AxisLocked[1] and 0 or 1
	local v13 = p1.AxisLocked[2] and 0 or 1
	local v14 = p1.AxisLocked[3] and 0 or 1
	if v9.Min == (-1 / 0) and (v9.Max == (1 / 0) and (v10.Min == (-1 / 0) and (v10.Max == (1 / 0) and (v11.Min == (-1 / 0) and v11.Max == (1 / 0))))) then
		if v12 == 1 and (v13 == 1 and v14 == 1) then
			return p2
		end
		local v15 = v6 * v12
		local v16 = v7 * v13
		local v17 = v8 * v14
		return p4 * Vector3.new(v15, v16, v17)
	end
	local v18 = v9.Min + p1.Radius
	local v19
	if v18 <= v9.Max - p1.Radius then
		v19 = v9.Max - p1.Radius or v18
	else
		v19 = v18
	end
	local v20 = v10.Min + p1.Radius
	local v21
	if v20 <= v10.Max - p1.Radius then
		v21 = v10.Max - p1.Radius or v20
	else
		v21 = v20
	end
	local v22 = v11.Min + p1.Radius
	local v23
	if v22 <= v11.Max - p1.Radius then
		v23 = v11.Max - p1.Radius or v22
	else
		v23 = v22
	end
	if v6 < v18 and v18 then
		v6 = v18
	elseif v19 < v6 then
		v6 = v19 or v6
	end
	if v7 < v20 and v20 then
		v7 = v20
	elseif v21 < v7 then
		v7 = v21 or v7
	end
	if v8 < v22 and v22 then
		v8 = v22
	elseif v23 < v8 then
		v8 = v23 or v8
	end
	local v24 = v6 * v12
	local v25 = v7 * v13
	local v26 = v8 * v14
	local v27 = p4 * Vector3.new(v24, v25, v26)
	local v28 = p4.RightVector
	local v29 = p4.UpVector
	local v30 = p4.LookVector
	local v31 = v27 - p3
	local v32 = v31.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v31.Unit
	if v24 ~= v5.X then
		if v28:Dot(v32) < 0 then
			v28 = -v28 or v28
		end
		p1:ClipVelocity(v27, v28)
	end
	if v25 ~= v5.Y then
		if v29:Dot(v32) < 0 then
			v29 = -v29 or v29
		end
		p1:ClipVelocity(v27, v29)
	end
	if v26 ~= v5.Z then
		if v30:Dot(v32) > 0 then
			v30 = -v30 or v30
		end
		p1:ClipVelocity(v27, v30)
	end
	return v27
end

			table.insert(v4, v6:GetObject())
		end
		for _, v8 in v7 do
			table.insert(v5, v8)
		end
	end
	for _, v9 in v5 do
		p2 = v9.ClosestPoint + v9.Normal * p1.Radius
	end
	p1.CollisionsData = v5
	p1.CollisionHits = v4
	return p2
end

ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SmartBone.Components.Constraints.RotationConstraint
    [========== SCRIPT: RotationConstraint ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3)
	local v4 = p1.ParentIndex
	local v5 = p3.Bones[v4]
	if not v5 then
		return p2
	end
	local v6 = v5.RotationLimit
	if v6 >= 180 then
		return p2
	end
	local v7 = p3.Bones[v5.ParentIndex]
	if not v7 then
		return p2
	end
	local v8 = v5.Position
	local v9 = v5.Position - v7.Position
	local v10 = v9.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v9.Unit
	local v11 = (p2 - v8).Magnitude
	local v12 = p2 - v8
	local v13 = v12.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v12.Unit
	if v6 <= 0 then
		return v8 + v10 * v11
	end
	local v14 = p1.RotationLimit
	local v15 = math.rad(v14)
	local v16 = v10:Dot(v13)
	if v15 <= math.acos(v16) then
		local v17 = v10:Cross(v13)
		local v18 = v17.Magnitude == 0 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) or v17.Unit
		v13 = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v18, v15) * v10
	end
	if v13 == v13 then
		v10 = v13
	end
	return v8 + v10 * v11
end

ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SmartBone.Components.Constraints.SpringConstraint
    [========== SCRIPT: SpringConstraint ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5)
	local v6 = p4.Settings
	local v7 = v6.Stiffness
	local v8 = v6.Elasticity
	local v9 = p4.Bones[p1.ParentIndex]
	if v9 then
		local v10 = p1.FreeLength
		if v7 > 0 or v8 > 0 then
			local v11 = p3 or (CFrame.new(v9.Position) * v9.TransformOffset.Rotation * CFrame.new(p1.LocalTransformOffset.Position)).Position

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone

ReplicatedStorage.Templates.Misc.Nhang.LocalScript
    [========== SCRIPT: LocalScript ==========]
local v_u_1 = tick()
local v_u_2 = nil
script.Parent.Activated:Connect(function()
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_2
	if tick() - v_u_1 >= 1 then
		v_u_1 = tick()
		v_u_2 = script.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid"):LoadAnimation(script.Animation)
		v_u_2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
		v_u_2.Looped = false
		v_u_2:Play()
		v_u_2.Stopped:Wait()
		v_u_2:Destroy()
	end
end)

function v_u_6.angleBetweenCFrames(p11, p12) -- name: angleBetweenCFrames

	local v16 = (p11.Position - v14.Position).Unit

		end
	end
end
function v_u_6.whenNearby(p43, p44, p45, p46) -- name: whenNearby
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v47
	if p45.ad_rotate_disabled == true then
		v47 = false
	else
		v47 = true
	end
	repeat
		task.wait(0.5)
	until v_u_6.getCharacterDistance(p44) <= 50 and not p44:GetAttribute("DialogueActive")
	local v48 = p44:GetAttribute("WavingStartTime")
	local v49 = p44:GetAttribute("DialogueActive")
	v_u_6.lookAtObject = v_u_3.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local v50 = false
	while true do
		local v51 = not v48 or v_u_2:GetServerTimeNow() - v48 >= 8
		if v47 then
			v_u_6.lookAtPlayer(p43, p44)
		end
		if v51 and (not v49 and (not v50 and (p46 and v47))) then
			p44:SetAttribute("WavingStartTime", v_u_2:GetServerTimeNow())
			v_u_6.playWaveAnim(p44)
			v50 = true
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
		if v_u_6.getCharacterDistance(p44) > 50 then
			v_u_6.whenNearby(p43, p44, p45, p46)
			return
		end
	end
end
function v_u_6.init(p_u_52, p_u_53, p_u_54) -- name: init
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_5
	local v_u_55 = p_u_53:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local v56 = p_u_54.ad_dialogue_disabled == false
	if p_u_53.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("StatusIcon") then
		p_u_53.PrimaryPart.StatusIcon.Enabled = true
		if not v56 then
			p_u_53.PrimaryPart.StatusIcon.ImageLabel.Visible = false
		end
	end
	if v_u_55 then
		v_u_6.playIdleAnim(p_u_53)
	end
	local v57, v58 = pcall(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_52, (copy) p_u_53, (copy) p_u_54, (copy) v_u_55
		v_u_6.whenNearby(p_u_52, p_u_53, p_u_54, v_u_55)
	end)
	if not v57 then
		v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Error: " .. v58)
	end
end
return v_u_6

function v_u_1.detectRaycast(p78) -- name: detectRaycast

	end

		local v82 = v81.Unit:Dot(v80.Normal.Unit)

end
function lookAt(p84, p85) -- name: lookAt
	local v86 = (p84 - p85).Unit
	local v87 = v86:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))

end

end

function v_u_1.backgroundProcess(p122) -- name: backgroundProcess
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_19
	while true do
		if p122.debugAPI and (p122.adPart and p122.adPart.Parent) then
			p122.debugAPI.EndImpression(p122.adPart.AdSurfaceGui)
		end
		if not p122:waitOrDeletePart() then
			return
		end
		local v123 = not p122.currentGIF
		if v123 then
			v123 = not p122.currentVideo
		end
		if not p122.isAdDisplaying and (p122.currentURL and v123) then
			p122:displayAd(p122.currentAdFormat, p122.currentURL, p122.currentBloxbizAdId, p122.currentAdExternalLinkReferences, p122.currentGIFFPS, p122.currentGIFVersion, p122.currentAudioUrl, p122.showAdDisclaimer, p122.ad_disclaimer_url, p122.ad_disclaimer_scale_x, p122.ad_disclaimer_scale_y, p122.currentBillType)
		end
		p122.isAdDisplaying = true
		local v124, v125 = pcall(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			v_u_1:detectAndMeasureImpression()
		end)
		if not v124 or p122.adPart.Parent == nil then
			if v125 then
				v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Error: " .. v125)
			else
				v_u_5.pprint("[SuperBiz] Warning: Ad part has no parent. Possibly due to streaming.")
			end
		end
		if p122:needsAdRotationForImgOrGifAd() then
			p122:requestAdRotation()
		end
		task.wait(v_u_19)
	end
end

function v_u_1.detectAndMeasureImpression(p126) -- name: detectAndMeasureImpression

	local _, v132, v133, v134 = p126:getSizeAtDistance(v129)
	local v135 = os.time()

	end
	local v141 = {

	}
	local v142

	else

	end
	local v143 = 1
	local v144 = 0
	local v145 = p126.aggregateImpressionTime
	local v146 = not p126.isClientPart

		v146 = v139[p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image]

		v147 = true
	else
		v147 = false
	end
	while v146 and (v147 and (v143 < 200 and not p126:needsAdRotationForImgOrGifAd())) do
		local v148, v149 = p126:detectImpression()

			p126.viewabilityMetEvent:Fire(false)
			break
		end
		local _, v150 = p126:getSizeAtDistance()
		p126.viewabilityMetEvent:Fire(true, v150, v149)
		local v151 = { timeInMs(), v149, v150 }
		table.insert(v141, v151)
		if p126.debugAPI then
			local v152 = p126.currentVideo
			if v152 then
				v152 = p126.currentVideo:getAnalytics()
			end
			local v153 = v152 and v152.playEndSeconds or 0
			p126.debugAPI.UpdateImpressions(v142, {
				["URL"] = v137,
				["PixelWidth"] = v133,
				["PixelHeight"] = v134,
				["Time"] = timeInMs() - v136,
				["VideoTime"] = v153,
				["Per"] = v150,
				["Angle"] = v149
			})
		end
		v143 = v143 + 1
		task.wait(v_u_19)
		v144 = timeInMs() - v136
		p126.aggregateImpressionTime = v145 + v144
		v146 = not p126.isClientPart
		if v146 then
			v146 = v139[p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui.ImageLabel.Image]
		end
		v147 = v140 == p126.currentVideo
	end
	if p126.debugAPI then
		local v154 = p126.currentVideo
		if v154 then
			v154 = p126.currentVideo:getAnalytics()
		end
		local v155 = v154 and v154.playEndSeconds or 0
		p126.debugAPI.UpdateImpressions(v142, {
			["URL"] = v137,
			["PixelWidth"] = v133,
			["PixelHeight"] = v134,
			["Time"] = timeInMs() - v136,
			["VideoTime"] = v155,
			["Per"] = v132,
			["Angle"] = v131
		})
		p126.debugAPI.EndImpression(p126.adPart.AdSurfaceGui)
	end
	p126:sendImpression(v137, v138, v135, v144, v141, p126.isClientPart)
end

function v_u_45.MarkAllForRefresh(p98, p99) -- name: MarkAllForRefresh

function v_u_45.ResetFeed(p101, p102) -- name: ResetFeed
	local v103 = p101.FeedsById[p102]
	local v104 = v103.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v105 = p101.OutfitsCache
	for _, v106 in ipairs(v104) do
		local v107 = type(v106) == "string" and v106 and v106 or v106.guid
		if v105[v107] then
			v105[v107].Frame:Destroy()
			v105[v107].Frame = nil
			v105[v107] = nil
		end
	end
	v103.Page:set(0)
	v103.LastRefresh:set(tick())
	v103.LoadedOutfits:set({})
	v103.LoadedAll:set(false)
	v103.ScrollY:set(0)
end
function v_u_45.SwitchToFeed(p_u_108, p109, p110) -- name: SwitchToFeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
	p_u_108:CancelLoading()
	if p109 ~= "top" then
		p_u_108.TopDropdownOpen:set(false)
	end
	p_u_108.States.Loading:set(true)
	p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(true)
	local v_u_111 = p_u_108.FeedsById[p109]
	v_u_111.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v_u_111.LoadFailed:set(false)
	local v112 = v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:get() and true or p110
	if not v_u_111.Searchable then
		p_u_108.States.Query:set(v_u_44)
	end
	if v112 or tick() - v_u_111.LastRefresh:get() > 60 then
		v_u_111.ShouldRefresh:set(false)
		p_u_108:ResetFeed(p109)
	end
	local v_u_113 = p_u_108.GuiObjects.ScrollingFrame
	v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	p_u_108:ClearWindow()
	task.wait(0.1)
	local v114 = v112 and {} or v_u_111.LoadedOutfits:get()
	if #v114 > 0 then
		p_u_108:RenderOutfits(v114, 0, true):andThen(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_111
			v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, v_u_111.ScrollY:get() or 0)
		end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_108
			p_u_108.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_108.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end)
	else
		p_u_108:LoadNextPage()
		v_u_113.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end
end
function v_u_45.UpdateFilters(p115) -- name: UpdateFilters
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27
	local v116 = p115.States.Query:get().keywords
	if v116 then
		v116 = #v116 > 0
	end
	local v117 = v_u_27.deepCopy(p115.FilterTabs:get())
	for v118, v119 in pairs(v117) do
		if v116 then
			local v120 = v117[v118]
			local v121 = v119.Internal
			if not v121 then
				local v122 = v119.Searchable or v119.SearchOnly
				v121 = not v122
			end
			v120.Hidden = v121
		else
			v117[v118].Hidden = v119.Internal or v119.SearchOnly
		end
	end
	p115.FilterTabs:set(v117)
	p115:MarkAllForRefresh()
	local v_u_123 = p115.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v125 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p124)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
		return p124.Id == v_u_123
	end)
	if p115.Enabled and (not v125 or v125.Hidden) then
		local v127 = v_u_27.search(v117, function(p126)
			return not p126.Hidden
		end)
		p115.States.CurrentFeedId:set(v127.Id)
		p115:SwitchToFeed(v127.Id, true)
	end
end
function v_u_45.LoadNextPage(p_u_128) -- name: LoadNextPage
	p_u_128.States.Loading:set(true)
	local v129 = p_u_128.States.CurrentFeedId:get()
	local v130 = p_u_128.FeedsById[v129]
	v130.SwitchFailed:set(false)
	v130.LoadFailed:set(false)
	v130.Page:set(v130.Page:get() + 1)
	local v131 = v130.Page:get()
	local v132 = v130.LoadedOutfits:get()
	local v133, v134 = p_u_128:GetOutfitsFromFeedId(v130.Id, p_u_128.States.Query:get(), v131)
	if v133 then
		if #v134 > 0 then
			p_u_128:RenderOutfits(v134, #v132, v131 == 1):andThen(function() end):catch(function() end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_128
				p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
				p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
			end)
			for _, v135 in v134 do
				table.insert(v132, v135)
			end
			v130.LoadedOutfits:set(v132)
		else
			v130.LoadedAll:set(true)
			p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
			p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		end
	else
		p_u_128.States.Loading:set(false)
		p_u_128.States.SwitchingFeed:set(false)
		v130.LoadFailed:set(true)
		v130.SwitchFailed:set(v131 == 1)
		v130.Page:set(v131 - 1)
		v130.ErrorType:set(v134.status)
		return
	end
end

function v_u_45.GetServerOutfit(_, p142, p143) -- name: GetServerOutfit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_22
	local v144 = p143:GetAccessories(true)
	local v147 = v_u_27.concat(v_u_27.map(v144, function(p145)
		return p145.AssetId
	end), v_u_27.filter({
		p143.Shirt,
		p143.Pants,
		p143.Torso,
		p143.RightArm,
		p143.LeftArm,
		p143.RightLeg,
		p143.LeftLeg,
		p143.Head,

	}, function(p146)
		if p146 then
			p146 = p146 > 0
		end
		return p146
	end))
	local v148 = v_u_27.defaultdict(function()
		return {}
	end, v_u_23.GetBatchItemDetails(v147))
	table.sort(v144, function(p149, p150)
		return (p149.Order or 0) < (p150.Order or 0)

		local v153 = v_u_21.GetAllowedSlot(v152.AccessoryType.Name)
		if v153 then

			}
			table.insert(v151, v154)
		end
	end
	local v155 = {
		["id"] = p143.Shirt,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.Shirt,
		["name"] = v148[p143.Shirt].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.Shirt].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v155)
	local v156 = {
		["id"] = p143.Pants,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.Pants,
		["name"] = v148[p143.Pants].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.Pants].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v156)
	local v157 = {
		["id"] = p143.Torso,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.Torso,
		["name"] = v148[p143.Torso].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.Torso].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v157)
	local v158 = {
		["id"] = p143.RightArm,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.RightArm,
		["name"] = v148[p143.RightArm].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.RightArm].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v158)
	local v159 = {
		["id"] = p143.RightLeg,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.RightLeg,
		["name"] = v148[p143.RightLeg].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.RightLeg].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v159)
	local v160 = {
		["id"] = p143.LeftArm,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.LeftArm,
		["name"] = v148[p143.LeftArm].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.LeftArm].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v160)
	local v161 = {
		["id"] = p143.LeftLeg,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.LeftLeg,
		["name"] = v148[p143.LeftLeg].Name,
		["price"] = v148[p143.LeftLeg].Price
	}
	table.insert(v151, v161)
	local v162 = {
		["id"] = p143.Head,
		["slot"] = v_u_22.Slots.Head,

function v_u_45.Enable(p179) -- name: Enable
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6
	if p179.Enabled then
		return
	else
		p179.Enabled = true
		p179.GuiObjects.Frame.Visible = true
		p179.Controllers.CategoryController:Disable(true)
		p179.Controllers.OutfitsController:Disable()
		p179.Controllers.InventoryController:Disable()
		p179.Controllers.BodyEditorController:Disable()
		v_u_6:FireServer("Feed")
		local v180 = p179.Controllers.TopBarController.SearchQuery:get()
		if v180 and #v180 > 0 then
			p179:SearchFor(v180)
		else
			if p179.States.CurrentFeedId:get() == "hot" then
				p179:SwitchToFeed("hot", true)
			else
				p179.FeedsById.hot.ShouldRefresh:set(true)
				p179.setSortTab("hot")
			end
			p179:UpdateFilters()
		end
	end
end

	end
	p182.GuiObjects.ItemFrame.Visible = true
end
function v_u_45.GetFeedFromServer(p_u_185, p186, p187, p188) -- name: GetFeedFromServer

	if p186 == 1 then

		p_u_185:ClearWindow()

	local v189, v190 = v_u_11:InvokeServer(p187, p186, p188, 20)

function v_u_26.SwitchToFeed(p_u_124, p125) -- name: SwitchToFeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
	local v126 = p_u_124.CurrentFeedId
	if v126:get() == p125 then
		return
	else

		end

		if #v128 > 0 then

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_124

			p_u_124:LoadNextPage(v127)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_26.LoadFromCache(p_u_131, p_u_132, p_u_133) -- name: LoadFromCache

		if not p_u_133 then
			p_u_131.Loading:set(true)
		end
		for _, v136 in p_u_132 do
			v_u_11(p_u_131, v136).Parent = v135
		end
		p134()
	end)
end
function v_u_26.LoadNextPage(p_u_137, p138, p139) -- name: LoadNextPage
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123
	if not p139 then
		p_u_137.Loading:set(true)
	end
	p138.Page = p138.Page + 1
	local v140 = p138.id
	local v141 = p138.Page
	local v142, v143 = p_u_137:GetShopsFromFeedId(v140, v141)
	if v142 then
		if #v143 > 0 then
			local v144 = p138.CacheShops(v143)
			local v145 = p_u_137.LoadingPromises
			local v146 = p_u_137:LoadFromCache(v144, p139)
			table.insert(v145, v146:andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_137

			end))

				v_u_123(p_u_137.Guis.ShopListFrame)
			end

	else

		p138.Page = p138.Page - 1
		p_u_137.Loading:set(false)

	end
end

end

	if p47:lower() == "outfits" or p47:lower() == "feed" then
		p46:OnCategoryClick("feed")
		return
	elseif p47:lower() == "shops" then
		p46:OnCategoryClick("shops")
		return
	else
		local v48 = p46.Controllers.CategoryController:GetCategoryId(p47)
		if v48 then
			p46:OnCategoryClick(v48)
		else
			p46:SearchFor(p47)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_12.OnOpen(p_u_49) -- name: OnOpen
	p_u_49.SearchQuery:set(nil)
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_49
		if p_u_49.OpenCategory then
			local v50 = p_u_49.OpenCategory
			p_u_49.OpenCategory = nil
			p_u_49:SwitchToCategoryOrSearch(v50)
			return
		elseif p_u_49.CurrentCategory:get() then
			p_u_49:OnCategoryClick(p_u_49.CurrentCategory:get())
		else
			p_u_49.Controllers.NavigationController:SwitchTo("Featured")
		end
	end)
end

function v_u_4.UpdateImpressions(p27, p28) -- name: UpdateImpressions
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4
	if p27 ~= nil then
		local v29 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 236, 12)
		local v30 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local v31 = p27.Row1.Time.Text
		local v32 = tonumber(v31)
		local v33 = p28.Time - v32
		if v_u_5[p28.URL] == nil then
			v_u_5[p28.URL] = 0
		end
		if p28.Per > 1.5 and (p28.Angle <= 55 and p28.Time > 0.5) then
			if p28.Time - v33 <= 0.5 and p28.Time > 0.5 then
				v33 = p28.Time
			end
			local v34 = v_u_5[p28.URL] / 10
			math.floor(v34)
			v_u_5[p28.URL] = v_u_5[p28.URL] + v33
		end
		if p28.Per >= 1.5 then
			p27.Row2.ScreenPercentage.TextColor3 = v29
		else
			p27.Row2.ScreenPercentage.TextColor3 = v30
		end
		if p28.Angle <= 55 then
			p27.Row2.Angle.TextColor3 = v29
		else
			p27.Row2.Angle.TextColor3 = v30
		end
		p27.Row1.Time.Text = string.format("%.2f", p28.Time)
		p27.Row2.ScreenPercentage.Text = string.format("%.2f", p28.Per) .. "%"
		p27.Row2.Angle.Text = string.format("%.1f", p28.Angle) .. "\194\176"
		if v_u_4.videoDebugModeEnabled() and p27.Row1:FindFirstChild("VideoTime") then
			p27.Row1.VideoTime.Text = string.format("%.2f", p28.VideoTime)
		end
		script.Parent.ImpressionTime.Text = v_u_4.GetImpressions()
	end
end
function v_u_4.StartImpression(p35, p36) -- name: StartImpression
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v37 = v_u_4.GetAdColor(p35)
	if v37 == nil then
		warn("[SuperBiz] Can\'t track ad, too many on screen")
		return nil
	end
	if p35:FindFirstChild("Colorize") then
		warn("[SuperBiz] New impression started before old impression ended")
		return nil
	end
	local v38 = script.Parent.Item:Clone()
	local v39 = script.Parent.Colorize:Clone()
	v39.Parent = p35
	v38.Parent = script.Parent.Main
	v38.Parent.Visible = true
	v39.Visible = true
	v38.Visible = true
	v39.BackgroundColor3 = v37
	v39.UI.Value = v38
	v39.ZIndex = 99
	v38.Row2.BackgroundColor3 = v37

	end

		v_u_4.playVideoDebugAd()

		v40.Parent = v38.Row1

		v40.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
		v40.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)

		v39.Transparency = 0.5
	end

end

ReplicatedStorage.BloxbizSDK.PopfeedClient.TimeFormat
    [========== SCRIPT: TimeFormat ==========]
return {
	["GetDate"] = function(p1) -- name: GetDate
		local _ = os.time() - p1
		return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(p1):FormatUniversalTime("ll", "en-us")
	end,
	["GetTime"] = function(p2) -- name: GetTime
		local _ = os.time() - p2
		return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(p2):FormatUniversalTime("LT", "en-us")
	end,
	["Format"] = function(p3) -- name: Format
		local v4 = os.time() - p3
		if v4 >= 86400 then
			return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(p3):FormatUniversalTime("ll", "en-us")
		end
		if v4 >= 3600 then
			local v5 = v4 / 3600
			return math.floor(v5) .. "h"
		end
		if v4 < 60 then
			return "Now"
		end
		local v6 = v4 / 60
		return math.floor(v6) .. "m"
	end
}

function v_u_16.GetAdFromInput(p44, p45) -- name: GetAdFromInput
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_16
	local v46 = {
		["ad_format"] = nil,
		["ad_url"] = nil,
		["bloxbiz_ad_id"] = -2,
		["external_link_references"] = {},
		["gif_fps"] = p45,
		["gif_version"] = nil,
		["audio_url"] = nil,
		["show_ad_disclaimer"] = true,
		["ad_disclaimer_url"] = "rbxassetid://7122215099",
		["ad_disclaimer_scale_x"] = 0.117,
		["ad_disclaimer_scale_y"] = 0.08
	}
	if string.match(p44, ",") then
		local v47 = {}
		for v48 in string.gmatch(p44, "([^,]+)") do
			table.insert(v47, {
				["ad_url"] = nil,
				["frames_per_sheet"] = 8,
				["ad_url"] = v48
			})
		end
		v46.ad_format = "gif"
		v46.ad_url = v47
		v46.gif_version = 2
	elseif v_u_9.getAdUsingBloxbizAdId(p44) then
		local v49 = v_u_9.getAdUsingBloxbizAdId(p44)
		v46.ad_format = v49.ad_format
		v46.ad_url = v49.ad_url
		v46.bloxbiz_ad_id = v49.bloxbiz_ad_id
		v46.gif_version = v49.gif_version or 2
		v46.gif_fps = v49.gif_fps or p45
		v46.audio_url = v49.audio_url
		local v50 = v49.ad_format == "static"
		local v51 = v49.ad_format == "portal"
		if v51 then
			v46.destination_place_id = v49.destination_place_id
		end
		if v50 or v51 then
			v46.ad_url = { v49.ad_url }
		end
	elseif string.match(p44, "id") then
		if v_u_16.IsAudioAd then
			v46.ad_format = "audio"
			v46.audio_url = tostring(p44)
			v46.gif_version = nil
		else
			v46.ad_format = "static"
			v46.ad_url = { (tostring(p44)) }
			v46.gif_version = nil
		end
	end
	local v52 = v46.ad_url
	local v53 = v46.ad_format == "3d"
	if v52 or v46.ad_format == "audio" then
		return v46
	end
	if v53 then
		return v_u_9.getAdUsingBloxbizAdId(p44)
	end
end
function v_u_16.ProcessInput() -- name: ProcessInput
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_16
	local v54 = 10
	local v55 = v_u_10.PlayerGui.ScreenshotTool.Main
	local v56 = v55.Ad.TextBox.Text
	local v57 = v55.FPS.TextBox.Text
	local v58 = tonumber(v57)
	if v58 == nil then
		v58 = v54
	elseif v58 <= 0 then
		v58 = v54
	end
	local v59 = v_u_16.GetAdFromInput(v56, v58)
	local v60
	if v59 then
		v60 = v59.ad_format == "3d"
	else
		v60 = v59
	end
	local v61
	if v59 then
		v61 = v59.ad_format == "portal"
	else
		v61 = v59
	end
	local v62
	if v59 then
		v62 = v59.ad_format == "audio"
	else
		v62 = v59
	end
	if v61 then
		v_u_16.TargetPortalAd(v59)
	elseif v60 then
		v_u_16.Target3dAd(v59)
	elseif v62 then
		v_u_16.TargetAudioAd(v59)
	elseif v59 then
		v_u_16.TurnOffTargeting()
		v_u_16.TurnOnTargeting(v59)
	else
		v_u_16.TurnOffTargeting()
	end
	if v_u_16.DebugModeForceEnabled then
		v_u_16.TurnOffDebugMode()
	else
		v_u_16.TurnOnDebugMode()
	end
end

ReplicatedStorage.BloxbizSDK.Utils.Fusion.Animation.springCoefficients
    [========== SCRIPT: springCoefficients ==========]
return function(p1, p2, p3) -- name: springCoefficients
	if p1 == 0 or p3 == 0 then
		return 1, 0, 0, 1
	end
	if p2 > 1 then
		local v4 = p1 * p3
		local v5 = p2 ^ 2 - 1
		local v6 = math.sqrt(v5)
		local v7 = -0.5 / v6
		local v8 = -v6 - p2
		local v9 = 1 / v8
		local v10 = v4 * v8
		local v11 = math.exp(v10)
		local v12 = v4 * v9
		local v13 = math.exp(v12)
		return (v13 * v8 - v11 * v9) * v7, (v11 - v13) * v7 / p3, (v13 - v11) * v7 * p3, (v11 * v8 - v13 * v9) * v7
	end
	if p2 == 1 then
		local v14 = p1 * p3
		local v15 = -v14
		local v16 = math.exp(v15)
		return v16 * (v14 + 1), v16 * p1, v16 * (-v14 * p3), v16 * (1 - v14)
	end
	local v17 = p1 * p3
	local v18 = 1 - p2 ^ 2
	local v19 = math.sqrt(v18)
	local v20 = 1 / v19
	local v21 = v19 * v17
	local v22 = -v17 * p2
	local v23 = math.exp(v22)
	local v24 = v23 * math.sin(v21)
	local v25 = v23 * math.cos(v21)
	local v26 = v24 * v20
	local v27 = v26 * p2
	return v27 + v25, v26, -(v27 * p2 + v24 * v19), v25 - v27
end

local v_u_2 = require(script.Parent.Parent)
local v_u_3 = {}

function DecodeData(p8) -- name: DecodeData
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v9 = {}
	local v10 = string.byte(p8:sub(1, 1))
	local v11 = v_u_3.StoreType[v10] or "Invalid"
	if v11 == "Invalid" then
		v_u_2.pprint("[SuperBiz][RBXLSerialize][Binary]:StoreType defined as Invalid? Binary Data may be corrupted?")
	else
		v9.TypeOf = v11
		local v12 = 1
		local v13
		if v11 == "Instance" then
			local v14 = string.byte(p8:sub(2, 2))
			v9.ClassName = v_u_3.InstanceName[v14] or "Invalid"
			v12 = v12 + 1
			v13 = "Ins:Prop"
		else
			v13 = ""
		end
		if v11 == "Value" then
			local v15 = string.byte(p8:sub(2, 2))
			local v16 = v_u_3.DataType[v15] or "Invalid"
			v9.ClassName = v16
			v9[v16] = p8:sub(4, 4 + string.byte(p8:sub(3, 3)))
			v12 = v12 + 5
			v13 = "Val:Prop"
		end
		if v11 == "Root" then
			v9.ClassName = "Root"
			v9.Root = {}
			v12 = v12 - 1
			v13 = "Root:NewRoot"
		end
		while v12 < #p8 do
			v12 = v12 + 1
			string.byte(p8:sub(v12, v12))
			if v13 == "Root:NewRoot" and v12 + 3 < #p8 then
				local v17 = v12 + 1
				local v18 = string.byte(p8:sub(v17, v17))
				local v19 = p8:sub(v12 + 2, v12 + 1 + v18)
				local v20 = v12 + 2 + v18
				local v21 = string.byte(p8:sub(v20, v20))
				local v22 = p8:sub(v12 + 3 + v18, v12 + 3 + v18 + v21)
				local v23 = DecodeData(v22)
				local v24 = v9.Root
				table.insert(v24, { v19, v23 })
				v12 = v12 + (v18 + v21 + 1)
			end
			if v13 == "Ins:Prop" and v12 + 2 < #p8 then
				local v25 = p8:sub(v12, v12 + 1)
				local v26 = string.unpack("H", v25)
				local v27 = v_u_3.ValueType[v26] or "Invalid"
				local v28 = v12 + 1
				local v29 = v28 + 1
				local v30 = string.byte(p8:sub(v29, v29))
				local v31 = p8:sub(v28 + 2, v28 + 1 + v30)
				if v27 ~= "Invalid" then
					v9[v27] = v31
				end
				v12 = v28 + v30 + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return v9
end
return {
	["DecodeData"] = DecodeData,
	["describe"] = function(p32, p33)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2
		local v34 = v_u_1[p32]
		if v34 and v34[p33] then
			if p32 == "ValueType" then
				return string.pack("H", v34[p33])
			end
			local v35 = v34[p33]
			return string.char(v35) or 0
		end
		if p32 ~= "Value" then
			v_u_2.pprint("[SuperBiz][RBXLSerialize][Binary]:Could not describe", p32, p33)
			return 0
		end
		local v36 = tostring(p33)
		local v37 = #v36
		if v37 <= 255 then
			return string.char(v37) .. v36 or 0
		end
		v_u_2.pprint("[SuperBiz][RBXLSerialize][Binary]:Cannot Encode DataValues more than 255 Bytes.")
	end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148

				if v_u_141 then

						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position

					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		v_u_144:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

function v_u_17.trackItem(p_u_218, p_u_219) -- name: trackItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	local v220 = p_u_219:IsA("BasePart")
	local v221
	if v220 then
		v221 = false
	else
		v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v221 then
			v221 = p_u_219:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end
	assert(v220 or v221, "Only BaseParts or Characters/NPCs can be tracked!")
	if not p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] then
		if p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] then
			p_u_218.itemsToUntrack[p_u_219] = nil
		end
		local v222 = p_u_218.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		local v223 = {
			["janitor"] = v222,

			["isBasePart"] = v220,
			["isCharacter"] = v221
		}
		p_u_218.trackedItems[p_u_219] = v223
		v222:add(p_u_219.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_219, (copy) p_u_218
			if not p_u_219:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				p_u_218:untrackItem(p_u_219)
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		require(v_u_12).itemAdded:Fire(v223)
	end
end
